-+++++-  async function handleSkuImageUpload(files: FileList) {
-+++++-    const preview = document.getElementById('sku-image-preview')!;
-+++++-    const uploadArea = document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')!;
-+++++-
-+++++-    for (const file of files) {
-+++++-      if (skuMediaIds.length >= 4) break;
-+++++-
-+++++-      const isImage = IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
-+++++-      const isVideo = VIDEO_TYPES.includes(file.type);
-+++++-
-+++++-      if (!isImage && !isVideo) continue;
-+++++-
-+++++-      if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
-+++++-        alert(`Image too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 2MB`);
-+++++-        continue;
-+++++-      }
-+++++-      if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
-+++++-        alert(`Video too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 8MB`);
-+++++-        continue;
-+++++-      }
-+++++-
-+++++-      let fileToUpload = file;
-+++++-
-+++++-      // Compress video
-+++++-      if (isVideo) {
-+++++-        const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
-+++++-        statusDiv.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs rounded-lg z-10';
-+++++-        statusDiv.textContent = 'Processing...';
-+++++-        uploadArea.style.position = 'relative';
-+++++-        uploadArea.appendChild(statusDiv);
-+++++-
-+++++-        try {
-+++++-          const { compressVideo } = await import('@/lib/video-compress');
-+++++-          const result = await compressVideo(file, {
-+++++-            maxSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
-+++++-            onProgress: (p) => { statusDiv.textContent = p.message; }
-+++++-          });
-+++++-
-+++++-          if (!result.withinLimit) {
-+++++-            alert('Video still too large after compression');
-+++++-            statusDiv.remove();
-+++++-            continue;
-+++++-          }
-+++++-          fileToUpload = result.file;
-+++++-          statusDiv.textContent = 'Uploading...';
-+++++-        } catch (err) {
-+++++-          console.error('Video compression error:', err);
-+++++-          statusDiv.remove();
-+++++-          alert('Video processing failed');
-+++++-          continue;
-+++++-        }
-+++++-      }
-+++++-
-+++++-      try {
-+++++-        const result = await actions.media.uploadMedia({ file: fileToUpload, category: 'sku' });
-+++++-        const data = { success: result.success, data: result.data };
-+++++-        if (data.success && data.data?.id) {
-+++++-          skuMediaIds.push(data.data.id);
-+++++-          const html = buildMediaThumbnailHtml(data.data.id, data.data.url, isVideo);
-+++++-          preview.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
-+++++-          preview.classList.remove('hidden');
-+++++-          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
-+++++-        }
-+++++-      } catch (err) {
-+++++-        console.error('Upload error:', err);
-+++++-      }
-+++++-    }
-+++++-  }

-+++++-  async function initEditor(initialContent = '') {
-+++++-    // Load editor modules first
-+++++-    const loaded = await loadEditor();
-+++++-    if (!loaded || !Editor) return null;
-+++++-
-+++++-    const element = document.querySelector('#tiptap-editor');
-+++++-    if (!element) return null;
-+++++-
-+++++-    // Destroy existing editor
-+++++-    if (editor) {
-+++++-      editor.destroy();
-+++++-    }
-+++++-
-+++++-    editor = new Editor({
-+++++-      element,
-+++++-      extensions: [
-+++++-        StarterKit,
-+++++-        Underline,
-+++++-        PlaceholderExt.configure({
-+++++-          placeholder: element.dataset.placeholder || 'Start writing...',
-+++++-        }),
-+++++-      ],
-+++++-      content: initialContent,
-+++++-      immediatelyRender: false,
-+++++-      onUpdate: ({ editor }) => {
-+++++-        // Sync to hidden input
-+++++-        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
-+++++-        if (hiddenInput) {
-+++++-          hiddenInput.value = editor.getHTML();
-+++++-        }
-+++++-      },
-+++++-    });
-+++++-
-+++++-    // Initial sync
-+++++-    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
-+++++-    if (hiddenInput) {
-+++++-      hiddenInput.value = initialContent;
-+++++-    }
-+++++-
-+++++-    return editor;
-+++++-  }

-+++++-  // Toolbar button handler
-+++++-  function setupToolbar() {
-+++++-    document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach(btn => {
-+++++-      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
-+++++-        if (!editor) return;
-+++++-        const command = btn.dataset.command;
-+++++-        const level = btn.dataset.level;
-+++++-
-+++++-        if (command === 'toggleHeading' && level) {
-+++++-          editor.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: parseInt(level) }).run();
-+++++-        } else if (command === 'undo') {
-+++++-          editor.chain().focus().undo().run();
-+++++-        } else if (command === 'redo') {
-+++++-          editor.chain().focus().redo().run();
-+++++-        } else if (command) {
-+++++-          const cmd = editor.chain().focus()[command];
-+++++-          if (typeof cmd.run === 'function') {
-+++++-            cmd.run();
-+++++-          }
-+++++-        }
-+++++-      });
-+++++-    });
-+++++-  }
-+++++-
-+++++-  // Update toolbar button active states
-+++++-  function updateToolbarState() {
-+++++-    if (!editor) return;
-+++++-    document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach(btn => {
-+++++-      const command = btn.dataset.command;
-+++++-      const level = btn.dataset.level;
-+++++-      let isActive = false;
-+++++-
-+++++-      if (command === 'toggleHeading' && level) {
-+++++-        isActive = editor.isActive('heading', { level: parseInt(level) });
-+++++-      } else if (['toggleBold', 'toggleItalic', 'toggleUnderline', 'toggleBulletList', 'toggleOrderedList', 'toggleBlockquote'].includes(command)) {
-+++++-        isActive = editor.isActive(command.replace('toggle', '').toLowerCase());
-+++++-      }
-+++++-
-+++++-      btn.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
-+++++-    });
-+++++-  }

-+++++-  // Auth fetch helper
-+++++-  async function authFetch(url, options = {}) {
-+++++-    return fetch(url, {
-+++++-      ...options,
-+++++-      credentials: 'include',
-+++++-      headers: {
-+++++-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
-+++++-        ...options.headers,
-+++++-      },
-+++++-    });
-+++++-  }

-+++++-  // Load SKUs
-+++++-  async function loadSKUs() {
-+++++-    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
-+++++-    const countEl = document.getElementById('skus-count');
-+++++-    const businessFilter = document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement;
-+++++-    if (!container) return;
-+++++-
-+++++-    // Populate business filter options
-+++++-    if (businessFilter) {
-+++++-      businessFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Businesses</option>' + buildBusinessFilterOptions();
-+++++-    }
-+++++-
-+++++-    try {
-+++++-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/skus');
-+++++-      const data = await res.json();
-+++++-
-+++++-      if (!data.success) {
-+++++-        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Failed to load SKUs</p>';
-+++++-        return;
-+++++-      }
-+++++-
-+++++-      (window as SkuData).allSkus = data.data || [];

-+++++-      credentials: 'include',

-+++++-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),

-+++++-  }
-+++++-
-+++++-  async function loadPlans() {
-+++++-    try {
-+++++-      const result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.getAll();
-+++++-
-+++++-      if (result.success && result.data) {
-+++++-        plans = result.data;
-+++++-        renderPlans();

-+++++-        showError(result.error?.message || 'Failed to load plans');

-+++++-    } catch (e) {
-+++++-      console.error('Failed to load plans:', e);
-+++++-      showError('Failed to load plans');

-+++++-  function renderPlans() {

-+++++-        </td>

-+++++-  function updateStats() {

-+++++  // Render SVG line chart helper
-+++++  function renderLineChart(svgId: string, data: number[], labels: string[], color: string) {
-+++++    const svg = document.getElementById(svgId) as unknown as SVGSVGElement;
-+++++    if (!svg || !data.length) return;
-+++++
-+++++    const width = svg.clientWidth || 400;
-+++++    const height = svg.clientHeight || 128;
-+++++    const padding = { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 30, left: 10 };
-+++++    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
-+++++    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
-+++++
-+++++    const maxVal = Math.max(...data, 1);
-+++++    const minVal = 0;
-+++++    const range = maxVal - minVal || 1;
-+++++
-+++++    const points = data.map((val, i) => ({
-+++++      x: padding.left + (i / (data.length - 1)) * chartWidth,
-+++++      y: padding.top + chartHeight - ((val - minVal) / range) * chartHeight
-+++++    }));
-+++++
-+++++    const pathD = points.map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${p.x} ${p.y}`).join(' ');
-+++++    const areaD = pathD + ` L ${points[points.length - 1].x} ${height - padding.bottom} L ${padding.left} ${height - padding.bottom} Z`;
-+++++    const safeLabels = labels.map(l => String(l ?? '').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'));
-+++++
-+++++    const circles = points.map((p, i) => `
-+++++      <circle cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="4" fill="${color}">
-+++++        <title>${safeLabels[i]}: ${data[i]}</title>
-+++++      </circle>
-+++++      <text x="${p.x}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-muted-foreground text-xs">${safeLabels[i]}</text>
-+++++    `).join('');
-+++++
-+++++    const svgContent = `<defs>
-+++++      <linearGradient id="${svgId}-gradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
-+++++        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
-+++++        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0"/>
-+++++      </linearGradient>
-+++++    </defs>
-+++++    <path d="${areaD}" fill="url(#${svgId}-gradient)"/>
-+++++    <path d="${pathD}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
-+++++    ${circles}`;
-+++++
-+++++    svg.innerHTML = sanitize(svgContent);
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  if (stats.monthly?.length) {

-+++++  function formatDate(ts: number | null): string {

-+++++  }

-+++++  async function loadListings() {

-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  function updateStats() {

-+++++    const total = listings.length;
-+++++    const published = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'published' || l.status === 'active').length;
-+++++    const draft = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'draft').length;

-+++++  function renderListings() {
-+++++    if (!tbody) return;
-+++++    const search = searchInput?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
-+++++    const status = statusFilter?.value || '';
-+++++
-+++++    const filtered = listings.filter(l => {
-+++++      if (search && !(l.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ?? false)) return false;
-+++++      if (status) {
-+++++        if (status === 'published') {
-+++++          if (l.status !== 'published' && l.status !== 'active') return false;
-+++++        } else if (l.status !== status) {
-+++++          return false;
-+++++        }
-+++++      }
-+++++      return true;
-+++++    });
-+++++
-+++++    if (filtered.length === 0) {
-+++++      tbody.innerHTML = '';
-+++++      noResults?.classList.remove('hidden');
-+++++      return;
-+++++    }
-+++++
-+++++    noResults?.classList.add('hidden');

-+++++    const now = Date.now() / 1000;

-+++++        expired: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
-+++++        draft: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300',
-+++++      };

-+++++

-+++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">

-+++++            <div class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Created ${formatDate(listing.createdAt)}</div>
-+++++          </td>
-+++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">
-+++++            <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${colorClass}">${effectiveStatus || 'draft'}</span>
-+++++          </td>
-+++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">${listing.price || '-'}</td>
-+++++          <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
-+++++            <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
-+++++              <a href="/admin/listings/${listing.id}/edit" data-action="edit-listing" data-id="${listing.id}" class="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">Edit</a>
-+++++              <button data-action="toggle-status" data-id="${listing.id}" data-status="${effectiveStatus}" class="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">
-+++++                ${effectiveStatus === 'published' ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
-+++++              </button>
-+++++              <button data-action="delete-listing" data-id="${listing.id}" class="text-sm text-red-500 hover:underline">Delete</button>
-+++++              ${listing.slug ? `<a href="/listing/${listing.slug}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">View</a>` : ''}
-+++++            </div>
-+++++          </td>
-+++++        </tr>

-+++++  async function handleToggleStatus(id: string, currentStatus: string) {

-+++++        ${units.map(u => `<option value="${u.value}">${escapeHtml(u.label)}</option>`).join('')}
-+++++      </select>
-+++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-price-field" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 p-1">
-+++++        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
-+++++          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
-+++++        </svg>
-+++++      </button>
-+++++    </div>`;
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  function buildSpecFieldHtml(field: {key: string; type: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; options?: string[]}, value: string): string {
-+++++    const id = `spec-${field.key}`;
-+++++    const escapedValue = escapeHtml(Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(', ') : value);
-+++++    if (field.type === 'text') {
-+++++      return `<div>
-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
-+++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
-+++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
-+++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
-+++++      </div>`;
-+++++    }
-+++++    if (field.type === 'number') {
-+++++      return `<div>
-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
-+++++        <input type="number" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
-+++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
-+++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
-+++++      </div>`;
-+++++    }
-+++++    if (field.type === 'select') {
-+++++      return `<div>
-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
-+++++        <select id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm bg-background">
-+++++          <option value="">Select...</option>
-+++++          ${(field.options || []).map((opt: string) => `<option value="${opt}" ${value === opt ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(opt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + opt.slice(1).replace('_', ' '))}</option>`).join('')}
-+++++        </select>
-+++++      </div>`;
-+++++    }
-+++++    if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
-+++++      return `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
-+++++        <input type="checkbox" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="true" ${value ? 'checked' : ''} class="w-4 h-4" />
-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="text-sm">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
-+++++      </div>`;
-+++++    }
-+++++    if (field.type === 'tags') {
-+++++      return `<div>
-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
-+++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
-+++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : 'Comma separated values'}"
-+++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
-+++++        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Separate with commas</p>
-+++++      </div>`;
-+++++    }
-+++++    return '';
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  function buildSkuItemHtml(sku: any, priceDisplay: string, businessName: string): string {
-+++++    const typeClass = sku.productType === 'product'
-+++++      ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200'
-+++++      : 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200';
-+++++    const typeLabel = sku.productType || 'product';
-+++++    return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 md:p-3 border rounded text-sm hover:bg-muted/30">
-+++++      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
-+++++        <p class="font-medium truncate">${escapeHtml(sku.title || 'Untitled')}</p>
-+++++        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${escapeHtml(priceDisplay)} - ${escapeHtml(businessName)}</p>
-+++++      </div>
-+++++      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
-+++++        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${typeClass}">${typeLabel}</span>
-+++++        <button data-action="edit-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-primary hover:text-primary/80 text-xs px-2 py-1">Edit</button>
-+++++        <button data-action="delete-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 text-xs px-2 py-1">Del</button>
-+++++      </div>
-+++++    </div>`;
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  function buildMediaThumbnailHtml(mediaId: string, mediaUrl: string, isVideo: boolean): string {
-+++++    const mediaHtml = isVideo
-+++++      ? `<video src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" muted /><div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"><svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></div>`
-+++++      : `<img src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" />`;
-+++++    return `<div class="relative aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
-+++++      ${mediaHtml}
-+++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-media" data-media-id="${mediaId}" class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full text-xs">x</button>
-+++++    </div>`;
-+++++  }

-+++++  // EVENT DELEGATION
-+++++  // =============================================================================
-+++++  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
-+++++    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
-+++++    const actionEl = target.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
-+++++    if (!actionEl) return;
-+++++    const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
-+++++    if (!action) return;
-+++++    switch (action) {
-+++++      case 'remove-price-field':
-+++++        actionEl.closest('.price-field-row')?.remove();
-+++++        break;
-+++++      case 'remove-media': {
-+++++        const mediaId = actionEl.dataset.mediaId;
-+++++        if (mediaId) {
-+++++          skuMediaIds = skuMediaIds.filter(id => id !== mediaId);
-+++++          actionEl.closest('.relative.aspect-square')?.remove();
-+++++          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
-+++++        }
-+++++        break;
-+++++      }
-+++++      case 'edit-sku': {
-+++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
-+++++        if (id) editSKU(id);
-+++++        break;
-+++++      }
-+++++      case 'delete-sku': {
-+++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
-+++++        if (id) deleteSKU(id);
-+++++        break;
-+++++      }
-+++++    }
-+++++  });

-+++++  async function handleSkuImageUpload(files: FileList) {
-+++++    const preview = document.getElementById('sku-image-preview')!;
-+++++    const uploadArea = document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')!;
-+++++
-+++++    for (const file of files) {
-+++++      if (skuMediaIds.length >= 4) break;
-+++++
-+++++      const isImage = IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
-+++++      const isVideo = VIDEO_TYPES.includes(file.type);
-+++++      if (!isImage && !isVideo) continue;
-+++++
-+++++      if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
-+++++        alert(`Image too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 2MB`);
-+++++        continue;
-+++++      }
-+++++      if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
-+++++        alert(`Video too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 8MB`);
-+++++        continue;
-+++++      }
-+++++
-+++++      let fileToUpload = file;
-+++++
-+++++      if (isVideo) {
-+++++        const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
-+++++        statusDiv.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs rounded-lg z-10';
-+++++        statusDiv.textContent = 'Processing...';
-+++++        uploadArea.style.position = 'relative';
-+++++        uploadArea.appendChild(statusDiv);
-+++++
-+++++        try {
-+++++          const { compressVideo } = await import('@/lib/video-compress');
-+++++          const result = await compressVideo(file, {
-+++++            maxSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
-+++++            onProgress: (p: {message: string}) => { statusDiv.textContent = p.message; }
-+++++          });
-+++++
-+++++          if (!result.withinLimit) {
-+++++            alert('Video still too large after compression');
-+++++            statusDiv.remove();
-+++++            continue;
-+++++          }
-+++++          fileToUpload = result.file;
-+++++          statusDiv.textContent = 'Uploading...';
-+++++        } catch (err) {
-+++++          console.error('Video compression error:', err);
-+++++          statusDiv.remove();
-+++++          alert('Video processing failed');
-+++++          continue;
-+++++        }
-+++++      }
-+++++
-+++++      try {
-+++++        const result = await actions.media.uploadMedia({ file: fileToUpload, category: 'sku' });
-+++++        if (result.success && result.data?.id) {
-+++++          skuMediaIds.push(result.data.id);
-+++++          preview.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', buildMediaThumbnailHtml(result.data.id, result.data.url, isVideo));
-+++++          preview.classList.remove('hidden');
-+++++          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
-+++++        }
-+++++      } catch (err) {
-+++++        console.error('Upload error:', err);
-+++++      }
-+++++    }
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
-+++++    document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.click();
-+++++  });
-+++++  document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
-+++++    const files = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).files;
-+++++    if (files) handleSkuImageUpload(files);
-+++++    (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
-+++++  });

-+++++  async function initEditor(initialContent = '') {
-+++++    const loaded = await loadEditor();
-+++++    if (!loaded || !Editor) return null;
-+++++
-+++++    const element = document.querySelector('#tiptap-editor');
-+++++    if (!element) return null;
-+++++
-+++++    if (editor) editor.destroy();
-+++++
-+++++    editor = new Editor({
-+++++      element,
-+++++      extensions: [
-+++++        StarterKit,
-+++++        Underline,
-+++++        PlaceholderExt.configure({
-+++++          placeholder: (element as HTMLElement).dataset.placeholder || 'Start writing...',
-+++++        }),
-+++++      ],
-+++++      content: initialContent,
-+++++      immediatelyRender: false,
-+++++      onUpdate: ({ editor }) => {
-+++++        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
-+++++        if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = editor.getHTML();
-+++++      },
-+++++    });
-+++++
-+++++    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
-+++++    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = initialContent;
-+++++
-+++++    return editor;
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  function setupToolbar() {
-+++++    document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach(btn => {
-+++++      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
-+++++        if (!editor) return;
-+++++        const command = (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.command;
-+++++        const level = (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.level;
-+++++
-+++++        if (command === 'toggleHeading' && level) {
-+++++          editor.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: parseInt(level) }).run();
-+++++        } else if (command === 'undo') {
-+++++          editor.chain().focus().undo().run();
-+++++        } else if (command === 'redo') {
-+++++          editor.chain().focus().redo().run();
-+++++        } else if (command) {
-+++++          const cmd = (editor.chain().focus() as any)[command];
-+++++          if (typeof cmd?.run === 'function') cmd.run();
-+++++        }
-+++++      });
-+++++    });
-+++++  }

-+++++  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}) {
-+++++    return fetch(url, {
-+++++      ...options,
-+++++      credentials: 'include',
-+++++      headers: {
-+++++        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
-+++++        ...options.headers,
-+++++      },
-+++++    });
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  interface SkuWindow extends Window { allSkus?: any[] }
-+++++  (window as SkuWindow).allSkus = [];
-+++++
-+++++  async function loadSKUs() {
-+++++    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
-+++++    const businessFilter = document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement | null;
-+++++    if (!container) return;
-+++++
-+++++    if (businessFilter) {
-+++++      const opts = businessOptions.map((b: {value: string; label: string}) =>
-+++++        `<option value="${b.value}">${escapeHtml(b.label)}</option>`
-+++++      ).join('');
-+++++      businessFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Businesses</option>' + opts;
-+++++    }
-+++++
-+++++    try {
-+++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/skus');
-+++++      const data = await res.json();
-+++++      if (!data.success) {
-+++++        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Failed to load SKUs</p>';
-+++++        return;
-+++++      }
-+++++      (window as SkuWindow).allSkus = data.data || [];
-+++++      renderSkus();
-+++++    } catch (err) {
-+++++      console.error('Error loading SKUs:', err);
-+++++      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Error loading SKUs</p>';
-+++++    }
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  function renderSkus() {
-+++++    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
-+++++    const countEl = document.getElementById('skus-count');
-+++++    if (!container) return;
-+++++
-+++++    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
-+++++    const businessFilter = (document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
-+++++    const typeFilter = (document.getElementById('type-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
-+++++
-+++++    const bizMap = new Map(businessOptions.map((b: {value: string; label: string}) => [b.value, b.label]));
-+++++    const allSkus = (window as SkuWindow).allSkus || [];
-+++++
-+++++    const filtered = allSkus.filter((sku: any) => {
-+++++      const matchesSearch = !search || (sku.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search));
-+++++      const matchesBusiness = !businessFilter || sku.businessId === businessFilter;
-+++++      const matchesType = !typeFilter || sku.productType === typeFilter;
-+++++      return matchesSearch && matchesBusiness && matchesType;
-+++++    });
-+++++
-+++++    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} of ${allSkus.length} SKUs`;
-+++++
-+++++    if (filtered.length === 0) {
-+++++      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No SKUs found</p>';
-+++++      return;
-+++++    }
-+++++
-+++++    container.innerHTML = filtered.map((sku: any) => {
-+++++      let priceDisplay = 'Ask for price';
-+++++      try {
-+++++        const fields = sku.priceFields ? JSON.parse(sku.priceFields) : [];
-+++++        if (fields.length > 0 && fields[0].value) {
-+++++          const unit = fields[0].unit ? ` / ${fields[0].unit.replace('/', '')}` : '';
-+++++          priceDisplay = `$${fields[0].value}${unit}`;
-+++++        }
-+++++      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
-+++++      return buildSkuItemHtml(sku, priceDisplay, bizMap.get(sku.businessId) || 'Unknown');
-+++++    }).join('');
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  async function editSKU(id: string) {
-+++++    try {
-+++++      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`);
-+++++      const data = await res.json();
-+++++      if (!data.id) { alert('SKU not found'); return; }
-+++++
-+++++      editingId = id;
-+++++      document.getElementById('modal-title')!.textContent = 'Edit SKU';
-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = id;
-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-title') as HTMLInputElement).value = data.title || '';
-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-business') as HTMLSelectElement).value = data.businessId || '';
-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-service-type') as HTMLSelectElement).value = data.productType || 'product';
-+++++
-+++++      let priceFields: any[] = [];
-+++++      try { priceFields = data.priceFields ? JSON.parse(data.priceFields) : []; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
-+++++      renderPriceFields(data.productType || 'product', priceFields);
-+++++
-+++++      let specifications: Record<string, any> = {};
-+++++      try { specifications = data.specifications ? JSON.parse(data.specifications) : {}; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
-+++++
-+++++      initEditor(data.description || '');
-+++++      renderSpecificationFields(data.productType || 'product', specifications);
-+++++      openModal();
-+++++      setupToolbar();
-+++++    } catch (err) {
-+++++      console.error('Error loading SKU:', err);
-+++++      alert('Failed to load SKU');
-+++++    }
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  async function deleteSKU(id: string) {
-+++++    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this SKU?')) return;
-+++++    try {
-+++++      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
-+++++      if (res.ok) { loadSKUs(); } else { alert('Failed to delete SKU'); }
-+++++    } catch (err) { alert('Failed to delete SKU'); }
-+++++  }

-+++++    (document.getElementById('sku-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';

-+++++    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
-+++++    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = '';

-+++++  document.getElementById('sku-form')?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
-+++++    e.preventDefault();
-+++++    const formData = new FormData(e.target as HTMLFormElement);
-+++++
-+++++    const fieldCount = parseInt(document.getElementById('price-fields-container')!.dataset.fieldCount || '1');
-+++++    const priceFields: {label: any; value: any; unit: any}[] = [];
-+++++    for (let i = 0; i < fieldCount; i++) {
-+++++      const label = formData.get(`priceLabel_${i}`);
-+++++      const value = formData.get(`priceValue_${i}`);
-+++++      const unit = formData.get(`priceUnit_${i}`);
-+++++      if (label || value) priceFields.push({ label, value: value || '', unit: unit || '' });
-+++++    }
-+++++
-+++++    const productType = formData.get('productType');
-+++++    const specFields = productConfig.getSpecificationFields(productType as string) || [];
-+++++    const specifications: Record<string, any> = {};
-+++++    specFields.forEach((field: any) => {
-+++++      const key = `spec_${field.key}`;
-+++++      if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
-+++++        specifications[field.key] = formData.get(key) === 'true';
-+++++      } else if (field.type === 'tags') {
-+++++        const val = formData.get(key);
-+++++        specifications[field.key] = val ? (val as string).split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(v => v) : [];
-+++++      } else {
-+++++        const val = formData.get(key);
-+++++        if (val) specifications[field.key] = field.type === 'number' ? Number(val) : val;
-+++++      }
-+++++    });
-+++++
-+++++    const descriptionInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
-+++++    const description = descriptionInput?.value || '';
-+++++
-+++++    const skuData: Record<string, any> = {
-+++++      title: formData.get('title'),
-+++++      businessId: formData.get('businessId'),
-+++++      productType,
-+++++      priceFields: priceFields.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(priceFields) : null,
-+++++      specifications: Object.keys(specifications).length > 0 ? specifications : null,
-+++++      description,
-+++++      isAdmin: true,
-+++++    };
-+++++
-+++++    if (!skuData.businessId) { alert('Please select a business'); return; }

-+++++  async function savePlan(formData: FormData) {
-+++++    const mode = formData.get('mode') as string;
-+++++    const id = formData.get('id') as string;
-+++++    const featuresText = formData.get('features') as string;
-+++++    const features = featuresText.split('\n').filter(f => f.trim());
-+++++
-+++++    const variant = {
-+++++      name: formData.get('name') as string,
-+++++      price: parseFloat(formData.get('amount') as string) || 0,
-+++++      currency: 'USD',
-+++++      durationValue: 1,
-+++++      durationUnit: 'month',
-+++++      limits: {
-+++++        skuLimit: parseInt(formData.get('skuLimit') as string) || 0,
-+++++        maxImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxImages') as string) || 0,
-+++++        maxVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxVideos') as string) || 0,
-+++++        maxBusinessImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessImages') as string) || 0,
-+++++        maxBusinessVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessVideos') as string) || 0,
-+++++      },
-+++++      features: features,
-+++++    };
-+++++
-+++++    try {
-+++++      let result;
-+++++      if (mode === 'edit' && id) {
-+++++        const existingPkg = packages.find(p => p.id === id);

-+++++
-+++++        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.update({
-+++++          id,

-+++++          description: formData.get('description') as string,

-+++++          isActive: formData.get('active') === 'on',

-+++++        });

-+++++        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.create({
-+++++          name: formData.get('name') as string,
-+++++          serviceType: (formData.get('serviceType') as 'subscription' | 'listing_renewal' | 'ad_banner') || 'subscription',
-+++++          serviceRelationTo: serviceRelationTo as 'business' | 'listing' | 'ad_banner',
-+++++          description: formData.get('description') as string || '',
-+++++          variants: [variant],
-+++++          isActive: formData.get('active') === 'on',
-+++++          sortOrder: parseInt(formData.get('sortOrder') as string) || 0,
-+++++        });
-+++++      }
-+++++
-+++++      if (result.success) {
-+++++        closeModal();
-+++++        toast.success(mode === 'edit' ? 'Plan updated' : 'Plan created');
-+++++        window.location.reload();

-+++++// Flue AI Generation - Direct API calls (no Mastra dependency)
-+++++// MiniMax M2.7 does not match Pi model catalog, so we call the API directly.
-+++++import { getMinimaxApiKey } from '@/lib/env';
-+++++import {
-+++++  ListingDataSchema,
-+++++  SkuDataSchema,
-+++++  BlogDataSchema,
-+++++  LandingDataSchema,
-+++++  type ListingOutput,
-+++++  type SkuOutput,
-+++++  type BlogOutput,
-+++++  type LandingOutput,
-+++++} from '@/lib/ai/valibot-schemas';
-+++++import { LISTING_INSTRUCTIONS, SKU_INSTRUCTIONS, BLOG_INSTRUCTIONS, LANDING_INSTRUCTIONS } from '@/lib/ai/validation';
-+++++
-+++++const API_BASE = 'https://api.minimax.chat/v1';
-+++++
-+++++interface GenerateOptions {
-+++++  systemPrompt: string;
-+++++  userMessage: string;
-+++++  schema: unknown; // Valibot schema
-+++++}
-+++++
-+++++export async function generateWithMinimax(options: GenerateOptions): Promise<unknown> {
-+++++  const apiKey = getMinimaxApiKey();
-+++++  if (!apiKey) {
-+++++    throw new Error('MINIMAX_API_KEY is not configured');
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/text/chatcompletion_v2`, {
-+++++    method: 'POST',
-+++++    headers: {
-+++++      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
-+++++      'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
-+++++    },
-+++++    body: JSON.stringify({
-+++++      model: 'MiniMax-M2.7',
-+++++      messages: [
-+++++        { role: 'system', content: options.systemPrompt },
-+++++        { role: 'user', content: options.userMessage },
-+++++      ],
-+++++      resp_format: { type: 'json_object' },
-+++++    }),
-+++++  });
-+++++
-+++++  if (!response.ok) {
-+++++    const errText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
-+++++    throw new Error(`MiniMax API error ${response.status}: ${errText}`);
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  const json = await response.json() as { choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[] };
-+++++  const content = json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
-+++++
-+++++  if (!content) {
-+++++    throw new Error('Empty response from MiniMax API');
-+++++  }
-+++++
-+++++  return JSON.parse(content);
-+++++}
-+++++

-+++++function buildListingMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
-+++++  const title = String(data.title ?? '');
-+++++  const entityType = String(data.entityType ?? 'business');
-+++++  const contactName = String(data.contactName ?? '');
-+++++  const phone = String(data.phone ?? '');
-+++++  const email = String(data.email ?? '');
-+++++  const address = String(data.address ?? '');
-+++++  const about = String(data.about ?? '');
-+++++  const tags = Array.isArray(data.tags) ? data.tags : String(data.tags ?? '').split(',');
-+++++  return `Create a listing for "${title}" (${entityType}).
-+++++Contact: ${contactName || 'N/A'}
-+++++Phone: ${phone || 'N/A'}
-+++++Email: ${email || 'N/A'}
-+++++Address: ${address || 'N/A'}
-+++++About: ${about || 'N/A'}
-+++++Tags: ${Array.isArray(tags) ? tags.join(', ') : tags || 'N/A'}`;

-+++++
-+++++function buildSkuMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
-+++++  const skuTitle = String(data.title ?? '');
-+++++  const skuDesc = String(data.description ?? '');
-+++++  const priceVal = String(data.priceValue ?? 'N/A');
-+++++  const priceFields = Array.isArray(data.priceFields) ? data.priceFields : [];

-+++++    ? priceFields.map((p: { label: string; value: string; unit?: string }) =>
-+++++        `${p.label}: ${p.value} ${p.unit || ''}`).join(', ')
-+++++    : `Price: ${priceVal}`;
-+++++  return `Create a ${data.productType || 'product'} called "${skuTitle}".
-+++++Description: ${skuDesc}
-+++++${priceInfo}`;
-+++++}

-++++  async function handleSkuImageUpload(files: FileList) {
-++++    const preview = document.getElementById('sku-image-preview')!;
-++++    const uploadArea = document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')!;
-++++
-++++    for (const file of files) {
-++++      if (skuMediaIds.length >= 4) break;
-++++
-++++      const isImage = IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
-++++      const isVideo = VIDEO_TYPES.includes(file.type);
-++++      if (!isImage && !isVideo) continue;
-++++
-++++      if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
-++++        alert(`Image too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 2MB`);
-++++        continue;
-++++      }
-++++      if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
-++++        alert(`Video too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 8MB`);
-++++        continue;
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      let fileToUpload = file;
-++++
-++++      if (isVideo) {
-++++        const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
-++++        statusDiv.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs rounded-lg z-10';
-++++        statusDiv.textContent = 'Processing...';
-++++        uploadArea.style.position = 'relative';
-++++        uploadArea.appendChild(statusDiv);
-++++
-++++        try {
-++++          const { compressVideo } = await import('@/lib/video-compress');
-++++          const result = await compressVideo(file, {
-++++            maxSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
-++++            onProgress: (p: {message: string}) => { statusDiv.textContent = p.message; }
-++++          });
-++++
-++++          if (!result.withinLimit) {
-++++            alert('Video still too large after compression');
-++++            statusDiv.remove();
-++++            continue;
-++++          }
-++++          fileToUpload = result.file;
-++++          statusDiv.textContent = 'Uploading...';
-++++        } catch (err) {
-++++          console.error('Video compression error:', err);
-++++          statusDiv.remove();
-++++          alert('Video processing failed');
-++++          continue;
-++++        }
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      try {
-++++        const result = await actions.media.uploadMedia({ file: fileToUpload, category: 'sku' });

-++++          skuMediaIds.push(result.data.id);

-++++    function getVerticalPlacement(options: {
-++++      preferredSide: ColorPickerFloatingSide;
-++++      align: FloatingAlign;
-++++      sideOffset: number;
-++++      triggerRect: DOMRect;
-++++      contentWidth: number;
-++++      contentHeight: number;
-++++      viewportWidth: number;
-++++      viewportHeight: number;
-++++      viewportPadding: number;
-++++      avoidCollisions?: boolean;
-++++    }): ColorPickerPlacement {
-++++      const {
-++++        preferredSide,
-++++        align,
-++++        sideOffset,
-++++        triggerRect,
-++++        contentWidth,
-++++        contentHeight,
-++++        viewportWidth,
-++++        viewportHeight,
-++++        viewportPadding,
-++++        avoidCollisions = true,
-++++      } = options;
-++++      const oppositeSide = preferredSide === "bottom" ? "top" : "bottom";
-++++      const getTop = (placementSide: ColorPickerFloatingSide) =>
-++++        placementSide === "bottom"
-++++          ? triggerRect.bottom + sideOffset
-++++          : triggerRect.top - contentHeight - sideOffset;
-++++      const getLeft = () => {
-++++        if (align === "end") {
-++++          return triggerRect.right - contentWidth;
-++++        }
-++++
-++++        if (align === "center") {
-++++          return triggerRect.left + (triggerRect.width - contentWidth) / 2;
-++++        }
-++++
-++++        return triggerRect.left;
-++++      };
-++++
-++++      if (!avoidCollisions) {
-++++        return {
-++++          side: preferredSide,
-++++          align,
-++++          top: getTop(preferredSide),
-++++          left: getLeft(),
-++++        };
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      const preferredTop = getTop(preferredSide);
-++++      const oppositeTop = getTop(oppositeSide);
-++++      const preferredFits =
-++++        preferredTop >= viewportPadding &&
-++++        preferredTop + contentHeight <= viewportHeight - viewportPadding;
-++++      const oppositeFits =
-++++        oppositeTop >= viewportPadding &&
-++++        oppositeTop + contentHeight <= viewportHeight - viewportPadding;
-++++      const spaceBelow = viewportHeight - triggerRect.bottom - sideOffset - viewportPadding;
-++++      const spaceAbove = triggerRect.top - sideOffset - viewportPadding;
-++++      const resolvedSide: ColorPickerFloatingSide = preferredFits
-++++        ? preferredSide
-++++        : oppositeFits
-++++          ? oppositeSide
-++++          : spaceBelow >= spaceAbove
-++++            ? "bottom"
-++++            : "top";
-++++
-++++      return {
-++++        side: resolvedSide,
-++++        align,
-++++        top: clampPosition(
-++++          getTop(resolvedSide),
-++++          viewportPadding,
-++++          viewportHeight - contentHeight - viewportPadding,
-++++        ),
-++++        left: clampPosition(
-++++          getLeft(),
-++++          viewportPadding,
-++++          viewportWidth - contentWidth - viewportPadding,
-++++        ),
-++++      };
-++++    }

-++++    private setActiveItem(item: HTMLElement | null) {
-++++      if (!this.content) return;
-++++
-++++      // Remove active state from previous item

-++++        this.activeItem.removeAttribute("data-active");

-++++    private findNavigableItem(
-++++      items: NodeListOf<Element>,
-++++      startIndex: number,
-++++      direction: "forward" | "backward",
-++++    ): HTMLElement | null {
-++++      const step = direction === "forward" ? 1 : -1;
-++++      const end = direction === "forward" ? items.length : -1;
-++++
-++++      for (let i = startIndex; i !== end; i += step) {
-++++        const item = items[i] as HTMLElement;
-++++        if (
-++++          item.getAttribute("data-disabled") !== "true" &&
-++++          item.getAttribute("data-filtered") !== "true"
-++++        ) {
-++++          return item;
-++++        }
-++++      }
-++++      return null;
-++++    }

-++++    private handleNavigationKeys(e: KeyboardEvent) {
-++++      if (!this.content) return;
-++++      const items = this.content.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]');
-++++      const currentIndex = Array.from(items).indexOf(this.activeItem as HTMLElement);
-++++
-++++      let targetItem: HTMLElement | null = null;
-++++
-++++      switch (e.key) {
-++++        case "Home":
-++++          targetItem = this.findNavigableItem(items, 0, "forward");
-++++          break;
-++++
-++++        case "End":
-++++          targetItem = this.findNavigableItem(items, items.length - 1, "backward");
-++++          break;
-++++
-++++        case "ArrowUp":
-++++          if (currentIndex > 0) {
-++++            targetItem = this.findNavigableItem(items, currentIndex - 1, "backward");
-++++          }
-++++          break;
-++++
-++++        case "ArrowDown":
-++++          if (currentIndex < items.length - 1) {
-++++            targetItem = this.findNavigableItem(items, currentIndex + 1, "forward");
-++++          }
-++++          break;
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      if (targetItem) {
-++++        this.setActiveItem(targetItem);
-++++      }
-++++    }

-++++    private setupSearchInput() {
-++++      if (!this.searchInput || !this.content) return;

-++++          }
-++++        }
-++++        // Prevent space from scrolling the page, but allow it to be typed

-++++          e.stopPropagation();

-++++      });
-++++    }

-++++    private filterItems(searchValue: string) {
-++++      if (!this.content) return;
-++++
-++++      const items = this.content.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]');
-++++      let visibleCount = 0;
-++++      let firstVisibleItem: HTMLElement | null = null;
-++++
-++++      items.forEach((item) => {
-++++        const itemText = item.textContent?.toLowerCase().trim() || "";
-++++        const matches = itemText.includes(searchValue);
-++++
-++++        if (matches || searchValue === "") {
-++++          item.classList.remove("starwind-sr-only");
-++++          item.removeAttribute("data-filtered");
-++++          visibleCount++;
-++++          if (!firstVisibleItem) {
-++++            firstVisibleItem = item as HTMLElement;
-++++          }
-++++        } else {
-++++          item.classList.add("starwind-sr-only");
-++++          item.setAttribute("data-filtered", "true");
-++++        }
-++++      });
-++++
-++++      // Update active item to first visible item after filtering
-++++      if (this.searchInput && firstVisibleItem) {
-++++        this.setActiveItem(firstVisibleItem);
-++++      } else if (this.searchInput && visibleCount === 0) {
-++++        this.setActiveItem(null);
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      // Show/hide empty message
-++++      if (this.emptyElement) {
-++++        if (visibleCount === 0 && searchValue !== "") {
-++++          this.emptyElement.classList.remove("hidden");
-++++        } else {
-++++          this.emptyElement.classList.add("hidden");
-++++        }
-++++      }
-++++    }

-++++    private handleTypeahead(key: string) {
-++++      if (!this.content) return;

-++++      const items = this.content.querySelectorAll('[role="option"]');

-++++      // find and set active the first matching option

-++++        item.textContent?.toLowerCase().trim().startsWith(search.toLowerCase()),
-++++      ) as HTMLElement[];

-++++        this.setActiveItem(matches[0]);

-++++      // update the typeahead search and reset the timer

-++++      if (this.typeaheadTimerRef) {
-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.typeaheadTimerRef);
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      // set a timer to clear the search after 1 second

-++++        this.typeaheadSearch = "";

-++++        }

-++++        const focusOnTouch =
-++++          this.searchInput?.getAttribute("data-focus-on-touch-devices") === "true";
-++++        if (!isTouchDevice || focusOnTouch) {

-++++        // set active on the current selected item

-++++          this.setActiveItem(this.selectedItem);

-++++          // if no item is selected, set active on the first item

-++++          if (firstItem) {
-++++            this.setActiveItem(firstItem);
-++++          }
-++++        }
-++++      }
-++++    }

-++++    private closeSelect() {
-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
-++++
-++++      this.isOpen = false;
-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
-++++
-++++      // Remove focus from any currently focused element

-++++      if (activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) {
-++++        activeElement.blur();

-++++      // Set focus on trigger if returnFocusOnClose is true
-++++      if (this.returnFocusOnClose) {

-++++      // give the content time to animate before hiding

-++++        // Clear search and show all items after animation completes
-++++        if (this.searchInput) {
-++++          this.searchInput.value = "";
-++++          this.filterItems("");
-++++          this.setActiveItem(null);
-++++        }

-++++      this.trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

-++++    private handleSelection(item: HTMLElement) {
-++++      if (!this.trigger) return;
-++++
-++++      // Clear any validation error when a selection is made
-++++      this.clearValidationError();

-++++      // update the hidden select field

-++++      if (selectField) {
-++++        const newValue = item.getAttribute("data-value") || "";
-++++        selectField.value = newValue;
-++++
-++++        // Dispatch custom event with the new value
-++++        const event = new CustomEvent<SelectChangeEvent["detail"]>("starwind-select:change", {
-++++          detail: { value: newValue, selectId: this.select.id, label: item.textContent || "" },
-++++          bubbles: true,
-++++          cancelable: true,
-++++        });
-++++
-++++        selectField.dispatchEvent(event);
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      // Update trigger content
-++++      const triggerSpan = this.trigger.firstElementChild as HTMLSpanElement;
-++++      if (triggerSpan) {
-++++        triggerSpan.textContent = item.textContent;
-++++      }
-++++
-++++      // Update selected states after select finishes closing
-++++      setTimeout(() => {
-++++        if (this.selectedItem) {
-++++          this.selectedItem.setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
-++++        }
-++++        item.setAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
-++++        this.selectedItem = item;
-++++      }, this.animationDuration);
-++++
-++++      // Close the select
-++++      this.closeSelect();
-++++    }

-++++    /**
-++++     * Sets the initial state based on the default value attribute
-++++     */
-++++    private setInitialState(): void {
-++++      const defaultValue = this.select.dataset.value;

-++++        const item = this.content?.querySelector(`[data-value="${defaultValue}"]`);
-++++
-++++        if (item && item instanceof HTMLElement) {
-++++          this.returnFocusOnClose = false;
-++++          this.handleSelection(item);
-++++          this.selectedItem = item;
-++++        }
-++++      }

-++++    /**
-++++     * Programmatically selects an option by value
-++++     */
-++++    private programmaticallySelect(value: string): void {

-++++/**
-++++ * Starwind Toast API
-++++ *
-++++ * A simple, framework-agnostic toast notification system.
-++++ *
-++++ * @example
-++++ * ```ts
-++++ * import { toast } from "@/components/starwind/toast";
-++++ *
-++++ * // Simple usage
-++++ * toast("Hello world");
-++++ * toast({ title: "Success", description: "Item saved" });
-++++ *
-++++ * // Variant shortcuts
-++++ * toast.success("Saved successfully");
-++++ * toast.error("Something went wrong");
-++++ * toast.warning("Please check your input");
-++++ * toast.info("New update available");
-++++ * toast.loading("Processing...");
-++++ *
-++++ * // Promise handling
-++++ * toast.promise(saveData(), {
-++++ *   loading: "Saving...",
-++++ *   success: "Saved!",
-++++ *   error: "Failed to save",
-++++ * });
-++++ *
-++++ * // Management
-++++ * const id = toast("Processing...");
-++++ * toast.update(id, { title: "Almost done..." });
-++++ * toast.dismiss(id);
-++++ * toast.dismiss(); // dismiss all
-++++ * ```

+-++# Implementation Plan: Admin Security + Island Migration
+-++
+-++## Architecture Decisions
+-++
+-++### AD-001: DOMPurify over safe DOM API for XSS Fixes
+-++- **Decision**: Use DOMPurify for complex HTML generation (charts, product cards), safe DOM API for simple cases
+-++- **Why**: Chart HTML is template-string-based; DOMPurify is the minimal-change fix
+-++- **Alternatives considered**: Full safe DOM API rewrite (too large, high risk)
+-++
+-++### AD-002: Island Pattern for Dashboard
+-++- **Decision**: Follow `ServicePackagesIsland.astro` pattern — server data via `set:html` JSON script tag, client uses `JSON.parse` + safe DOM API
+-++- **Why**: Zero innerHTML, type-safe data flow, consistent with codebase patterns
+-++
+-++### AD-003: Re-export over Deletion for Legacy Components
+-++- **Decision**: Convert legacy PascalCase files to thin re-exports
+-++- **Why**: Prevents breaking unknown import sites without doing a full grep audit
+-++
+-++## Components
+-++
+-++- `DashboardIsland.astro` (NEW): Admin dashboard island — stats cards, revenue chart, subscription list
+-++- `pages/admin/index.astro` (MOD): Becomes island shell — server data fetch, island reference
+-++- `pages/business/[slug]/products.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to product card innerHTML
+-++- `pages/business/[slug]/edit/index.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to gallery preview
+-++- `src/components/ui/*.astro` (MOD): 11 re-export files → thin wrappers
+-++
+-++## DOMPurify Pattern
+-++
+-++```typescript
+-++// In <script> block of affected files
+-++import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
+-++const sanitize = (html: string) => DOMPurify.sanitize(html, { USE_PROFILES: { html: true } });
+-++
+-++// Before any innerHTML assignment
+-++chartEl.innerHTML = sanitize(chartHTML);
+-++cardEl.innerHTML = sanitize(cardHTML);
+-++```
+-++
+-++## Testing Strategy
+-++
+-++- Build verification: `pnpm build` exit 0
+-++- E2E regression: `pnpm test:e2e`
+-++- Manual XSS test: inject `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` in product title → verify not executed

+-++# Plan: Fulldev + Starwind Migration
+-++
+-++## Overview
+-++
+-++通过3 个维度重构，实现 Astro 原生组件最大化复用 + UI/UX 与业务代码完全分离：
+-++
+-++1. **Starwind 安装** — 补充 fulldev 缺失的 10 个差异化组件
+-++2. **Block 替换** — 营销页从手写 HTML → Fulldev Block（改数据不改模板）
+-++3. **架构分离** — slug 页面 DB逻辑 → lib/queries，admin 页面 inline script → island
+-++
+-++## Architecture
+-++
+-++### Target Component Structure
+-++```
+-++src/
+-++├── components/
+-++│   ├── ui/ ← Fulldev 组件（54 dirs, source-owned）
+-++│   │   ├── button/, card/, dialog/, ...
+-++│   │   └── blocks/ ← Fulldev Blocks（新增）
+-++│   ├── starwind/              ← Starwind 组件（新增，10 个差异化组件）
+-++│   ├── islands/               ← 交互组件（已有13 个 + 新增 4 个）
+-++│   │   └── admin/ ← Admin islands
+-++│   ├── business/              ← 业务卡片（保留）
+-++│   └── forms/                  ← 表单组件（保留）
+-++├── lib/
+-++│   └── db/
+-++│       └── queries/           ← 业务查询函数（新增 6 个）
+-++│           ├── getBusinessBySlug.ts
+-++│           ├── getListingBySlug.ts
+-++│           ├── getNonProfitBySlug.ts
+-++│           ├── getPublicSectorBySlug.ts
+-++│           ├── getBlogPostBySlug.ts
+-++│           └── getEntityBySlug.ts  ← 非营利/公共部门共用
+-++└── pages/
+-++    ├── index.astro            ← Block替换（~116行 → ~60行）
+-++    ├── business/[slug].astro ← 查询分离（~593行 → ~200行）
+-++    ├── admin/
+-++    │   ├── login.astro        ← Island 迁移
+-++    │   ├── media.astro ← Island 迁移
+-++    │   └── ai-tools.astro ← Island 迁移
+-++    └── ...
+-++```
+-++
+-++### Data Flow: Before vs After
+-++
+-++**Before**（slug页面）：
+-++```
+-++Astro frontmatter:
+-++  await getDb()         ← DB 连接
+-++  db.select(...) ← 查询
+-++  .map(...).filter(...) ← 数据转换
+-++  { business, products } ← 组装数据
+-++  return Astro.redirect ← 重定向
+-++---
+-++HTML template (300+ lines, inline styles, hardcoded grid)
+-++```
+-++
+-++**After**（slug 页面）：
+-++```
+-++Astro frontmatter:
+-++  import { getBusinessBySlug } from "@/lib/db/queries"
+-++  const { business, products } = await getBusinessBySlug(slug)
+-++  if (!business) return Astro.redirect("/404")
+-++---
+-++HTML template: 纯 import fulldev/starwind 组件 + 数据注入
+-++```
+-++
+-++**Before**（admin 页面）：
+-++```
+-++Astro frontmatter: fetch data
+-++HTML template: inline<script> with innerHTML, classList manipulation
+-++```
+-++
+-++**After**（admin 页面）：
+-++```
+-++Astro frontmatter: fetch data, pass as props to Island
+-++HTML template: <XxxIsland data={...} />
+-++Island script: textContent/classList/value (no innerHTML)
+-++```
+-++
+-++## Technical Decisions
+-++
+-++### ADR-1: Query Function Granularity
+-++**Decision**: 每个 slug 页面对应一个 query 文件，`non-profit` 和 `public-sector` 共用一个 `getEntityBySlug`（两者 schema 几乎相同）
+-++**Rationale**: 避免过度抽象。先按页面分离，后续发现共性再提取。
+-++**Risk**: 6 个新文件 = 维护负担。Mitigation：这些函数可以被 E2E 测试覆盖。
+-++
+-++### ADR-2: Starwind Component Selection
+-++**Decision**: 安装 10 个 fulldev 没有的组件：toast, dropzone, pagination, progress, color-picker, scroll-area, hover-card, context-menu, image, item
+-++**Rationale**: 这 10 个是项目目前用 Tailwind 硬拼的组件，也是 fulldev 明确缺失的。
+-++**Not installing**: button, card, dialog, sidebar 等（与 fulldev 重叠，安装了是浪费且增加维护成本）
+-++
+-++### ADR-3: Block vs Atomic Component for Marketing Pages
+-++**Decision**: 优先用 Block（数据驱动的整页模板），而非原子组件拼接
+-++**Rationale**: Block = 改 props 数据不改模板，AI 开发效率最高。手写 grid + h1+h2 每次改版要动多个文件。
+-++**Risk**: Block 源码量大（单个 Hero block ~200行）。Mitigation：source 文件归你，修改前先 git commit。
+-++
+-++### ADR-4: Island Migration Priority
+-++**Decision**: 先迁移 inline script 最严重的3 个页面（ai-tools 927行、login 188行、media 303行）
+-++**Rationale**: 这些页面的 inline script 是最大的 XSS 风险源和代码复杂度来源。
+-++**Not migrating**: admin/index（已迁移），其他 admin页面（已有 islands）
+-++
+-++## Risks & Mitigations
+-++
+-++| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
+-++|---|---|---|
+-++| Block 升级覆盖本地修改 | Medium | 升级前 git commit，每次只升级一个组件 |
+-++| query 函数与页面逻辑不一致 | High | 每个 query 函数配套 E2E 测试（Given page loads → data correct）|
+-++| Starwind 动效与现有 CSS 变量冲突 | Low | `starwind.config.json` 的 theme 配置独立，不改 `globals.css` 已有变量 |
+-++| 删除 PascalCase 文件导致断链 import | High | 先 grep 全部引用，批量替换后再删除 |
+-++| Slug 页面重构引入 regression | High | `sw:grill` 验证 + E2E smoke test |
+-++| Block 源码不适合当前设计 | Medium | 先用 `--dry-run` 查看 Block 效果，不满意不安装 |
+-++
+-++## Testing Strategy
+-++
+-++1. **US-003 query 函数**：每个 query 函数一个集成测试（mock DB，返回预期数据 shape）
+-++2. **US-004 island**：Given admin page loads → Then island renders with correct data, no innerHTML
+-++3. **US-007验证**：全量 `astro build` + `playwright test`
+-++
+-++## Implementation Phases
+-++
+-++### Phase 1: Setup（US-001）
+-++- `npx starwind@latest init`
+-++- `npx starwind@latest add` 10 个组件
+-++
+-++### Phase 2: Block + Query（US-002, US-003）
+-++- 营销页 → Block（5 个页面）
+-++- Slug 页面查询分离（5+1 个 query 文件）
+-++
+-++### Phase 3: Island（US-004）
+-++- 4 个 admin 页面 → island
+-++
+-++### Phase 4: Cleanup（US-005, US-006）
+-++- 删除 PascalCase 文件 + components.json
+-++- Starwind 组件集成到页面
+-++

+-++# Feature: Fulldev + Starwind Migration
+-++
+-++## Context
+-++
+-++**项目现状（2026-06-07 评估数据）：**
+-++- 58 个页面，23 个页面 frontmatter >20 行（混合架构）
+-++- 5 个 slug 详情页包含 DB 查询 + 数据转换 + HTML 模板，全部混在一个文件
+-++- `business/[slug].astro` 单独 593 行（183 行 frontmatter）
+-++- 54 个 Fulldev 组件目录（8577 行）已安装在 `src/components/ui/`
+-++- **Starwind 未安装**（缺失 Toast/Dropzone/Pagination 等 10 个差异化组件）
+-++- Fulldev Blocks 使用率：**0 / 82**（营销页全靠手写 HTML）
+-++- 3 个 Admin 页面（ai-tools 927行、login 188行、media 303行）仍用 inline script，未 island化
+-++- 24 个 PascalCase re-export 文件需要删除
+-++- `components.json` 存在（shadcn CLI 配置）
+-++
+-++**迁移目标：**
+-++-组件复用最大化：Starwind 补充 fulldev 缺失的 10 个组件
+-++- UI/UX 分离：业务逻辑 → lib/queries，数据获取 → page frontmatter，UI → fulldev/starwind
+-++- 代码量降低：Block 替代手写 HTML，island 替代 inline script
+-++- AI 开发效率提升：组件 = 改数据不改模板，业务逻辑可被 AI 独立处理
+-++
+-++---
+-++
+-++## User Stories
+-++

+-++### US-008: Design System Consistency (P0)
+-++**Project**: timorup
+-++
+-++**As a** developer
+-++**I want** fulldev + starwind 组件共存时风格完全一致
+-++**So that** 用户体验无割裂感
+-++
+-++**Context**:
+-++- fulldev (`cva`) + starwind (`tv`) 共用 `--color-*` design tokens（通过 `globals.css` 别名映射）
+-++- 两者均生成原子化 Tailwind 类名，无独立 CSS 类冲突
+-++- **风险点**：同名组件 variant 值不同（fulldev `default` = starwind `primary`），禁止混用
+-++
+-++**Acceptance Criteria**:
+-++- [ ] **AC-US8-01**: 页面级组件只使用一个库的 Button/Dropdown/Select，禁止同一页面同时 import 两个库的同名组件
+-++- [ ] **AC-US8-02**: fulldev button 作为 primary choice；starwind 仅用于差异化组件（Toast/Pagination/Progress/Dropzone/Scroll-Area/Hover-Card/Context-Menu/Image/Item）
+-++- [ ] **AC-US8-03**: `globals.css` 中 `--starwind-*` 别名全部指向 `--color-*`（已满足，无需修改）
+-++- [ ] **AC-US8-04**: 页面代码审查时检测同一文件中同时 import fulldev + starwind 同名组件的情况
+-++
+-++---

+-++- 不修改 fulldev source 文件
+-++- 不修改 `lib/utils.ts` 的 `cn()` 函数

+-+++# Implementation Plan: Admin Security + Island Migration
+-+++
+-+++## Architecture Decisions
+-+++
+-+++### AD-001: DOMPurify over safe DOM API for XSS Fixes
+-+++- **Decision**: Use DOMPurify for complex HTML generation (charts, product cards), safe DOM API for simple cases
+-+++- **Why**: Chart HTML is template-string-based; DOMPurify is the minimal-change fix
+-+++- **Alternatives considered**: Full safe DOM API rewrite (too large, high risk)
+-+++
+-+++### AD-002: Island Pattern for Dashboard
+-+++- **Decision**: Follow `ServicePackagesIsland.astro` pattern — server data via `set:html` JSON script tag, client uses `JSON.parse` + safe DOM API
+-+++- **Why**: Zero innerHTML, type-safe data flow, consistent with codebase patterns
+-+++
+-+++### AD-003: Re-export over Deletion for Legacy Components
+-+++- **Decision**: Convert legacy PascalCase files to thin re-exports
+-+++- **Why**: Prevents breaking unknown import sites without doing a full grep audit
+-+++
+-+++## Components
+-+++
+-+++- `DashboardIsland.astro` (NEW): Admin dashboard island — stats cards, revenue chart, subscription list
+-+++- `pages/admin/index.astro` (MOD): Becomes island shell — server data fetch, island reference
+-+++- `pages/business/[slug]/products.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to product card innerHTML
+-+++- `pages/business/[slug]/edit/index.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to gallery preview
+-+++- `src/components/ui/*.astro` (MOD): 11 re-export files → thin wrappers
+-+++
+-+++## DOMPurify Pattern
+-+++
+-+++```typescript
+-+++// In <script> block of affected files
+-+++import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
+-+++const sanitize = (html: string) => DOMPurify.sanitize(html, { USE_PROFILES: { html: true } });
+-+++
+-+++// Before any innerHTML assignment
+-+++chartEl.innerHTML = sanitize(chartHTML);
+-+++cardEl.innerHTML = sanitize(cardHTML);
+-+++```
+-+++
+-+++## Testing Strategy
+-+++
+-+++- Build verification: `pnpm build` exit 0
+-+++- E2E regression: `pnpm test:e2e`
+-+++- Manual XSS test: inject `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` in product title → verify not executed
+-++\ No newline at end of file

+-+++# Plan: Fulldev + Starwind Migration
+-+++
+-+++## Overview
+-+++
+-+++通过3 个维度重构，实现 Astro 原生组件最大化复用 + UI/UX 与业务代码完全分离：
+-+++
+-+++1. **Starwind 安装** — 补充 fulldev 缺失的 10 个差异化组件
+-+++2. **Block 替换** — 营销页从手写 HTML → Fulldev Block（改数据不改模板）
+-+++3. **架构分离** — slug 页面 DB逻辑 → lib/queries，admin 页面 inline script → island
+-+++
+-+++## Architecture
+-+++
+-+++### Target Component Structure
+-+++```
+-+++src/
+-+++├── components/
+-+++│   ├── ui/ ← Fulldev 组件（54 dirs, source-owned）
+-+++│   │   ├── button/, card/, dialog/, ...
+-+++│   │   └── blocks/ ← Fulldev Blocks（新增）
+-+++│   ├── starwind/              ← Starwind 组件（新增，10 个差异化组件）
+-+++│   ├── islands/               ← 交互组件（已有13 个 + 新增 4 个）
+-+++│   │   └── admin/ ← Admin islands
+-+++│   ├── business/              ← 业务卡片（保留）
+-+++│   └── forms/                  ← 表单组件（保留）
+-+++├── lib/
+-+++│   └── db/
+-+++│       └── queries/           ← 业务查询函数（新增 6 个）
+-+++│           ├── getBusinessBySlug.ts
+-+++│           ├── getListingBySlug.ts
+-+++│           ├── getNonProfitBySlug.ts
+-+++│           ├── getPublicSectorBySlug.ts
+-+++│           ├── getBlogPostBySlug.ts
+-+++│           └── getEntityBySlug.ts  ← 非营利/公共部门共用
+-+++└── pages/
+-+++    ├── index.astro            ← Block替换（~116行 → ~60行）
+-+++    ├── business/[slug].astro ← 查询分离（~593行 → ~200行）
+-+++    ├── admin/
+-+++    │   ├── login.astro        ← Island 迁移
+-+++    │   ├── media.astro ← Island 迁移
+-+++    │   └── ai-tools.astro ← Island 迁移
+-+++    └── ...
+-+++```
+-+++
+-+++### Data Flow: Before vs After
+-+++
+-+++**Before**（slug页面）：
+-+++```
+-+++Astro frontmatter:
+-+++  await getDb()         ← DB 连接
+-+++  db.select(...) ← 查询
+-+++  .map(...).filter(...) ← 数据转换
+-+++  { business, products } ← 组装数据
+-+++  return Astro.redirect ← 重定向
+-+++---
+-+++HTML template (300+ lines, inline styles, hardcoded grid)
+-+++```
+-+++
+-+++**After**（slug 页面）：
+-+++```
+-+++Astro frontmatter:
+-+++  import { getBusinessBySlug } from "@/lib/db/queries"
+-+++  const { business, products } = await getBusinessBySlug(slug)
+-+++  if (!business) return Astro.redirect("/404")
+-+++---
+-+++HTML template: 纯 import fulldev/starwind 组件 + 数据注入
+-+++```
+-+++
+-+++**Before**（admin 页面）：
+-+++```
+-+++Astro frontmatter: fetch data
+-+++HTML template: inline<script> with innerHTML, classList manipulation
+-+++```
+-+++
+-+++**After**（admin 页面）：
+-+++```
+-+++Astro frontmatter: fetch data, pass as props to Island
+-+++HTML template: <XxxIsland data={...} />
+-+++Island script: textContent/classList/value (no innerHTML)
+-+++```
+-+++
+-+++## Technical Decisions
+-+++
+-+++### ADR-1: Query Function Granularity
+-+++**Decision**: 每个 slug 页面对应一个 query 文件，`non-profit` 和 `public-sector` 共用一个 `getEntityBySlug`（两者 schema 几乎相同）
+-+++**Rationale**: 避免过度抽象。先按页面分离，后续发现共性再提取。
+-+++**Risk**: 6 个新文件 = 维护负担。Mitigation：这些函数可以被 E2E 测试覆盖。
+-+++
+-+++### ADR-2: Starwind Component Selection
+-+++**Decision**: 安装 10 个 fulldev 没有的组件：toast, dropzone, pagination, progress, color-picker, scroll-area, hover-card, context-menu, image, item
+-+++**Rationale**: 这 10 个是项目目前用 Tailwind 硬拼的组件，也是 fulldev 明确缺失的。
+-+++**Not installing**: button, card, dialog, sidebar 等（与 fulldev 重叠，安装了是浪费且增加维护成本）
+-+++
+-+++### ADR-3: Block vs Atomic Component for Marketing Pages
+-+++**Decision**: 优先用 Block（数据驱动的整页模板），而非原子组件拼接
+-+++**Rationale**: Block = 改 props 数据不改模板，AI 开发效率最高。手写 grid + h1+h2 每次改版要动多个文件。
+-+++**Risk**: Block 源码量大（单个 Hero block ~200行）。Mitigation：source 文件归你，修改前先 git commit。
+-+++
+-+++### ADR-4: Island Migration Priority
+-+++**Decision**: 先迁移 inline script 最严重的3 个页面（ai-tools 927行、login 188行、media 303行）
+-+++**Rationale**: 这些页面的 inline script 是最大的 XSS 风险源和代码复杂度来源。
+-+++**Not migrating**: admin/index（已迁移），其他 admin页面（已有 islands）
+-+++
+-+++## Risks & Mitigations
+-+++
+-+++| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
+-+++|---|---|---|
+-+++| Block 升级覆盖本地修改 | Medium | 升级前 git commit，每次只升级一个组件 |
+-+++| query 函数与页面逻辑不一致 | High | 每个 query 函数配套 E2E 测试（Given page loads → data correct）|
+-+++| Starwind 动效与现有 CSS 变量冲突 | Low | `starwind.config.json` 的 theme 配置独立，不改 `globals.css` 已有变量 |
+-+++| 删除 PascalCase 文件导致断链 import | High | 先 grep 全部引用，批量替换后再删除 |
+-+++| Slug 页面重构引入 regression | High | `sw:grill` 验证 + E2E smoke test |
+-+++| Block 源码不适合当前设计 | Medium | 先用 `--dry-run` 查看 Block 效果，不满意不安装 |
+-+++
+-+++## Testing Strategy
+-+++
+-+++1. **US-003 query 函数**：每个 query 函数一个集成测试（mock DB，返回预期数据 shape）
+-+++2. **US-004 island**：Given admin page loads → Then island renders with correct data, no innerHTML
+-+++3. **US-007验证**：全量 `astro build` + `playwright test`
+-+++
+-+++## Implementation Phases
+-+++
+-+++### Phase 1: Setup（US-001）
+-+++- `npx starwind@latest init`
+-+++- `npx starwind@latest add` 10 个组件
+-+++
+-+++### Phase 2: Block + Query（US-002, US-003）
+-+++- 营销页 → Block（5 个页面）
+-+++- Slug 页面查询分离（5+1 个 query 文件）
+-+++
+-+++### Phase 3: Island（US-004）
+-+++- 4 个 admin 页面 → island
+-+++
+-+++### Phase 4: Cleanup（US-005, US-006）
+-+++- 删除 PascalCase 文件 + components.json
+-+++- Starwind 组件集成到页面
+-+++
+-+++### Phase 5: Verification（US-007）
+-+++- 构建 + E2E
+-++\ No newline at end of file

+-+++
+-+++**迁移目标：**
+-+++-组件复用最大化：Starwind 补充 fulldev 缺失的 10 个组件
+-+++- UI/UX 分离：业务逻辑 → lib/queries，数据获取 → page frontmatter，UI → fulldev/starwind
+-+++- 代码量降低：Block 替代手写 HTML，island 替代 inline script
+-+++- AI 开发效率提升：组件 = 改数据不改模板，业务逻辑可被 AI 独立处理
+-+++
+-+++---
+-+++
+-+++## User Stories

+-+++# Feature: Starwind UI Installation
+-+++

+-+++
+-+++项目当前缺少 Starwind 组件库。Fulldev UI 覆盖55 个组件，但缺少 10 个差异化组件：Toast/Dropzone/Pagination/Progress/Color Picker/Scroll Area/Hover Card/Context Menu/Image/Item。项目目前用 Tailwind 硬拼这些组件。
+-+++
+-+++Starwind UI 是 Astro 原生组件库，零 runtime，source 文件归你，通过 `npx starwind@latest` CLI 安装到 `src/components/starwind/`。

+-+++| 页面 | 文件行数 | frontmatter |
+-+++|---|---|---|
+-+++| `business/[slug].astro` | 593 | 183行 |
+-+++| `listings/[slug].astro` | 250 | 116行 |
+-+++| `non-profit/[slug].astro` | 238 | 98行 |
+-+++| `public-sector/[slug].astro` | 238 | 98行 |
+-+++| `blog/[slug].astro` | 307 | 81行 |
+-+++
+-+++**目标：** 业务逻辑（DB 查询 + 数据转换）→ `src/lib/db/queries/`，页面仅保留 fetch + redirect。
+-+++
+-+++---
+-+++
+-+++## User Stories
+-+++
+-+++### US-001: Extract Business Slug Queries (P0)
+-+++**Project**: timorup

+-+++### US-008: Design System Consistency (P0)
+-+++**Project**: timorup
+-+++
+-+++**As a** developer
+-+++**I want** fulldev + starwind 组件共存时风格完全一致
+-+++**So that** 用户体验无割裂感
+-+++
+-+++**Context**:
+-+++- fulldev (`cva`) + starwind (`tv`) 共用 `--color-*` design tokens（通过 `globals.css` 别名映射）
+-+++- 两者均生成原子化 Tailwind 类名，无独立 CSS 类冲突
+-+++- **风险点**：同名组件 variant 值不同（fulldev `default` = starwind `primary`），禁止混用
+-+++
+-+++**Acceptance Criteria**:
+-+++- [ ] **AC-US8-01**: 页面级组件只使用一个库的 Button/Dropdown/Select，禁止同一页面同时 import 两个库的同名组件
+-+++- [ ] **AC-US8-02**: fulldev button 作为 primary choice；starwind 仅用于差异化组件（Toast/Pagination/Progress/Dropzone/Scroll-Area/Hover-Card/Context-Menu/Image/Item）
+-+++- [ ] **AC-US8-03**: `globals.css` 中 `--starwind-*` 别名全部指向 `--color-*`（已满足，无需修改）
+-+++- [ ] **AC-US8-04**: 页面代码审查时检测同一文件中同时 import fulldev + starwind 同名组件的情况
+-+++
+-+++---

+-++++# Implementation Plan: Admin Security + Island Migration
+-++++
+-++++## Architecture Decisions
+-++++
+-++++### AD-001: DOMPurify over safe DOM API for XSS Fixes
+-++++- **Decision**: Use DOMPurify for complex HTML generation (charts, product cards), safe DOM API for simple cases
+-++++- **Why**: Chart HTML is template-string-based; DOMPurify is the minimal-change fix
+-++++- **Alternatives considered**: Full safe DOM API rewrite (too large, high risk)
+-++++
+-++++### AD-002: Island Pattern for Dashboard
+-++++- **Decision**: Follow `ServicePackagesIsland.astro` pattern — server data via `set:html` JSON script tag, client uses `JSON.parse` + safe DOM API
+-++++- **Why**: Zero innerHTML, type-safe data flow, consistent with codebase patterns
+-++++
+-++++### AD-003: Re-export over Deletion for Legacy Components
+-++++- **Decision**: Convert legacy PascalCase files to thin re-exports
+-++++- **Why**: Prevents breaking unknown import sites without doing a full grep audit
+-++++
+-++++## Components
+-++++
+-++++- `DashboardIsland.astro` (NEW): Admin dashboard island — stats cards, revenue chart, subscription list
+-++++- `pages/admin/index.astro` (MOD): Becomes island shell — server data fetch, island reference
+-++++- `pages/business/[slug]/products.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to product card innerHTML
+-++++- `pages/business/[slug]/edit/index.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to gallery preview
+-++++- `src/components/ui/*.astro` (MOD): 11 re-export files → thin wrappers
+-++++
+-++++## DOMPurify Pattern
+-++++
+-++++```typescript
+-++++// In <script> block of affected files
+-++++import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
+-++++const sanitize = (html: string) => DOMPurify.sanitize(html, { USE_PROFILES: { html: true } });
+-++++
+-++++// Before any innerHTML assignment
+-++++chartEl.innerHTML = sanitize(chartHTML);
+-++++cardEl.innerHTML = sanitize(cardHTML);
+-++++```
+-++++
+-++++## Testing Strategy
+-++++
+-++++- Build verification: `pnpm build` exit 0
+-++++- E2E regression: `pnpm test:e2e`
+-++++- Manual XSS test: inject `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` in product title → verify not executed

+-++++# Plan: Fulldev + Starwind Migration
+-++++
+-++++## Overview
+-++++
+-++++通过3 个维度重构，实现 Astro 原生组件最大化复用 + UI/UX 与业务代码完全分离：
+-++++
+-++++1. **Starwind 安装** — 补充 fulldev 缺失的 10 个差异化组件
+-++++2. **Block 替换** — 营销页从手写 HTML → Fulldev Block（改数据不改模板）
+-++++3. **架构分离** — slug 页面 DB逻辑 → lib/queries，admin 页面 inline script → island
+-++++
+-++++## Architecture
+-++++
+-++++### Target Component Structure
+-++++```
+-++++src/
+-++++├── components/
+-++++│   ├── ui/ ← Fulldev 组件（54 dirs, source-owned）
+-++++│   │   ├── button/, card/, dialog/, ...
+-++++│   │   └── blocks/ ← Fulldev Blocks（新增）
+-++++│   ├── starwind/              ← Starwind 组件（新增，10 个差异化组件）
+-++++│   ├── islands/               ← 交互组件（已有13 个 + 新增 4 个）
+-++++│   │   └── admin/ ← Admin islands
+-++++│   ├── business/              ← 业务卡片（保留）
+-++++│   └── forms/                  ← 表单组件（保留）
+-++++├── lib/
+-++++│   └── db/
+-++++│       └── queries/           ← 业务查询函数（新增 6 个）
+-++++│           ├── getBusinessBySlug.ts
+-++++│           ├── getListingBySlug.ts
+-++++│           ├── getNonProfitBySlug.ts
+-++++│           ├── getPublicSectorBySlug.ts
+-++++│           ├── getBlogPostBySlug.ts
+-++++│           └── getEntityBySlug.ts  ← 非营利/公共部门共用
+-++++└── pages/
+-++++    ├── index.astro            ← Block替换（~116行 → ~60行）
+-++++    ├── business/[slug].astro ← 查询分离（~593行 → ~200行）
+-++++    ├── admin/
+-++++    │   ├── login.astro        ← Island 迁移
+-++++    │   ├── media.astro ← Island 迁移
+-++++    │   └── ai-tools.astro ← Island 迁移
+-++++    └── ...
+-++++```
+-++++
+-++++### Data Flow: Before vs After
+-++++
+-++++**Before**（slug页面）：
+-++++```
+-++++Astro frontmatter:
+-++++  await getDb()         ← DB 连接
+-++++  db.select(...) ← 查询
+-++++  .map(...).filter(...) ← 数据转换
+-++++  { business, products } ← 组装数据
+-++++  return Astro.redirect ← 重定向
+-++++---
+-++++HTML template (300+ lines, inline styles, hardcoded grid)
+-++++```
+-++++
+-++++**After**（slug 页面）：
+-++++```
+-++++Astro frontmatter:
+-++++  import { getBusinessBySlug } from "@/lib/db/queries"
+-++++  const { business, products } = await getBusinessBySlug(slug)
+-++++  if (!business) return Astro.redirect("/404")
+-++++---
+-++++HTML template: 纯 import fulldev/starwind 组件 + 数据注入
+-++++```
+-++++
+-++++**Before**（admin 页面）：
+-++++```
+-++++Astro frontmatter: fetch data
+-++++HTML template: inline<script> with innerHTML, classList manipulation
+-++++```
+-++++
+-++++**After**（admin 页面）：
+-++++```
+-++++Astro frontmatter: fetch data, pass as props to Island
+-++++HTML template: <XxxIsland data={...} />
+-++++Island script: textContent/classList/value (no innerHTML)
+-++++```
+-++++
+-++++## Technical Decisions
+-++++
+-++++### ADR-1: Query Function Granularity
+-++++**Decision**: 每个 slug 页面对应一个 query 文件，`non-profit` 和 `public-sector` 共用一个 `getEntityBySlug`（两者 schema 几乎相同）
+-++++**Rationale**: 避免过度抽象。先按页面分离，后续发现共性再提取。
+-++++**Risk**: 6 个新文件 = 维护负担。Mitigation：这些函数可以被 E2E 测试覆盖。
+-++++
+-++++### ADR-2: Starwind Component Selection
+-++++**Decision**: 安装 10 个 fulldev 没有的组件：toast, dropzone, pagination, progress, color-picker, scroll-area, hover-card, context-menu, image, item
+-++++**Rationale**: 这 10 个是项目目前用 Tailwind 硬拼的组件，也是 fulldev 明确缺失的。
+-++++**Not installing**: button, card, dialog, sidebar 等（与 fulldev 重叠，安装了是浪费且增加维护成本）
+-++++
+-++++### ADR-3: Block vs Atomic Component for Marketing Pages
+-++++**Decision**: 优先用 Block（数据驱动的整页模板），而非原子组件拼接
+-++++**Rationale**: Block = 改 props 数据不改模板，AI 开发效率最高。手写 grid + h1+h2 每次改版要动多个文件。
+-++++**Risk**: Block 源码量大（单个 Hero block ~200行）。Mitigation：source 文件归你，修改前先 git commit。
+-++++
+-++++### ADR-4: Island Migration Priority
+-++++**Decision**: 先迁移 inline script 最严重的3 个页面（ai-tools 927行、login 188行、media 303行）
+-++++**Rationale**: 这些页面的 inline script 是最大的 XSS 风险源和代码复杂度来源。
+-++++**Not migrating**: admin/index（已迁移），其他 admin页面（已有 islands）
+-++++
+-++++## Risks & Mitigations
+-++++
+-++++| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
+-++++|---|---|---|
+-++++| Block 升级覆盖本地修改 | Medium | 升级前 git commit，每次只升级一个组件 |
+-++++| query 函数与页面逻辑不一致 | High | 每个 query 函数配套 E2E 测试（Given page loads → data correct）|
+-++++| Starwind 动效与现有 CSS 变量冲突 | Low | `starwind.config.json` 的 theme 配置独立，不改 `globals.css` 已有变量 |
+-++++| 删除 PascalCase 文件导致断链 import | High | 先 grep 全部引用，批量替换后再删除 |
+-++++| Slug 页面重构引入 regression | High | `sw:grill` 验证 + E2E smoke test |
+-++++| Block 源码不适合当前设计 | Medium | 先用 `--dry-run` 查看 Block 效果，不满意不安装 |
+-++++
+-++++## Testing Strategy
+-++++
+-++++1. **US-003 query 函数**：每个 query 函数一个集成测试（mock DB，返回预期数据 shape）
+-++++2. **US-004 island**：Given admin page loads → Then island renders with correct data, no innerHTML
+-++++3. **US-007验证**：全量 `astro build` + `playwright test`
+-++++
+-++++## Implementation Phases
+-++++
+-++++### Phase 1: Setup（US-001）
+-++++- `npx starwind@latest init`
+-++++- `npx starwind@latest add` 10 个组件
+-++++
+-++++### Phase 2: Block + Query（US-002, US-003）
+-++++- 营销页 → Block（5 个页面）
+-++++- Slug 页面查询分离（5+1 个 query 文件）
+-++++
+-++++### Phase 3: Island（US-004）
+-++++- 4 个 admin 页面 → island
+-++++
+-++++### Phase 4: Cleanup（US-005, US-006）
+-++++- 删除 PascalCase 文件 + components.json
+-++++- Starwind 组件集成到页面
+-++++
+-++++### Phase 5: Verification（US-007）
+-++++- 构建 + E2E

+-++++- 3 个 Admin 页面（ai-tools 927行、login 188行、media 303行）仍用 inline script，未 island化
+-++++- 24 个 PascalCase re-export 文件需要删除
+-++++- `components.json` 存在（shadcn CLI 配置）
+-++++
+-++++**迁移目标：**
+-++++-组件复用最大化：Starwind 补充 fulldev 缺失的 10 个组件
+-++++- UI/UX 分离：业务逻辑 → lib/queries，数据获取 → page frontmatter，UI → fulldev/starwind
+-++++- 代码量降低：Block 替代手写 HTML，island 替代 inline script
+-++++- AI 开发效率提升：组件 = 改数据不改模板，业务逻辑可被 AI 独立处理
+-++++

+-++++
+-++++# Feature: Starwind UI Installation
+-++++
+-++++## Context
+-++++
+-++++项目当前缺少 Starwind 组件库。Fulldev UI 覆盖55 个组件，但缺少 10 个差异化组件：Toast/Dropzone/Pagination/Progress/Color Picker/Scroll Area/Hover Card/Context Menu/Image/Item。项目目前用 Tailwind 硬拼这些组件。
+-++++
+-++++Starwind UI 是 Astro 原生组件库，零 runtime，source 文件归你，通过 `npx starwind@latest` CLI 安装到 `src/components/starwind/`。
+-++++
+-++++---
+-++++
