+-+++++# Implementation Plan: Admin Security + Island Migration
+-+++++
+-+++++## Architecture Decisions
+-+++++
+-+++++### AD-001: DOMPurify over safe DOM API for XSS Fixes
+-+++++- **Decision**: Use DOMPurify for complex HTML generation (charts, product cards), safe DOM API for simple cases
+-+++++- **Why**: Chart HTML is template-string-based; DOMPurify is the minimal-change fix
+-+++++- **Alternatives considered**: Full safe DOM API rewrite (too large, high risk)
+-+++++
+-+++++### AD-002: Island Pattern for Dashboard
+-+++++- **Decision**: Follow `ServicePackagesIsland.astro` pattern — server data via `set:html` JSON script tag, client uses `JSON.parse` + safe DOM API
+-+++++- **Why**: Zero innerHTML, type-safe data flow, consistent with codebase patterns
+-+++++
+-+++++### AD-003: Re-export over Deletion for Legacy Components
+-+++++- **Decision**: Convert legacy PascalCase files to thin re-exports
+-+++++- **Why**: Prevents breaking unknown import sites without doing a full grep audit
+-+++++
+-+++++## Components
+-+++++
+-+++++- `DashboardIsland.astro` (NEW): Admin dashboard island — stats cards, revenue chart, subscription list
+-+++++- `pages/admin/index.astro` (MOD): Becomes island shell — server data fetch, island reference
+-+++++- `pages/business/[slug]/products.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to product card innerHTML
+-+++++- `pages/business/[slug]/edit/index.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to gallery preview
+-+++++- `src/components/ui/*.astro` (MOD): 11 re-export files → thin wrappers
+-+++++
+-+++++## DOMPurify Pattern
+-+++++
+-+++++```typescript
+-+++++// In <script> block of affected files
+-+++++import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
+-+++++const sanitize = (html: string) => DOMPurify.sanitize(html, { USE_PROFILES: { html: true } });
+-+++++
+-+++++// Before any innerHTML assignment
+-+++++chartEl.innerHTML = sanitize(chartHTML);
+-+++++cardEl.innerHTML = sanitize(cardHTML);
+-+++++```
+-+++++
+-+++++## Testing Strategy
+-+++++
+-+++++- Build verification: `pnpm build` exit 0
+-+++++- E2E regression: `pnpm test:e2e`
+-+++++- Manual XSS test: inject `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` in product title → verify not executed
+-++++\ No newline at end of file

+-++++++# Implementation Plan: Admin Security + Island Migration
+-++++++
+-++++++## Architecture Decisions
+-++++++
+-++++++### AD-001: DOMPurify over safe DOM API for XSS Fixes
+-++++++- **Decision**: Use DOMPurify for complex HTML generation (charts, product cards), safe DOM API for simple cases
+-++++++- **Why**: Chart HTML is template-string-based; DOMPurify is the minimal-change fix
+-++++++- **Alternatives considered**: Full safe DOM API rewrite (too large, high risk)
+-++++++
+-++++++### AD-002: Island Pattern for Dashboard
+-++++++- **Decision**: Follow `ServicePackagesIsland.astro` pattern — server data via `set:html` JSON script tag, client uses `JSON.parse` + safe DOM API
+-++++++- **Why**: Zero innerHTML, type-safe data flow, consistent with codebase patterns
+-++++++
+-++++++### AD-003: Re-export over Deletion for Legacy Components
+-++++++- **Decision**: Convert legacy PascalCase files to thin re-exports
+-++++++- **Why**: Prevents breaking unknown import sites without doing a full grep audit
+-++++++
+-++++++## Components
+-++++++
+-++++++- `DashboardIsland.astro` (NEW): Admin dashboard island — stats cards, revenue chart, subscription list
+-++++++- `pages/admin/index.astro` (MOD): Becomes island shell — server data fetch, island reference
+-++++++- `pages/business/[slug]/products.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to product card innerHTML
+-++++++- `pages/business/[slug]/edit/index.astro` (MOD): Add DOMPurify to gallery preview
+-++++++- `src/components/ui/*.astro` (MOD): 11 re-export files → thin wrappers
+-++++++
+-++++++## DOMPurify Pattern
+-++++++
+-++++++```typescript
+-++++++// In <script> block of affected files
+-++++++import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
+-++++++const sanitize = (html: string) => DOMPurify.sanitize(html, { USE_PROFILES: { html: true } });
+-++++++
+-++++++// Before any innerHTML assignment
+-++++++chartEl.innerHTML = sanitize(chartHTML);
+-++++++cardEl.innerHTML = sanitize(cardHTML);
+-++++++```
+-++++++
+-++++++## Testing Strategy
+-++++++
+-++++++- Build verification: `pnpm build` exit 0
+-++++++- E2E regression: `pnpm test:e2e`
+-++++++- Manual XSS test: inject `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` in product title → verify not executed

+-++++++++<script>
+-++++++++  import { toast } from '@/lib/toast';
+-++++++++
+-++++++++  let currentPage = 1;
+-++++++++  const pageSize = 20;
+-++++++++
+-++++++++  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}) {
+-++++++++    return fetch(url, {
+-++++++++      ...options,
+-++++++++      credentials: 'include',
+-++++++++      headers: {
+-++++++++        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-++++++++        ...options.headers,
+-++++++++      },
+-++++++++    });
+-++++++++  }
+-++++++++
+-++++++++  async function loadReviews() {
+-++++++++    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value || '';
+-++++++++    const rating = (document.getElementById('rating-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-++++++++    const fromDate = (document.getElementById('from-date') as HTMLInputElement)?.value || '';
+-++++++++    const toDate = (document.getElementById('to-date') as HTMLInputElement)?.value || '';
+-++++++++
+-++++++++    let url = `/api/admin/reviews?page=${currentPage}&limit=${pageSize}`;
+-++++++++    if (search) url += `&search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}`;
+-++++++++    if (rating) url += `&rating=${rating}`;
+-++++++++    if (fromDate) url += `&from=${fromDate}`;
+-++++++++    if (toDate) url += `&to=${toDate}`;
+-++++++++
+-++++++++    try {
+-++++++++      const res = await authFetch(url);
+-++++++++      const data = await res.json();
+-++++++++
+-++++++++      const container = document.getElementById('reviews-list');
+-++++++++      const countEl = document.getElementById('reviews-count');
+-++++++++      const pageInfo = document.getElementById('page-info');
+-++++++++      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prev-btn') as HTMLButtonElement;
+-++++++++      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('next-btn') as HTMLButtonElement;
+-++++++++      if (!container || !countEl) return;
+-++++++++
+-++++++++      if (!data.success || !data.data || data.data.length === 0) {
+-++++++++        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No reviews found</p>';
+-++++++++        countEl.textContent = '0 reviews';
+-++++++++        if (pageInfo) pageInfo.textContent = '';
+-++++++++        return;
+-++++++++      }
+-++++++++
+-++++++++      const total = data.total || data.data.length;
+-++++++++      countEl.textContent = `${total} review${total !== 1 ? 's' : ''} total`;
+-++++++++
+-++++++++      if (pageInfo) {
+-++++++++        const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1;
+-++++++++        const end = Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, total);
+-++++++++        pageInfo.textContent = `Showing ${start}-${end} of ${total}`;
+-++++++++      }
+-++++++++
+-++++++++      if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = currentPage <= 1;
+-++++++++      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = currentPage * pageSize >= total;
+-++++++++
+-++++++++      container.textContent = '';
+-++++++++      data.data.forEach((review: any) => {
+-++++++++        const reviewDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-++++++++        reviewDiv.className = 'p-3 border rounded text-sm';
+-++++++++
+-++++++++        const stars = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) =>
+-++++++++          i < (review.rating || 0)
+-++++++++            ? '<span class="text-yellow-500">★</span>'
+-++++++++            : '<span class="text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-600">★</span>'
+-++++++++        ).join('');
+-++++++++
+-++++++++        const replyBadge = review.reply
+-++++++++          ? `<span class="text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">Replied</span>`
+-++++++++          : '';
+-++++++++        const editedSpan = review.isEdited
+-++++++++          ? `<span class="text-xs text-yellow-600">(edited)</span>`
+-++++++++          : '';
+-++++++++        const replyInfo = review.reply
+-++++++++          ? `<span class="text-xs text-green-600">Replied: ${review.reply.slice(0, 30)}${review.reply.length > 30 ? '...' : ''}</span>`
+-++++++++          : '';
+-++++++++        const createdAt = review.createdAt
+-++++++++          ? new Date(review.createdAt * 1000).toLocaleDateString()
+-++++++++          : 'N/A';
+-++++++++
+-++++++++        reviewDiv.innerHTML = `
+-++++++++          <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
+-++++++++            <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-++++++++              <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-1">
+-++++++++                <span class="font-medium">${review.businessTitle || 'Unknown Business'}</span>
+-++++++++                <span class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">by ${review.userName || review.userEmail || 'Unknown'}</span>
+-++++++++                ${replyBadge}
+-++++++++              </div>
+-++++++++              <div class="flex items-center gap-1 mb-2">${stars}</div>
+-++++++++              <p class="text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-2 break-words">${review.comment || 'No comment'}</p>
+-++++++++              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-++++++++                <span class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${createdAt}</span>
+-++++++++                ${editedSpan}
+-++++++++                ${replyInfo}
+-++++++++              </div>
+-++++++++            </div>
+-++++++++            <button class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 text-xs px-2 py-1 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded shrink-0" data-action="delete-review" data-id="${review.id}">Delete</button>
+-++++++++          </div>
+-++++++++        `;
+-++++++++        container.appendChild(reviewDiv);
+-++++++++      });
+-++++++++    } catch (err) {
+-++++++++      console.error('Error loading reviews:', err);
+-++++++++      toast.error('Failed to load reviews');
+-++++++++    }
+-++++++++  }

+-++++++++  async function confirmDelete() {

+-++++++++        toast.error(data.error?.message || 'Failed to delete review');

+-++++++++      toast.error('Error deleting review');
+-++++++++    }

+-++++++++function escapeHtml(str: string): string {

+-+++++++-  const dialog = document.getElementById('share-dialog');
+-+++++++-  const backdrop = document.getElementById('share-backdrop');
+-+++++++-  const closeBtn = document.getElementById('share-close');
+-+++++++-  const shareBtn = document.getElementById('share-btn');
+-+++++++-  const platforms = document.querySelectorAll('.share-platform');
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  let currentUrl = '';
+-+++++++-  let currentTitle = '';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  function openDialog(e) {
+-+++++++-    e.preventDefault();
+-+++++++-    currentUrl = shareBtn?.dataset.url || '';
+-+++++++-    currentTitle = shareBtn?.dataset.title || '';
+-+++++++-    dialog?.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++-    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  function closeDialog() {
+-+++++++-    dialog?.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++++-    document.body.style.overflow = '';
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  function shareTo(platform) {
+-+++++++-    const encodedUrl = encodeURIComponent(currentUrl);
+-+++++++-    const encodedTitle = encodeURIComponent(currentTitle);
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-    switch (platform) {
+-+++++++-      case 'facebook':
+-+++++++-        window.open(`https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodedUrl}`, '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'instagram':
+-+++++++-        // Instagram doesn't have web share API, copy link instead
+-+++++++-        navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentUrl);
+-+++++++-        alert('Link copied! Open Instagram and paste.');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'twitter':
+-+++++++-        window.open(`https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=${encodedUrl}&text=${encodedTitle}`, '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'linkedin':
+-+++++++-        window.open(`https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=${encodedUrl}`, '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'whatsapp':
+-+++++++-        window.open(`https://wa.me/?text=${encodedTitle}%20${encodedUrl}`, '_blank');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'tiktok':
+-+++++++-        // TikTok web share is limited, show message
+-+++++++-        navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentUrl);
+-+++++++-        alert('Link copied! Open TikTok and paste.');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'viber':
+-+++++++-        window.open(`viber://forward?text=${encodedTitle}%20${encodedUrl}`, '_blank');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'telegram':
+-+++++++-        window.open(`https://t.me/share/url?url=${encodedUrl}&text=${encodedTitle}`, '_blank', 'width=600,height=400');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'sms':
+-+++++++-        window.open(`sms:?body=${encodedTitle}%20${encodedUrl}`, '_blank');
+-+++++++-        break;
+-+++++++-      case 'copy':
+-+++++++-        navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentUrl).then(() => {
+-+++++++-          closeDialog();
+-+++++++-          // Show toast
+-+++++++-          const toast = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++-          toast.className = 'fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-green-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-sm z-50';
+-+++++++-          toast.textContent = 'Link copied!';
+-+++++++-          document.body.appendChild(toast);
+-+++++++-          setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 2000);
+-+++++++-        });
+-+++++++-        return;
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-    closeDialog();
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-

+-+++++++-  shareBtn?.addEventListener('click', openDialog);
+-+++++++-  backdrop?.addEventListener('click', closeDialog);
+-+++++++-  closeBtn?.addEventListener('click', closeDialog);
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  platforms.forEach(btn => {
+-+++++++-    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {

+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  });

+-+++++++-/**
+-+++++++- * Unified TipTap Renderer Component
+-+++++++- * Renders TipTap-generated HTML content consistently across all entity types
+-+++++++- * 
+-+++++++- * Supports: businesses, listings, blogs, non-profits, public-sectors, products
+-+++++++- */
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-interface Props {
+-+++++++-  /** HTML content from TipTap editor */
+-+++++++-  content: string | null | undefined;
+-+++++++-  /** CSS class for the container */
+-+++++++-  class?: string;
+-+++++++-  /** Optional prose size variant */
+-+++++++-  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
+-+++++++-  /** Enable/disable link sanitization */
+-+++++++-  sanitizeLinks?: boolean;
+-+++++++-}
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-const {
+-+++++++-  content,
+-+++++++-  class: className = '',
+-+++++++-  size = 'md',
+-+++++++-  sanitizeLinks = true,
+-+++++++-} = Astro.props;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-// Size-based prose classes
+-+++++++-const sizeClasses = {
+-+++++++-  sm: 'prose-sm',
+-+++++++-  md: 'prose-base',
+-+++++++-  lg: 'prose-lg',
+-+++++++-};
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-// Sanitize function - removes potentially dangerous attributes while preserving safe HTML
+-+++++++-function sanitizeHtml(html: string): string {
+-+++++++-  if (!html) return '';
+-+++++++-  
+-+++++++-  // If sanitizeLinks is false, skip link sanitization
+-+++++++-  if (!sanitizeLinks) {
+-+++++++-    return html;
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-  
+-+++++++-  // Allow only safe attributes in links
+-+++++++-  return html.replace(
+-+++++++-    /<a\s+([^>]*?)>/gi,
+-+++++++-    (match, attrs) => {
+-+++++++-      // Keep only href, title, target, rel attributes
+-+++++++-      const allowedAttrs = attrs.match(/(href|title|target|rel)=["'][^"']*["']/gi) || [];
+-+++++++-      // Add noopener/noreferrer for security
+-+++++++-      const secureAttrs = allowedAttrs
+-+++++++-        .map(attr => {
+-+++++++-          if (attr.startsWith('href=')) {
+-+++++++-            // Validate href is safe (http, https, mailto, or relative)
+-+++++++-            const urlMatch = attr.match(/href=["']([^"']*)["']/);
+-+++++++-            if (urlMatch) {
+-+++++++-              const url = urlMatch[1];
+-+++++++-              const isSafe = 
+-+++++++-                url.startsWith('http://') || 
+-+++++++-                url.startsWith('https://') ||
+-+++++++-                url.startsWith('mailto:') ||
+-+++++++-                url.startsWith('#') ||
+-+++++++-                url.startsWith('/');
+-+++++++-              if (!isSafe) return 'href="#"';
+-+++++++-            }
+-+++++++-          }
+-+++++++-          return attr;
+-+++++++-        })
+-+++++++-        .join(' ');
+-+++++++-      
+-+++++++-      // Ensure target="_blank" has rel="noopener noreferrer"
+-+++++++-      if (allowedAttrs.some(a => a.includes('target='))) {
+-+++++++-        if (!allowedAttrs.some(a => a.includes('rel='))) {
+-+++++++-          secureAttrs.push('rel="noopener noreferrer"');
+-+++++++-        }
+-+++++++-      }
+-+++++++-      
+-+++++++-      return `<a ${secureAttrs}>`;
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  );
+-+++++++-}
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-// Process TipTap HTML content
+-+++++++-const processedContent = content ? sanitizeHtml(content) : '';
+-+++++++-const proseClass = sizeClasses[size];

+-++++++++export interface OrderData {
+-++++++++  id: string;
+-++++++++  servicePackageId: string | null;
+-++++++++  variantSnapshot: string | null;
+-++++++++  type: string | null;
+-++++++++  typeId: string | null;
+-++++++++  userId: string | null;
+-++++++++  amount: number | null;
+-++++++++  paymentMethod: string | null;
+-++++++++  status: string | null;
+-++++++++  planExpiresAt: number | null;
+-++++++++  paidDate: number | null;
+-++++++++  createdAt: number | null;
+-++++++++  adminNotes: string | null;
+-++++++++}
+-++++++++
+-++++++++export async function getAdminOrders(status?: string): Promise<OrderData[]> {
+-++++++++  const db = await getDb();
+-++++++++  if (!db) return [];
+-++++++++
+-++++++++  let query = db.select({
+-++++++++    id: orders.id,
+-++++++++    servicePackageId: orders.servicePackageId,
+-++++++++    variantSnapshot: orders.variantSnapshot,
+-++++++++    type: orders.type,
+-++++++++    typeId: orders.typeId,
+-++++++++    userId: orders.userId,
+-++++++++    amount: orders.amount,
+-++++++++    paymentMethod: orders.paymentMethod,
+-++++++++    status: orders.status,
+-++++++++    planExpiresAt: orders.planExpiresAt,
+-++++++++    paidDate: orders.paidDate,
+-++++++++    createdAt: orders.createdAt,
+-++++++++    adminNotes: orders.adminNotes,
+-++++++++  })
+-++++++++    .from(orders)
+-++++++++    .orderBy(desc(orders.createdAt))
+-++++++++    .limit(100);
+-++++++++
+-++++++++  if (status) {
+-++++++++    query = query.where(eq(orders.status, status)) as typeof query;
+-++++++++  }
+-++++++++
+-++++++++  return query.all();
+-++++++++}

+-+++++++-  // Render businesses with filters

+-+++++++-    const container = document.getElementById('businesses-list');

+-+++++++-    if (!container) return;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value.toLowerCase() || '';

+-+++++++-        return `
+-+++++++-        <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-3 border rounded text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50" data-action="show-order-details" data-id="${order.id}">
+-+++++++-          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-+++++++-            <p class="font-medium truncate">#${order.id.slice(0, 8)}</p>
+-+++++++-            <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">${snapshot.name || order.servicePackageId || 'N/A'} - $${order.amount / 100}</p>
+-+++++++-            <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${order.typeId || order.userId || 'N/A'}</p>

+-+++++++-            <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${order.status === 'paid' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-200' : 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900 dark:text-yellow-200'}">${order.status}</span>

+-+++++++-  let currentPage = 1;
+-+++++++-  const pageSize = 20;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+++++++-  async function authFetch(url, options = {}) {
+-+++++++-    return fetch(url, {
+-+++++++-      ...options,
+-+++++++-      credentials: 'include',
+-+++++++-      headers: {
+-+++++++-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+++++++-        ...options.headers,
+-+++++++-      },
+-+++++++-    });
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  // Load reviews
+-+++++++-  async function loadReviews() {
+-+++++++-    try {
+-+++++++-      const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++++-      const rating = (document.getElementById('rating-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++++-      const fromDate = (document.getElementById('from-date') as HTMLInputElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++++-      const toDate = (document.getElementById('to-date') as HTMLInputElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      let url = `/api/admin/reviews?page=${currentPage}&limit=${pageSize}`;
+-+++++++-      if (search) url += `&search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}`;
+-+++++++-      if (rating) url += `&rating=${rating}`;
+-+++++++-      if (fromDate) url += `&from=${fromDate}`;
+-+++++++-      if (toDate) url += `&to=${toDate}`;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      const res = await authFetch(url);
+-+++++++-      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      const container = document.getElementById('reviews-list');
+-+++++++-      const countEl = document.getElementById('reviews-count');
+-+++++++-      const pageInfo = document.getElementById('page-info');
+-+++++++-      const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prev-btn') as HTMLButtonElement;
+-+++++++-      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('next-btn') as HTMLButtonElement;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      if (!container || !countEl) return;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      if (!data.success || data.data.length === 0) {
+-+++++++-        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No reviews found</p>';
+-+++++++-        countEl.textContent = '0 reviews';
+-+++++++-        if (pageInfo) pageInfo.textContent = '';
+-+++++++-        if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = true;
+-+++++++-        if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = true;
+-+++++++-        return;
+-+++++++-      }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      const total = data.total || data.data.length;
+-+++++++-      countEl.textContent = `${total} review${total !== 1 ? 's' : ''} total`;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      if (pageInfo) {
+-+++++++-        const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1;
+-+++++++-        const end = Math.min(currentPage * pageSize, total);
+-+++++++-        pageInfo.textContent = `Showing ${start}-${end} of ${total}`;
+-+++++++-      }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = currentPage <= 1;
+-+++++++-      if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = currentPage * pageSize >= total;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      // Clear and render
+-+++++++-      container.textContent = '';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      data.data.forEach((review: ReviewData) => {
+-+++++++-        const reviewDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++-        reviewDiv.className = 'p-3 border rounded text-sm';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        const innerDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++-        innerDiv.className = 'flex items-start justify-between gap-2';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        // Left content
+-+++++++-        const leftDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++-        leftDiv.className = 'min-w-0 flex-1';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        // Header
+-+++++++-        const headerDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++-        headerDiv.className = 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-1';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        const bizSpan = document.createElement('span');
+-+++++++-        bizSpan.className = 'font-medium';
+-+++++++-        bizSpan.textContent = review.businessTitle || 'Unknown Business';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        const userSpan = document.createElement('span');
+-+++++++-        userSpan.className = 'text-xs text-muted-foreground';
+-+++++++-        userSpan.textContent = `by ${review.userName || review.userEmail || 'Unknown'}`;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        headerDiv.appendChild(bizSpan);
+-+++++++-        headerDiv.appendChild(userSpan);
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        // Reply badge
+-+++++++-        if (review.reply) {
+-+++++++-          const replyBadge = document.createElement('span');
+-+++++++-          replyBadge.className = 'text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded';
+-+++++++-          replyBadge.textContent = 'Replied';
+-+++++++-          headerDiv.appendChild(replyBadge);
+-+++++++-        }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        // Stars
+-+++++++-        const starsDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++-        starsDiv.className = 'flex items-center gap-1 mb-2';
+-+++++++-        starsDiv.innerHTML = renderStars(review.rating || 0);
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        // Comment
+-+++++++-        const commentP = document.createElement('p');
+-+++++++-        commentP.className = 'text-muted-foreground text-xs mb-2';
+-+++++++-        commentP.textContent = review.comment || 'No comment';
+-+++++++-        commentP.style.wordBreak = 'break-word';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        // Meta row
+-+++++++-        const metaDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++-        metaDiv.className = 'flex items-center gap-2';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        const dateSpan = document.createElement('span');
+-+++++++-        dateSpan.className = 'text-xs text-muted-foreground';
+-+++++++-        dateSpan.textContent = review.createdAt ? new Date(review.createdAt).toLocaleDateString() : '';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        metaDiv.appendChild(dateSpan);
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        if (review.isEdited) {
+-+++++++-          const editedSpan = document.createElement('span');
+-+++++++-          editedSpan.className = 'text-xs text-yellow-600';
+-+++++++-          editedSpan.textContent = '(edited)';
+-+++++++-          metaDiv.appendChild(editedSpan);
+-+++++++-        }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        if (review.reply) {
+-+++++++-          const replyInfo = document.createElement('span');
+-+++++++-          replyInfo.className = 'text-xs text-green-600';
+-+++++++-          replyInfo.textContent = `Replied: ${review.reply.slice(0, 30)}${review.reply.length > 30 ? '...' : ''}`;
+-+++++++-          metaDiv.appendChild(replyInfo);
+-+++++++-        }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        leftDiv.appendChild(headerDiv);
+-+++++++-        leftDiv.appendChild(starsDiv);
+-+++++++-        leftDiv.appendChild(commentP);
+-+++++++-        leftDiv.appendChild(metaDiv);
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        // Delete button
+-+++++++-        const deleteBtn = document.createElement('button');
+-+++++++-        deleteBtn.className = 'text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 text-xs px-2 py-1 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded shrink-0';
+-+++++++-        deleteBtn.textContent = 'Delete';
+-+++++++-        deleteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => showDeleteModal(review.id));
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-        innerDiv.appendChild(leftDiv);
+-+++++++-        innerDiv.appendChild(deleteBtn);
+-+++++++-        reviewDiv.appendChild(innerDiv);
+-+++++++-        container.appendChild(reviewDiv);
+-+++++++-      });
+-+++++++-    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++-      console.error('Error loading reviews:', err);
+-+++++++-      toast.error('Failed to load reviews');
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  // Render star rating
+-+++++++-  function renderStars(rating: number) {
+-+++++++-    let stars = '';
+-+++++++-    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
+-+++++++-      if (i <= rating) {
+-+++++++-        stars += '<span class="text-yellow-500">★</span>';
+-+++++++-      } else {
+-+++++++-        stars += '<span class="text-gray-300 dark:text-gray-600">★</span>';
+-+++++++-      }
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-    return stars;
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  // Delete modal
+-+++++++-  function showDeleteModal(id: string) {
+-+++++++-    const modal = document.getElementById('delete-modal');
+-+++++++-    const input = document.getElementById('delete-review-id') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+++++++-    if (modal && input) {
+-+++++++-      input.value = id;
+-+++++++-      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++-      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  function hideDeleteModal() {
+-+++++++-    const modal = document.getElementById('delete-modal');
+-+++++++-    if (modal) {
+-+++++++-      modal.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++++-      modal.classList.remove('flex');
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  async function confirmDelete() {
+-+++++++-    const input = document.getElementById('delete-review-id') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+++++++-    const id = input?.value;
+-+++++++-    if (!id) return;
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-    try {
+-+++++++-      const res = await authFetch(`/api/admin/reviews/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+-+++++++-      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      if (data.success) {
+-+++++++-        toast.success('Review deleted');
+-+++++++-        hideDeleteModal();
+-+++++++-        loadReviews();
+-+++++++-      } else {
+-+++++++-        toast.error(data.error?.message || 'Failed to delete review');
+-+++++++-      }
+-+++++++-    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++-      console.error('Error deleting review:', err);
+-+++++++-      toast.error('Error deleting review');
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  }
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  // Event listeners
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('search-btn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-+++++++-    currentPage = 1;
+-+++++++-    loadReviews();
+-+++++++-  });
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('search-input')?.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
+-+++++++-    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+-+++++++-      currentPage = 1;
+-+++++++-      loadReviews();
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  });
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('rating-filter')?.addEventListener('change', () => {
+-+++++++-    currentPage = 1;
+-+++++++-    loadReviews();
+-+++++++-  });
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('from-date')?.addEventListener('change', () => {
+-+++++++-    currentPage = 1;
+-+++++++-    loadReviews();
+-+++++++-  });
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('to-date')?.addEventListener('change', () => {
+-+++++++-    currentPage = 1;
+-+++++++-    loadReviews();
+-+++++++-  });
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('prev-btn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-+++++++-    if (currentPage > 1) {
+-+++++++-      currentPage--;
+-+++++++-      loadReviews();
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  });
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('next-btn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {

+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('delete-cancel')?.addEventListener('click', hideDeleteModal);

+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  // Close modal on backdrop click
+-+++++++-  document.getElementById('delete-modal')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+++++++-    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) {
+-+++++++-      hideDeleteModal();
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  });
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-  // Initialize
+-+++++++-  loadReviews();

+-+++++++-  // Check current user role
+-+++++++-  async function checkUserRole() {
+-+++++++-    try {
+-+++++++-      const result = await actions.admin.users.getById({ id: 'session-check' }).catch(() => null);
+-+++++++-      // Use direct fetch for session check as getById requires actual user ID
+-+++++++-      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/session');
+-+++++++-      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++-      currentUserRole = data.user?.role || 'user';
+-+++++++-
+-+++++++-      // Show/hide edit buttons based on role
+-+++++++-      const roleSelect = document.getElementById('user-role') as HTMLSelectElement;
+-+++++++-      const roleNote = document.getElementById('role-edit-note');
+-+++++++-      if (currentUserRole === 'super_admin') {
+-+++++++-        if (roleSelect) roleSelect.disabled = false;
+-+++++++-        if (roleNote) roleNote.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++-      } else {
+-+++++++-        if (roleSelect) roleSelect.disabled = true;
+-+++++++-        if (roleNote) roleNote.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++-      }
+-+++++++-    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++-      console.error('Error checking user role:', err);
+-+++++++-    }
+-+++++++-  }

+-+++++++// Astro Server Actions for Admin Non-Profits Management
+-+++++++import { defineAction } from 'astro:actions';
+-+++++++import { z } from 'zod';
+-+++++++import { getDb } from '@/lib/db';
+-+++++++import { nonProfits } from '@/db/schema';
+-+++++++import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
+-+++++++import { getAdminUser } from '@/lib/admin-auth';
+-+++++++import { createErrorResponse, ErrorCode } from '@/lib/errors';
+-+++++++
+-+++++++export const adminNonProfits = {
+-+++++++  // Create a new non-profit (draft status)
+-+++++++  create: defineAction({
+-+++++++    input: z.object({
+-+++++++      title: z.string().min(1),
+-+++++++      slug: z.string().min(1),
+-+++++++      email: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++      contactNumber: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++      aboutUs: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++      latestUpdate: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++    }),
+-+++++++    handler: async (input) => {
+-+++++++      const user = await getAdminUser();
+-+++++++      if (!user) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.AUTH_REQUIRED, 'Authentication required');
+-+++++++      const db = await getDb();
+-+++++++      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-+++++++      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
+-+++++++      const newItem = {
+-+++++++        id: `np-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
+-+++++++        title: input.title,
+-+++++++        slug: input.slug,
+-+++++++        email: input.email || null,
+-+++++++        contactNumber: input.contactNumber || null,
+-+++++++        aboutUs: input.aboutUs || null,
+-+++++++        latestUpdate: input.latestUpdate || null,
+-+++++++        status: 'draft' as const,
+-+++++++        ownerId: user.id,
+-+++++++        createdAt: now,
+-+++++++        updatedAt: now,
+-+++++++      };
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      await db.insert(nonProfits).values(newItem);
+-+++++++      return { success: true, data: { id: newItem.id, slug: newItem.slug } };
+-+++++++    },
+-+++++++  }),
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  // Update a non-profit
+-+++++++  update: defineAction({
+-+++++++    input: z.object({
+-+++++++      id: z.string(),
+-+++++++      title: z.string().min(1).optional(),
+-+++++++      slug: z.string().min(1).optional(),
+-+++++++      email: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++      contactNumber: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++      aboutUs: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++      latestUpdate: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+++++++    }),
+-+++++++    handler: async (input) => {
+-+++++++      const user = await getAdminUser();
+-+++++++      if (!user) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.AUTH_REQUIRED, 'Authentication required');
+-+++++++      const db = await getDb();
+-+++++++      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      const existing = await db.select()
+-+++++++        .from(nonProfits)
+-+++++++        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+++++++        .limit(1)
+-+++++++        .get();
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      if (!existing) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND, 'Non-profit not found');
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = { updatedAt: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) };
+-+++++++      if (input.title !== undefined) updateData.title = input.title;
+-+++++++      if (input.slug !== undefined) updateData.slug = input.slug;
+-+++++++      if (input.email !== undefined) updateData.email = input.email;
+-+++++++      if (input.contactNumber !== undefined) updateData.contactNumber = input.contactNumber;
+-+++++++      if (input.aboutUs !== undefined) updateData.aboutUs = input.aboutUs;
+-+++++++      if (input.latestUpdate !== undefined) updateData.latestUpdate = input.latestUpdate;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      await db.update(nonProfits)
+-+++++++        .set(updateData)
+-+++++++        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+++++++        .run();
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      return { success: true, data: { id: input.id } };
+-+++++++    },
+-+++++++  }),
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  // Update non-profit status
+-+++++++  updateStatus: defineAction({
+-+++++++    input: z.object({
+-+++++++      id: z.string(),
+-+++++++      status: z.enum(['draft', 'active', 'deleted']),
+-+++++++    }),
+-+++++++    handler: async (input) => {
+-+++++++      const user = await getAdminUser();
+-+++++++      if (!user) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.AUTH_REQUIRED, 'Authentication required');
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      const db = await getDb();
+-+++++++      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      const existing = await db.select()
+-+++++++        .from(nonProfits)
+-+++++++        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+++++++        .limit(1)
+-+++++++        .get();
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      if (!existing) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND, 'Non-profit not found');
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      await db.update(nonProfits)
+-+++++++        .set({ status: input.status, updatedAt: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) })
+-+++++++        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+++++++        .run();
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      return { success: true, data: { id: input.id, status: input.status } };
+-+++++++    },
+-+++++++  }),

+-+++++++<script>
+-+++++++  interface Listing {
+-+++++++    id: string;
+-+++++++    title: string | null;
+-+++++++    slug: string | null;
+-+++++++    status: string | null;
+-+++++++    price: string | null;
+-+++++++    createdAt: number | null;
+-+++++++    planExpiresAt: number | null;
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
+-+++++++    return fetch(url, {
+-+++++++      ...options,
+-+++++++      credentials: 'include',
+-+++++++      headers: {
+-+++++++        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+++++++        ...options.headers,
+-+++++++      },
+-+++++++    });
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  const statusFilter = document.getElementById('filter-status') as HTMLSelectElement | null;
+-+++++++  const searchInput = document.getElementById('search') as HTMLInputElement | null;
+-+++++++  const tbody = document.getElementById('listings-body') as HTMLTableSectionElement | null;
+-+++++++  const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results') as HTMLDivElement | null;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  let listings: Listing[] = [];
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function formatDate(ts: number | null): string {
+-+++++++    return ts ? new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A';
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function loadListings() {
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing');
+-+++++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++      if (data.success) {
+-+++++++        listings = data.data || [];
+-+++++++        updateStats();
+-+++++++        renderListings();
+-+++++++      } else {
+-+++++++        console.error('API error:', data.error);
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++      console.error('Failed to load listings:', err);
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function updateStats() {
+-+++++++    const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-+++++++    const total = listings.length;
+-+++++++    const published = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'published' || l.status === 'active').length;
+-+++++++    const draft = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'draft').length;
+-+++++++    const expired = listings.filter(l => l.planExpiresAt && l.planExpiresAt < now).length;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const el = (id: string) => document.getElementById(id);
+-+++++++    (el('stat-total') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(total);
+-+++++++    (el('stat-published') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(published);
+-+++++++    (el('stat-draft') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(draft);
+-+++++++    (el('stat-expired') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(expired);
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function renderListings() {
+-+++++++    if (!tbody) return;
+-+++++++    const search = searchInput?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+++++++    const status = statusFilter?.value || '';
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const filtered = listings.filter(l => {
+-+++++++      if (search && !(l.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ?? false)) return false;
+-+++++++      if (status) {
+-+++++++        if (status === 'published') {
+-+++++++          if (l.status !== 'published' && l.status !== 'active') return false;
+-+++++++        } else if (l.status !== status) {
+-+++++++          return false;
+-+++++++        }
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++      return true;
+-+++++++    });
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+++++++      tbody.innerHTML = '';
+-+++++++      noResults?.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++      return;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    noResults?.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-+++++++    tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(listing => {
+-+++++++      const isExpired = listing.planExpiresAt && listing.planExpiresAt < now;
+-+++++++      const effectiveStatus = isExpired ? 'expired' : (listing.status === 'active' ? 'published' : listing.status);
+-+++++++      const statusColors: Record<string, string> = {
+-+++++++        published: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400',
+-+++++++        expired: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
+-+++++++        draft: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300',
+-+++++++      };
+-+++++++      const colorClass = statusColors[effectiveStatus || 'draft'] || statusColors.draft;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      return `
+-+++++++        <tr class="hover:bg-muted/30">
+-+++++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">
+-+++++++            <div class="font-medium">${listing.title || 'Untitled'}</div>
+-+++++++            <div class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Created ${formatDate(listing.createdAt)}</div>
+-+++++++          </td>
+-+++++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">
+-+++++++            <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${colorClass}">${effectiveStatus || 'draft'}</span>
+-+++++++          </td>
+-+++++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">${listing.price || '-'}</td>
+-+++++++          <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
+-+++++++            <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
+-+++++++              <a href="/admin/listings/${listing.id}/edit" data-action="edit-listing" data-id="${listing.id}" class="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">Edit</a>
+-+++++++              <button data-action="toggle-status" data-id="${listing.id}" data-status="${effectiveStatus}" class="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">
+-+++++++                ${effectiveStatus === 'published' ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
+-+++++++              </button>
+-+++++++              <button data-action="delete-listing" data-id="${listing.id}" class="text-sm text-red-500 hover:underline">Delete</button>
+-+++++++              ${listing.slug ? `<a href="/listing/${listing.slug}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">View</a>` : ''}
+-+++++++            </div>
+-+++++++          </td>
+-+++++++        </tr>
+-+++++++      `;
+-+++++++    }).join('');
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function handleToggleStatus(id: string, currentStatus: string) {
+-+++++++    const newStatus = currentStatus === 'published' ? 'draft' : 'published';
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-+++++++        method: 'PUT',
+-+++++++        body: JSON.stringify({ id, status: newStatus }),
+-+++++++      });
+-+++++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++      if (data.success) loadListings();
+-+++++++      else alert('Failed to update listing');
+-+++++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++      console.error('Error:', err);
+-+++++++      alert('Failed to update listing');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function handleDeleteListing(id: string) {
+-+++++++    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this listing?')) return;
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-+++++++        method: 'DELETE',
+-+++++++        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
+-+++++++      });
+-+++++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++      if (data.success) loadListings();
+-+++++++      else alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-+++++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++      console.error('Error:', err);
+-+++++++      alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+++++++    const btn = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-+++++++    const actionEl = btn.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
+-+++++++    if (!actionEl) return;
+-+++++++    const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
+-+++++++    const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-+++++++    const status = actionEl.dataset.status;
+-+++++++    switch (action) {
+-+++++++      case 'edit-listing':
+-+++++++        window.location.href = `/admin/listings/${id}/edit`;
+-+++++++        break;
+-+++++++      case 'toggle-status':
+-+++++++        handleToggleStatus(id!, status!);
+-+++++++        break;
+-+++++++      case 'delete-listing':
+-+++++++        handleDeleteListing(id!);
+-+++++++        break;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  });
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  statusFilter?.addEventListener('change', renderListings);
+-+++++++  searchInput?.addEventListener('input', renderListings);
+-+++++++</script>

+-+++++++      </select>
+-+++++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-price-field" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 p-1" ${isFirst ? 'style="visibility:hidden"' : ''}>
+-+++++++        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
+-+++++++          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
+-+++++++        </svg>
+-+++++++      </button>
+-+++++++    </div>`;
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function buildPriceFieldsHtml(productType: string, existingFields: {label: string; value: string; unit: string}[]): string {
+-+++++++    const units = getPriceUnitsForServiceType(productType);
+-+++++++    if (existingFields.length === 0) existingFields.push({ label: '', value: '', unit: '' });
+-+++++++    return existingFields.map((field, idx) => buildPriceFieldRow(idx, field, units)).join('');
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function buildNewPriceFieldHtml(productType: string, count: number): string {
+-+++++++    const units = getPriceUnitsForServiceType(productType);
+-+++++++    return `<div class="flex gap-2 items-center price-field-row" data-index="${count}">
+-+++++++      <input type="text" name="priceLabel_${count}" placeholder="Label (e.g., Weekend Rate)" class="flex-1 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" />
+-+++++++      <input type="number" name="priceValue_${count}" placeholder="0.00" class="w-20 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" step="0.01" />
+-+++++++      <select name="priceUnit_${count}" class="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs bg-background">
+-+++++++        ${units.map(u => `<option value="${u.value}">${escapeHtml(u.label)}</option>`).join('')}
+-+++++++      </select>
+-+++++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-price-field" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 p-1">
+-+++++++        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
+-+++++++          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
+-+++++++        </svg>
+-+++++++      </button>
+-+++++++    </div>`;
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function buildSpecFieldHtml(field: {key: string; type: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; options?: string[]}, value: string): string {
+-+++++++    const id = `spec-${field.key}`;
+-+++++++    const escapedValue = escapeHtml(Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(', ') : value);
+-+++++++    if (field.type === 'text') {
+-+++++++      return `<div>
+-+++++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+++++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-+++++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+++++++      </div>`;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++    if (field.type === 'number') {
+-+++++++      return `<div>
+-+++++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++++        <input type="number" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+++++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-+++++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+++++++      </div>`;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++    if (field.type === 'select') {
+-+++++++      return `<div>
+-+++++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++++        <select id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm bg-background">
+-+++++++          <option value="">Select...</option>
+-+++++++          ${(field.options || []).map((opt: string) => `<option value="${opt}" ${value === opt ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(opt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + opt.slice(1).replace('_', ' '))}</option>`).join('')}
+-+++++++        </select>
+-+++++++      </div>`;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++    if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
+-+++++++      return `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-+++++++        <input type="checkbox" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="true" ${value ? 'checked' : ''} class="w-4 h-4" />
+-+++++++        <label for="${id}" class="text-sm">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++++      </div>`;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++    if (field.type === 'tags') {
+-+++++++      return `<div>
+-+++++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+++++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : 'Comma separated values'}"
+-+++++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+++++++        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Separate with commas</p>
+-+++++++      </div>`;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++    return '';
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function buildSkuItemHtml(sku: any, priceDisplay: string, businessName: string): string {
+-+++++++    const typeClass = sku.productType === 'product'
+-+++++++      ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200'
+-+++++++      : 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200';
+-+++++++    const typeLabel = sku.productType || 'product';
+-+++++++    return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 md:p-3 border rounded text-sm hover:bg-muted/30">
+-+++++++      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-+++++++        <p class="font-medium truncate">${escapeHtml(sku.title || 'Untitled')}</p>
+-+++++++        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${escapeHtml(priceDisplay)} - ${escapeHtml(businessName)}</p>
+-+++++++      </div>
+-+++++++      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-+++++++        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${typeClass}">${typeLabel}</span>
+-+++++++        <button data-action="edit-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-primary hover:text-primary/80 text-xs px-2 py-1">Edit</button>
+-+++++++        <button data-action="delete-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 text-xs px-2 py-1">Del</button>
+-+++++++      </div>
+-+++++++    </div>`;
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function buildMediaThumbnailHtml(mediaId: string, mediaUrl: string, isVideo: boolean): string {
+-+++++++    const mediaHtml = isVideo
+-+++++++      ? `<video src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" muted /><div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"><svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></div>`
+-+++++++      : `<img src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" />`;
+-+++++++    return `<div class="relative aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
+-+++++++      ${mediaHtml}
+-+++++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-media" data-media-id="${mediaId}" class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full text-xs">x</button>
+-+++++++    </div>`;
+-+++++++  }

+-+++++++  // =============================================================================
+-+++++++  // EVENT DELEGATION
+-+++++++  // =============================================================================
+-+++++++  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+++++++    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-+++++++    const actionEl = target.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
+-+++++++    if (!actionEl) return;
+-+++++++    const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
+-+++++++    if (!action) return;
+-+++++++    switch (action) {
+-+++++++      case 'remove-price-field':
+-+++++++        actionEl.closest('.price-field-row')?.remove();
+-+++++++        break;
+-+++++++      case 'remove-media': {
+-+++++++        const mediaId = actionEl.dataset.mediaId;
+-+++++++        if (mediaId) {
+-+++++++          skuMediaIds = skuMediaIds.filter(id => id !== mediaId);
+-+++++++          actionEl.closest('.relative.aspect-square')?.remove();
+-+++++++          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
+-+++++++        }
+-+++++++        break;
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++      case 'edit-sku': {
+-+++++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-+++++++        if (id) editSKU(id);
+-+++++++        break;
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++      case 'delete-sku': {
+-+++++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-+++++++        if (id) deleteSKU(id);
+-+++++++        break;
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  });

+-+++++++  async function handleSkuImageUpload(files: FileList) {
+-+++++++    const preview = document.getElementById('sku-image-preview')!;
+-+++++++    const uploadArea = document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')!;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    for (const file of files) {
+-+++++++      if (skuMediaIds.length >= 4) break;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      const isImage = IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-+++++++      const isVideo = VIDEO_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-+++++++      if (!isImage && !isVideo) continue;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
+-+++++++        alert(`Image too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 2MB`);
+-+++++++        continue;
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++      if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
+-+++++++        alert(`Video too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 8MB`);
+-+++++++        continue;
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      let fileToUpload = file;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      if (isVideo) {
+-+++++++        const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++        statusDiv.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs rounded-lg z-10';
+-+++++++        statusDiv.textContent = 'Processing...';
+-+++++++        uploadArea.style.position = 'relative';
+-+++++++        uploadArea.appendChild(statusDiv);
+-+++++++
+-+++++++        try {
+-+++++++          const { compressVideo } = await import('@/lib/video-compress');
+-+++++++          const result = await compressVideo(file, {
+-+++++++            maxSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
+-+++++++            onProgress: (p: {message: string}) => { statusDiv.textContent = p.message; }
+-+++++++          });
+-+++++++
+-+++++++          if (!result.withinLimit) {
+-+++++++            alert('Video still too large after compression');
+-+++++++            statusDiv.remove();
+-+++++++            continue;
+-+++++++          }
+-+++++++          fileToUpload = result.file;
+-+++++++          statusDiv.textContent = 'Uploading...';
+-+++++++        } catch (err) {
+-+++++++          console.error('Video compression error:', err);
+-+++++++          statusDiv.remove();
+-+++++++          alert('Video processing failed');
+-+++++++          continue;
+-+++++++        }
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      try {
+-+++++++        const result = await actions.media.uploadMedia({ file: fileToUpload, category: 'sku' });
+-+++++++        if (result.success && result.data?.id) {
+-+++++++          skuMediaIds.push(result.data.id);
+-+++++++          preview.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', buildMediaThumbnailHtml(result.data.id, result.data.url, isVideo));
+-+++++++          preview.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
+-+++++++        }
+-+++++++      } catch (err) {
+-+++++++        console.error('Upload error:', err);
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-+++++++    document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.click();
+-+++++++  });
+-+++++++  document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
+-+++++++    const files = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).files;
+-+++++++    if (files) handleSkuImageUpload(files);
+-+++++++    (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++++  });

+-+++++++  async function initEditor(initialContent = '') {
+-+++++++    const loaded = await loadEditor();
+-+++++++    if (!loaded || !Editor) return null;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const element = document.querySelector('#tiptap-editor');
+-+++++++    if (!element) return null;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    if (editor) editor.destroy();
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    editor = new Editor({
+-+++++++      element,
+-+++++++      extensions: [
+-+++++++        StarterKit,
+-+++++++        Underline,
+-+++++++        PlaceholderExt.configure({
+-+++++++          placeholder: (element as HTMLElement).dataset.placeholder || 'Start writing...',
+-+++++++        }),
+-+++++++      ],
+-+++++++      content: initialContent,
+-+++++++      immediatelyRender: false,
+-+++++++      onUpdate: ({ editor }) => {
+-+++++++        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+++++++        if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = editor.getHTML();
+-+++++++      },
+-+++++++    });
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+++++++    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = initialContent;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    return editor;
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function setupToolbar() {
+-+++++++    document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach(btn => {
+-+++++++      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-+++++++        if (!editor) return;
+-+++++++        const command = (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.command;
+-+++++++        const level = (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.level;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++        if (command === 'toggleHeading' && level) {
+-+++++++          editor.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: parseInt(level) }).run();
+-+++++++        } else if (command === 'undo') {
+-+++++++          editor.chain().focus().undo().run();
+-+++++++        } else if (command === 'redo') {
+-+++++++          editor.chain().focus().redo().run();
+-+++++++        } else if (command) {
+-+++++++          const cmd = (editor.chain().focus() as any)[command];
+-+++++++          if (typeof cmd?.run === 'function') cmd.run();
+-+++++++        }
+-+++++++      });
+-+++++++    });
+-+++++++  }

+-+++++++      `<option value="${b.value}" ${b.value === selectedId ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(b.label)}</option>`
+-+++++++    ).join('');
+-+++++++    select.innerHTML = '<option value="">Select a business...</option>' + opts;
+-+++++++  }

+-+++++++  function renderSpecificationFields(productType = 'product', existingSpecs: Record<string, any> = {}) {
+-+++++++    const container = document.getElementById('specifications-container');

+-+++++++    if (!container || !fieldsContainer) return;
+-+++++++    const fields = productConfig.getSpecificationFields(productType) || [];
+-+++++++    if (fields.length === 0) { container.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
+-+++++++    container.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++    fieldsContainer.innerHTML = fields.map((field: any) => buildSpecFieldHtml(field, existingSpecs[field.key] || '')).join('');
+-+++++++  }

+-+++++++  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}) {
+-+++++++    return fetch(url, {
+-+++++++      ...options,
+-+++++++      credentials: 'include',
+-+++++++      headers: {
+-+++++++        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+++++++        ...options.headers,
+-+++++++      },
+-+++++++    });
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  interface SkuWindow extends Window { allSkus?: any[] }
+-+++++++  (window as SkuWindow).allSkus = [];
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function loadSKUs() {
+-+++++++    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
+-+++++++    const businessFilter = document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement | null;
+-+++++++    if (!container) return;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    if (businessFilter) {
+-+++++++      const opts = businessOptions.map((b: {value: string; label: string}) =>
+-+++++++        `<option value="${b.value}">${escapeHtml(b.label)}</option>`
+-+++++++      ).join('');
+-+++++++      businessFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Businesses</option>' + opts;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/skus');
+-+++++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++      if (!data.success) {
+-+++++++        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Failed to load SKUs</p>';
+-+++++++        return;
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++      (window as SkuWindow).allSkus = data.data || [];
+-+++++++      renderSkus();
+-+++++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++      console.error('Error loading SKUs:', err);
+-+++++++      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Error loading SKUs</p>';
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function renderSkus() {
+-+++++++    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
+-+++++++    const countEl = document.getElementById('skus-count');
+-+++++++    if (!container) return;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+++++++    const businessFilter = (document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++++    const typeFilter = (document.getElementById('type-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const bizMap = new Map(businessOptions.map((b: {value: string; label: string}) => [b.value, b.label]));
+-+++++++    const allSkus = (window as SkuWindow).allSkus || [];
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const filtered = allSkus.filter((sku: any) => {
+-+++++++      const matchesSearch = !search || (sku.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search));
+-+++++++      const matchesBusiness = !businessFilter || sku.businessId === businessFilter;
+-+++++++      const matchesType = !typeFilter || sku.productType === typeFilter;
+-+++++++      return matchesSearch && matchesBusiness && matchesType;
+-+++++++    });
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} of ${allSkus.length} SKUs`;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+++++++      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No SKUs found</p>';
+-+++++++      return;
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    container.innerHTML = filtered.map((sku: any) => {
+-+++++++      let priceDisplay = 'Ask for price';
+-+++++++      try {
+-+++++++        const fields = sku.priceFields ? JSON.parse(sku.priceFields) : [];
+-+++++++        if (fields.length > 0 && fields[0].value) {
+-+++++++          const unit = fields[0].unit ? ` / ${fields[0].unit.replace('/', '')}` : '';
+-+++++++          priceDisplay = `$${fields[0].value}${unit}`;
+-+++++++        }
+-+++++++      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
+-+++++++      return buildSkuItemHtml(sku, priceDisplay, bizMap.get(sku.businessId) || 'Unknown');
+-+++++++    }).join('');
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function editSKU(id: string) {
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`);
+-+++++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++++      if (!data.id) { alert('SKU not found'); return; }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      editingId = id;
+-+++++++      document.getElementById('modal-title')!.textContent = 'Edit SKU';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('sku-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = id;
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('sku-title') as HTMLInputElement).value = data.title || '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('sku-business') as HTMLSelectElement).value = data.businessId || '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('sku-service-type') as HTMLSelectElement).value = data.productType || 'product';
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      let priceFields: any[] = [];
+-+++++++      try { priceFields = data.priceFields ? JSON.parse(data.priceFields) : []; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
+-+++++++      renderPriceFields(data.productType || 'product', priceFields);
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      let specifications: Record<string, any> = {};
+-+++++++      try { specifications = data.specifications ? JSON.parse(data.specifications) : {}; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++      initEditor(data.description || '');
+-+++++++      renderSpecificationFields(data.productType || 'product', specifications);
+-+++++++      openModal();
+-+++++++      setupToolbar();
+-+++++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++++      console.error('Error loading SKU:', err);
+-+++++++      alert('Failed to load SKU');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function deleteSKU(id: string) {
+-+++++++    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this SKU?')) return;
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+-+++++++      if (res.ok) { loadSKUs(); } else { alert('Failed to delete SKU'); }
+-+++++++    } catch (err) { alert('Failed to delete SKU'); }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function openModal() {
+-+++++++    const modal = document.getElementById('sku-modal');
+-+++++++    modal?.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++    modal?.classList.add('flex');
+-+++++++    setTimeout(() => (editor as any)?.commands.focus(), 100);
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function closeModal() {
+-+++++++    const modal = document.getElementById('sku-modal');
+-+++++++    modal?.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++++    modal?.classList.remove('flex');
+-+++++++    editingId = null;
+-+++++++    document.getElementById('sku-form')?.reset();
+-+++++++    (document.getElementById('sku-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++++    document.getElementById('modal-title')!.textContent = 'Create SKU';
+-+++++++    if (editor) editor.commands.clearContent();
+-+++++++    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+++++++    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = '';
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  document.getElementById('add-product-btn')?.addEventListener('click', () => {

+-+++++++      const key = `spec_${field.key}`;
+-+++++++      if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
+-+++++++        specifications[field.key] = formData.get(key) === 'true';
+-+++++++      } else if (field.type === 'tags') {
+-+++++++        const val = formData.get(key);
+-+++++++        specifications[field.key] = val ? (val as string).split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(v => v) : [];
+-+++++++      } else {
+-+++++++        const val = formData.get(key);
+-+++++++        if (val) specifications[field.key] = field.type === 'number' ? Number(val) : val;

+-+++++++      businessId: formData.get('businessId'),
+-+++++++      productType,
+-+++++++      priceFields: priceFields.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(priceFields) : null,
+-+++++++      specifications: Object.keys(specifications).length > 0 ? specifications : null,
+-+++++++      description,

+-+++++++        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+-+++++++        body: JSON.stringify(skuData),
+-+++++++      });

+-+++++++<script>
+-+++++++  import { toast } from '@/lib/toast';
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  interface PackageVariant {
+-+++++++    id: string;
+-+++++++    name: string;
+-+++++++    price: number;
+-+++++++    currency: string;
+-+++++++    durationValue: number;
+-+++++++    durationUnit: string;
+-+++++++    limits: {
+-+++++++      skuLimit?: number;
+-+++++++      maxImages?: number;
+-+++++++      maxVideos?: number;
+-+++++++      maxBusinessImages?: number;
+-+++++++      maxBusinessVideos?: number;
+-+++++++    };
+-+++++++    features: string[];
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  interface ServicePackageData {
+-+++++++    id: string;
+-+++++++    name: string;
+-+++++++    slug: string;
+-+++++++    serviceRelationTo: string;
+-+++++++    description: string | null;
+-+++++++    variants: PackageVariant[];
+-+++++++    isActive: boolean;
+-+++++++    sortOrder: number;
+-+++++++    createdAt: number | null;
+-+++++++    updatedAt: number | null;
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  const packagesData: ServicePackageData[] = JSON.parse(
+-+++++++    document.getElementById('sp-packages-data')?.textContent || '[]'
+-+++++++  );
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  let packages: ServicePackageData[] = packagesData;
+-+++++++  let deleteTargetId: string | null = null;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function escapeHtml(text: string): string {
+-+++++++    const div = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++++    div.textContent = text;
+-+++++++    return div.innerHTML;
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function closeModal() {
+-+++++++    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+++++++    if (modal) {
+-+++++++      modal.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++++      modal.classList.remove('flex');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function hideDeleteConfirm() {
+-+++++++    deleteTargetId = null;
+-+++++++    const modal = document.getElementById('delete-modal');
+-+++++++    if (modal) {
+-+++++++      modal.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++++      modal.classList.remove('flex');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function showDeleteConfirm(planId: string) {
+-+++++++    deleteTargetId = planId;
+-+++++++    const modal = document.getElementById('delete-modal');
+-+++++++    if (modal) {
+-+++++++      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function openEditModal(pkg: ServicePackageData) {
+-+++++++    const firstVariant = pkg.variants[0] || {};
+-+++++++    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+++++++    const title = document.getElementById('modal-title');
+-+++++++    const modeInput = document.getElementById('plan-mode') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+++++++    const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('delete-plan-btn');
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    if (modeInput) modeInput.value = 'edit';
+-+++++++    if (title) title.textContent = `Edit ${pkg.name}`;
+-+++++++    if (deleteBtn) {
+-+++++++      deleteBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++      deleteBtn.onclick = () => showDeleteConfirm(pkg.id);
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const form = document.getElementById('plan-form') as HTMLFormElement;
+-+++++++    if (form) {
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = pkg.id;
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-name') as HTMLInputElement).value = pkg.name;
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-amount') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.price || 0);
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-skuLimit') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.skuLimit || 0);
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxImages || 0);
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxVideos || 0);
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxBusinessImages || 0);
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxBusinessVideos || 0);
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-sortOrder') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(pkg.sortOrder || 0);
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-description') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = pkg.description || '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-features') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = (firstVariant.features || []).join('\n');
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-active') as HTMLInputElement).checked = Boolean(pkg.isActive);
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    if (modal) {
+-+++++++      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++++      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  function openCreateModal() {
+-+++++++    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+++++++    const title = document.getElementById('modal-title');
+-+++++++    const modeInput = document.getElementById('plan-mode') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+++++++    const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('delete-plan-btn');
+-+++++++    const form = document.getElementById('plan-form') as HTMLFormElement;
+-+++++++

+-+++++++

+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-name') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-amount') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-skuLimit') as HTMLInputElement).value = '10';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = '5';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = '1';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = '16';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = '2';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-sortOrder') as HTMLInputElement).value = '0';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-description') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-features') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = '';
+-+++++++      (document.getElementById('plan-active') as HTMLInputElement).checked = true;

+-+++++++      modal.classList.add('flex');

+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function deletePlan(planId: string) {
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      const result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.delete({ id: planId });
+-+++++++      if (result.success) {
+-+++++++        hideDeleteConfirm();
+-+++++++        closeModal();
+-+++++++        toast.success('Plan deleted');
+-+++++++        window.location.reload();
+-+++++++      } else {
+-+++++++        toast.error(result.error?.message || 'Failed to delete plan');
+-+++++++      }
+-+++++++    } catch (e) {
+-+++++++      console.error('Failed to delete plan:', e);
+-+++++++      toast.error('Failed to delete plan');
+-+++++++    }
+-+++++++  }
+-+++++++
+-+++++++  async function savePlan(formData: FormData) {
+-+++++++    const mode = formData.get('mode') as string;
+-+++++++    const id = formData.get('id') as string;
+-+++++++    const featuresText = formData.get('features') as string;
+-+++++++    const features = featuresText.split('\n').filter(f => f.trim());
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    const variant = {
+-+++++++      name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+++++++      price: parseFloat(formData.get('amount') as string) || 0,
+-+++++++      currency: 'USD',
+-+++++++      durationValue: 1,
+-+++++++      durationUnit: 'month',
+-+++++++      limits: {
+-+++++++        skuLimit: parseInt(formData.get('skuLimit') as string) || 0,
+-+++++++        maxImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxImages') as string) || 0,
+-+++++++        maxVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+++++++        maxBusinessImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessImages') as string) || 0,
+-+++++++        maxBusinessVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+++++++      },
+-+++++++      features: features,
+-+++++++    };
+-+++++++
+-+++++++    try {
+-+++++++      let result;
+-+++++++      if (mode === 'edit' && id) {
+-+++++++        const existingPkg = packages.find(p => p.id === id);
+-+++++++        const variants = existingPkg?.variants || [variant];
+-+++++++        variants[0] = variant;
+-+++++++
+-+++++++        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.update({
+-+++++++          id,
+-+++++++          name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+++++++          description: formData.get('description') as string,
+-+++++++          variants: variants,
+-+++++++          isActive: formData.get('active') === 'on',
+-+++++++          sortOrder: parseInt(formData.get('sortOrder') as string) || 0,
+-+++++++        });
+-+++++++      } else {
+-+++++++        const serviceRelationTo = (formData.get('serviceRelationTo') as string) || 'business';
+-+++++++        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.create({
