+-+++++-    id: string;
+-+++++-    title: string;
+-+++++-    slug: string;
+-+++++-    email?: string;
+-+++++-    contactNumber?: string;
+-+++++-    aboutUs?: string;

+-+++++-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+++++-  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
+-+++++-    return fetch(url, {
+-+++++-      ...options,
+-+++++-      credentials: 'include',
+-+++++-      headers: {
+-+++++-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+++++-        ...options.headers,
+-+++++-      },
+-+++++-    });
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  let businessList: PublicSectorData[] = [];
+-+++++-  let aboutContent = '';
+-+++++-  let updatesContent = '';
+-+++++-  let editingId: string | null = null;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  // Load public-sectors
+-+++++-  async function loadPublicSectorores() {
+-+++++-    try {
+-+++++-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/public-sectors');
+-+++++-      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++-
+-+++++-      const container = document.getElementById('list');
+-+++++-      const countEl = document.getElementById('count');
+-+++++-      if (!container) return;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-      if (!data.success || data.data.length === 0) {
+-+++++-        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No public-sectors yet</p>';
+-+++++-        if (countEl) countEl.textContent = '0 public-sectors';
+-+++++-        return;
+-+++++-      }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-      businessList = data.data;
+-+++++-      renderPublicSectorores();
+-+++++-    } catch (err) {
+-+++++-      console.error('Error loading public-sectors:', err);
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  // Render public-sectors with filters
+-+++++-  function renderPublicSectorores() {
+-+++++-    const container = document.getElementById('list');
+-+++++-    const countEl = document.getElementById('count');
+-+++++-    if (!container) return;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+++++-    const status = (document.getElementById('status-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    const filtered = businessList.filter(biz => {
+-+++++-      const matchesSearch = !search ||
+-+++++-        biz.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
+-+++++-        biz.slug?.toLowerCase().includes(search);
+-+++++-      const matchesStatus = !status || biz.status === status;
+-+++++-      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
+-+++++-    });
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} of ${businessList.length} public-sectors`;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+++++-      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No public-sectors found</p>';
+-+++++-      return;
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    container.innerHTML = filtered.map((biz) => `
+-+++++-      <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 md:p-3 border rounded text-sm hover:bg-muted/30">
+-+++++-        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-+++++-          <p class="font-medium truncate">${escapeHtml(biz.title)}</p>
+-+++++-          <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">/${escapeHtml(biz.slug)}</p>
+-+++++-        </div>
+-+++++-        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-2">
+-+++++-          <button class="text-xs px-2 py-1 border rounded hover:bg-muted" data-action="edit" data-id="${biz.id}">Edit</button>
+-+++++-          <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${biz.status === 'live' || biz.status === 'paid' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-200' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200'}">${capitalizeFirst(biz.status)}</span>
+-+++++-          <select class="text-xs border rounded px-1 py-0.5 bg-background" data-action="status-update" data-id="${biz.id}">
+-+++++-            <option value="draft" ${biz.status === 'draft' ? 'selected' : ''}>Draft</option>
+-+++++-            <option value="live" ${biz.status === 'live' ? 'selected' : ''}>Live</option>
+-+++++-            <option value="paid" ${biz.status === 'paid' ? 'selected' : ''}>Paid</option>
+-+++++-            <option value="expired" ${biz.status === 'expired' ? 'selected' : ''}>Expired</option>
+-+++++-          </select>
+-+++++-        </div>
+-+++++-      </div>
+-+++++-    `).join('');
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  function escapeHtml(str: string): string {
+-+++++-    return str.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  function capitalizeFirst(str: string | null | undefined): string {
+-+++++-    if (!str) return '-';
+-+++++-    return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-

+-+++++-    aboutTextarea.placeholder = 'Write about your public sector...';

+-+++++-    period: string;

+-+++++-  interface PlanData {
+-+++++-    editPlan?: (planId: string) => void;
+-+++++-    createPlan?: () => void;
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+++++-  async function authFetch(url, options = {}) {
+-+++++-    return fetch(url, {
+-+++++-      ...options,
+-+++++-      credentials: 'include',
+-+++++-      headers: {
+-+++++-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+++++-        ...options.headers,
+-+++++-      },
+-+++++-    });
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  let plans: Plan[] = [];
+-+++++-  let currentUserRole: string = '';
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  // Check auth and role
+-+++++-  async function checkAuth() {
+-+++++-    try {
+-+++++-      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/session', { credentials: 'include' });
+-+++++-      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++-      if (data.user) {
+-+++++-        currentUserRole = data.user.role || '';
+-+++++-        // Show/hide Add Plan button based on role
+-+++++-        const addBtn = document.getElementById('add-plan-btn');
+-+++++-        if (addBtn) {
+-+++++-          addBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', currentUserRole !== 'super_admin');
+-+++++-        }
+-+++++-      }
+-+++++-    } catch (e) {
+-+++++-      console.error('Auth check failed:', e);
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  async function loadPlans() {
+-+++++-    try {
+-+++++-      const result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.getAll();
+-+++++-
+-+++++-      if (result.success && result.data) {
+-+++++-        plans = result.data;
+-+++++-        renderPlans();
+-+++++-        updateStats();
+-+++++-      } else {
+-+++++-        showError(result.error?.message || 'Failed to load plans');
+-+++++-      }
+-+++++-    } catch (e) {
+-+++++-      console.error('Failed to load plans:', e);
+-+++++-      showError('Failed to load plans');
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  function renderPlans() {
+-+++++-    const tbody = document.getElementById('plans-list');
+-+++++-    if (!tbody) return;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (plans.length === 0) {
+-+++++-      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center p-8 text-muted-foreground">No packages found</td></tr>';
+-+++++-      return;
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    const canEdit = currentUserRole === 'super_admin';
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    tbody.innerHTML = plans.map(pkg => {
+-+++++-      const firstVariant = pkg.variants?.[0] || {};
+-+++++-      const durationUnit = firstVariant.durationUnit || 'month';
+-+++++-      const price = firstVariant.price || 0;
+-+++++-      const skuLimit = firstVariant.limits?.skuLimit ?? '-';
+-+++++-      const maxImages = firstVariant.limits?.maxImages ?? '-';
+-+++++-      const maxVideos = firstVariant.limits?.maxVideos ?? '-';
+-+++++-      const variantCount = pkg.variants?.length || 0;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-      return `
+-+++++-      <tr class="border-t hover:bg-muted/50">
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3">
+-+++++-          <div class="font-medium">${escapeHtml(pkg.name)}</div>
+-+++++-          <div class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${escapeHtml(pkg.slug)}</div>
+-+++++-        </td>
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3 hidden md:table-cell">
+-+++++-          <Badge variant="purple" size="sm">
+-+++++-            ${pkg.serviceType}
+-+++++-          </Badge>
+-+++++-        </td>
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3 font-semibold">$${price}</td>
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3 hidden lg:table-cell">${skuLimit}</td>
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3 hidden lg:table-cell">${maxImages}</td>
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3 hidden lg:table-cell">${variantCount} variant${variantCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</td>
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3 text-center">
+-+++++-          <Badge variant={pkg.isActive ? 'success' : 'secondary'} size="sm">
+-+++++-            {pkg.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
+-+++++-          </Badge>
+-+++++-        </td>
+-+++++-        <td class="p-3 text-right">
+-+++++-          ${canEdit ? `<button data-action="edit-plan" data-plan-id="${pkg.id}" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-sm font-medium transition-colors rounded-md px-2 py-1">Edit</button>` : '<span class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">View only</span>'}
+-+++++-        </td>
+-+++++-    `}).join('');
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  function updateStats() {
+-+++++-    const total = plans.length;
+-+++++-    const subscriptions = plans.filter(p => p.serviceType === 'subscription').length;
+-+++++-    const listings = plans.filter(p => p.serviceType === 'listing_renewal').length;
+-+++++-    const active = plans.filter(p => p.isActive).length;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    const statTotal = document.getElementById('stat-total');
+-+++++-    const statMonthly = document.getElementById('stat-monthly');
+-+++++-    const statYearly = document.getElementById('stat-yearly');
+-+++++-    const statActive = document.getElementById('stat-active');
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (statTotal) statTotal.textContent = String(total);
+-+++++-    if (statMonthly) statMonthly.textContent = String(subscriptions);
+-+++++-    if (statYearly) statYearly.textContent = String(listings);
+-+++++-    if (statActive) statActive.textContent = String(active);
+-+++++-  }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  (window as PlanData).editPlan = function(planId: string) {
+-+++++-    const pkg = plans.find(p => p.id === planId);
+-+++++-    if (!pkg) return;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    const firstVariant = pkg.variants?.[0] || {};
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+++++-    const title = document.getElementById('modal-title');
+-+++++-    const modeInput = document.getElementById('plan-mode') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+++++-    const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('delete-plan-btn');
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (modeInput) modeInput.value = 'edit';
+-+++++-    if (title) title.textContent = `Edit ${pkg.name}`;
+-+++++-    if (deleteBtn) {
+-+++++-      deleteBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++-      deleteBtn.onclick = () => showDeleteConfirm(planId);
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    const form = document.getElementById('plan-form') as HTMLFormElement;
+-+++++-    if (form) {
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = pkg.id;
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-name') as HTMLInputElement).value = pkg.name;
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-amount') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.price || 0);
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-skuLimit') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.skuLimit || 0);
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxImages || 0);
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxVideos || 0);
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxBusinessImages || 0);
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxBusinessVideos || 0);
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-sortOrder') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(pkg.sortOrder || 0);
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-description') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = pkg.description || '';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-features') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = (firstVariant.features || []).join('\n');
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-active') as HTMLInputElement).checked = Boolean(pkg.isActive);
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (modal) {
+-+++++-      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++-      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-  };
+-+++++-
+-+++++-  (window as PlanData).createPlan = function() {
+-+++++-    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+++++-    const title = document.getElementById('modal-title');
+-+++++-    const modeInput = document.getElementById('plan-mode') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+++++-    const periodField = document.getElementById('period-field');
+-+++++-    const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('delete-plan-btn');
+-+++++-    const form = document.getElementById('plan-form') as HTMLFormElement;
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (modeInput) modeInput.value = 'create';
+-+++++-    if (title) title.textContent = 'Create Plan';
+-+++++-    if (periodField) periodField.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++-    if (deleteBtn) deleteBtn.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (form) {
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-name') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-period') as HTMLSelectElement).value = 'monthly';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-amount') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-skuLimit') as HTMLInputElement).value = '10';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = '5';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = '1';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = '16';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = '2';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-sortOrder') as HTMLInputElement).value = '0';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-description') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = '';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-features') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = '';
+-+++++-      (document.getElementById('plan-active') as HTMLInputElement).checked = true;
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    if (modal) {
+-+++++-      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++-      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+++++-    }
+-+++++-  };
+-+++++-

+-+++++-  async function deletePlan(planId: string) {

+-+++++-
+-+++++-  function closeModal() {
+-+++++-    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');

+-+++++-  async function savePlan(formData: FormData) {
+-+++++-    const mode = formData.get('mode') as string;
+-+++++-    const id = formData.get('id') as string;
+-+++++-    const featuresText = formData.get('features') as string;
+-+++++-    const features = featuresText.split('\n').filter(f => f.trim());
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    // Build variant from form data
+-+++++-    const variant = {
+-+++++-      name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+++++-      price: parseFloat(formData.get('amount') as string) || 0,
+-+++++-      currency: 'USD',
+-+++++-      durationValue: 1,
+-+++++-      durationUnit: 'month',
+-+++++-      limits: {
+-+++++-        skuLimit: parseInt(formData.get('skuLimit') as string) || 0,
+-+++++-        maxImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxImages') as string) || 0,
+-+++++-        maxVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+++++-        maxBusinessImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessImages') as string) || 0,
+-+++++-        maxBusinessVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+++++-      },
+-+++++-      features: features,
+-+++++-    };
+-+++++-
+-+++++-    try {

+-+++++  function renderLineChart(svgId: string, data: number[], labels: string[], color: string) {
+-+++++    const svg = document.getElementById(svgId) as unknown as SVGSVGElement;
+-+++++    if (!svg || !data.length) return;

+-+++++    const width = svg.clientWidth || 400;
+-+++++    const height = svg.clientHeight || 128;
+-+++++    const padding = { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 30, left: 10 };
+-+++++    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
+-+++++    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
+-+++++
+-+++++    const maxVal = Math.max(...data, 1);
+-+++++    const minVal = 0;
+-+++++    const range = maxVal - minVal || 1;
+-+++++
+-+++++    const points = data.map((val, i) => ({
+-+++++      x: padding.left + (i / (data.length - 1)) * chartWidth,
+-+++++      y: padding.top + chartHeight - ((val - minVal) / range) * chartHeight
+-+++++    }));
+-+++++

+-+++++    const areaD = pathD + ` L ${points[points.length - 1].x} ${height - padding.bottom} L ${padding.left} ${height - padding.bottom} Z`;
+-+++++    const safeLabels = labels.map(l => String(l ?? '').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'));
+-+++++
+-+++++    const circles = points.map((p, i) => `

+-+++++        <title>${safeLabels[i]}: ${data[i]}</title>
+-+++++      </circle>
+-+++++      <text x="${p.x}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-muted-foreground text-xs">${safeLabels[i]}</text>
+-+++++    `).join('');
+-+++++
+-+++++    const svgContent = `<defs>
+-+++++      <linearGradient id="${svgId}-gradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
+-+++++        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
+-+++++        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0"/>
+-+++++      </linearGradient>
+-+++++    </defs>
+-+++++    <path d="${areaD}" fill="url(#${svgId}-gradient)"/>
+-+++++    <path d="${pathD}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
+-+++++    ${circles}`;
+-+++++
+-+++++    svg.innerHTML = sanitize(svgContent);
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  interface Listing {
+-+++++    id: string;
+-+++++    title: string | null;
+-+++++    slug: string | null;
+-+++++    status: string | null;
+-+++++    price: string | null;
+-+++++    createdAt: number | null;
+-+++++    planExpiresAt: number | null;
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
+-+++++    return fetch(url, {
+-+++++      ...options,
+-+++++      credentials: 'include',
+-+++++      headers: {
+-+++++        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+++++        ...options.headers,
+-+++++      },
+-+++++    });
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  const statusFilter = document.getElementById('filter-status') as HTMLSelectElement | null;
+-+++++  const searchInput = document.getElementById('search') as HTMLInputElement | null;
+-+++++  const tbody = document.getElementById('listings-body') as HTMLTableSectionElement | null;
+-+++++  const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results') as HTMLDivElement | null;
+-+++++
+-+++++  let listings: Listing[] = [];
+-+++++
+-+++++  function formatDate(ts: number | null): string {
+-+++++    return ts ? new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A';
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  async function loadListings() {
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing');
+-+++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++      if (data.success) {
+-+++++        listings = data.data || [];
+-+++++        updateStats();
+-+++++        renderListings();
+-+++++      } else {
+-+++++        console.error('API error:', data.error);
+-+++++      }
+-+++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++      console.error('Failed to load listings:', err);
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  function updateStats() {
+-+++++    const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-+++++    const total = listings.length;
+-+++++    const published = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'published' || l.status === 'active').length;
+-+++++    const draft = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'draft').length;
+-+++++    const expired = listings.filter(l => l.planExpiresAt && l.planExpiresAt < now).length;
+-+++++
+-+++++    const el = (id: string) => document.getElementById(id);
+-+++++    (el('stat-total') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(total);
+-+++++    (el('stat-published') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(published);
+-+++++    (el('stat-draft') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(draft);
+-+++++    (el('stat-expired') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(expired);
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  function renderListings() {
+-+++++    if (!tbody) return;
+-+++++    const search = searchInput?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+++++    const status = statusFilter?.value || '';
+-+++++
+-+++++    const filtered = listings.filter(l => {
+-+++++      if (search && !(l.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ?? false)) return false;
+-+++++      if (status) {
+-+++++        if (status === 'published') {
+-+++++          if (l.status !== 'published' && l.status !== 'active') return false;
+-+++++        } else if (l.status !== status) {
+-+++++          return false;
+-+++++        }
+-+++++      }
+-+++++      return true;
+-+++++    });
+-+++++
+-+++++    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+++++      tbody.innerHTML = '';
+-+++++      noResults?.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+++++      return;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++
+-+++++    noResults?.classList.add('hidden');
+-+++++
+-+++++    const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-+++++    tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(listing => {
+-+++++      const isExpired = listing.planExpiresAt && listing.planExpiresAt < now;
+-+++++      const effectiveStatus = isExpired ? 'expired' : (listing.status === 'active' ? 'published' : listing.status);
+-+++++      const statusColors: Record<string, string> = {
+-+++++        published: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400',
+-+++++        expired: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',

+-+++++  async function handleToggleStatus(id: string, currentStatus: string) {
+-+++++    const newStatus = currentStatus === 'published' ? 'draft' : 'published';
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-+++++        method: 'PUT',
+-+++++        body: JSON.stringify({ id, status: newStatus }),
+-+++++      });
+-+++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++      if (data.success) loadListings();
+-+++++      else alert('Failed to update listing');
+-+++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++      console.error('Error:', err);
+-+++++      alert('Failed to update listing');
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  async function handleDeleteListing(id: string) {
+-+++++    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this listing?')) return;
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-+++++        method: 'DELETE',
+-+++++        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
+-+++++      });
+-+++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++      if (data.success) loadListings();
+-+++++      else alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-+++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++      console.error('Error:', err);
+-+++++      alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  function escapeHtml(str: string) {
+-+++++    return str.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  function buildPriceFieldRow(idx: number, field: {label: string; value: string; unit: string}, units: {value: string; label: string}[]): string {
+-+++++    const isFirst = idx === 0;
+-+++++    return `<div class="flex gap-2 items-center price-field-row" data-index="${idx}">
+-+++++      <input type="text" name="priceLabel_${idx}" value="${escapeHtml(field.label)}" placeholder="Label (e.g., Hourly Rate)" class="flex-1 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" />
+-+++++      <input type="number" name="priceValue_${idx}" value="${escapeHtml(field.value)}" placeholder="${field.unit ? '0.00' : 'Ask for price'}" class="w-20 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" step="0.01" />
+-+++++      <select name="priceUnit_${idx}" class="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs bg-background">
+-+++++        ${units.map(u => `<option value="${u.value}" ${u.value === field.unit ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(u.label)}</option>`).join('')}
+-+++++      </select>
+-+++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-price-field" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 p-1" ${isFirst ? 'style="visibility:hidden"' : ''}>
+-+++++        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
+-+++++          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
+-+++++        </svg>
+-+++++      </button>
+-+++++    </div>`;
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  function buildPriceFieldsHtml(productType: string, existingFields: {label: string; value: string; unit: string}[]): string {
+-+++++    const units = getPriceUnitsForServiceType(productType);
+-+++++    if (existingFields.length === 0) existingFields.push({ label: '', value: '', unit: '' });
+-+++++    return existingFields.map((field, idx) => buildPriceFieldRow(idx, field, units)).join('');
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  function buildSpecFieldHtml(field: {key: string; type: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; options?: string[]}, value: string): string {
+-+++++    const id = `spec-${field.key}`;
+-+++++    const escapedValue = escapeHtml(Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(', ') : value);
+-+++++    if (field.type === 'text') {
+-+++++      return `<div>
+-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-+++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+++++      </div>`;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++    if (field.type === 'number') {
+-+++++      return `<div>
+-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++        <input type="number" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-+++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+++++      </div>`;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++    if (field.type === 'select') {
+-+++++      return `<div>
+-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++        <select id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm bg-background">
+-+++++          <option value="">Select...</option>
+-+++++          ${(field.options || []).map((opt: string) => `<option value="${opt}" ${value === opt ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(opt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + opt.slice(1).replace('_', ' '))}</option>`).join('')}
+-+++++        </select>
+-+++++      </div>`;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++    if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
+-+++++      return `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-+++++        <input type="checkbox" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="true" ${value ? 'checked' : ''} class="w-4 h-4" />
+-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="text-sm">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++      </div>`;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++    if (field.type === 'tags') {
+-+++++      return `<div>
+-+++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : 'Comma separated values'}"
+-+++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+++++        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Separate with commas</p>
+-+++++      </div>`;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++    return '';
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  // =============================================================================
+-+++++  // EVENT DELEGATION
+-+++++  // =============================================================================
+-+++++  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+++++    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-+++++    const actionEl = target.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
+-+++++    if (!actionEl) return;
+-+++++    const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
+-+++++    if (!action) return;
+-+++++    switch (action) {
+-+++++      case 'remove-price-field':
+-+++++        actionEl.closest('.price-field-row')?.remove();
+-+++++        break;
+-+++++      case 'remove-media': {
+-+++++        const mediaId = actionEl.dataset.mediaId;
+-+++++        if (mediaId) {
+-+++++          skuMediaIds = skuMediaIds.filter(id => id !== mediaId);
+-+++++          actionEl.closest('.relative.aspect-square')?.remove();
+-+++++          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
+-+++++        }
+-+++++        break;
+-+++++      }
+-+++++      case 'edit-sku': {
+-+++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-+++++        if (id) editSKU(id);
+-+++++        break;
+-+++++      }
+-+++++      case 'delete-sku': {
+-+++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-+++++        if (id) deleteSKU(id);
+-+++++        break;
+-+++++      }
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  });

+-+++++  async function handleSkuImageUpload(files: FileList) {
+-+++++    const preview = document.getElementById('sku-image-preview')!;
+-+++++    const uploadArea = document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')!;
+-+++++
+-+++++    for (const file of files) {
+-+++++      if (skuMediaIds.length >= 4) break;
+-+++++
+-+++++      const isImage = IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-+++++      const isVideo = VIDEO_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-+++++      if (!isImage && !isVideo) continue;
+-+++++
+-+++++      if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
+-+++++        alert(`Image too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 2MB`);
+-+++++        continue;
+-+++++      }
+-+++++      if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
+-+++++        alert(`Video too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 8MB`);
+-+++++        continue;
+-+++++      }
+-+++++
+-+++++      let fileToUpload = file;
+-+++++
+-+++++      if (isVideo) {
+-+++++        const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+++++        statusDiv.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs rounded-lg z-10';
+-+++++        statusDiv.textContent = 'Processing...';
+-+++++        uploadArea.style.position = 'relative';
+-+++++        uploadArea.appendChild(statusDiv);
+-+++++
+-+++++        try {
+-+++++          const { compressVideo } = await import('@/lib/video-compress');
+-+++++          const result = await compressVideo(file, {
+-+++++            maxSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
+-+++++            onProgress: (p: {message: string}) => { statusDiv.textContent = p.message; }
+-+++++          });
+-+++++
+-+++++          if (!result.withinLimit) {
+-+++++            alert('Video still too large after compression');
+-+++++            statusDiv.remove();
+-+++++            continue;
+-+++++          }
+-+++++          fileToUpload = result.file;
+-+++++          statusDiv.textContent = 'Uploading...';
+-+++++        } catch (err) {
+-+++++          console.error('Video compression error:', err);
+-+++++          statusDiv.remove();
+-+++++          alert('Video processing failed');
+-+++++          continue;
+-+++++        }

+-+++++        }
+-+++++      } catch (err) {

+-+++++      }
+-+++++    }

+-+++++  async function initEditor(initialContent = '') {

+-+++++    if (!loaded || !Editor) return null;

+-+++++    if (!element) return null;

+-+++++      extensions: [
+-+++++        StarterKit,
+-+++++        Underline,
+-+++++        PlaceholderExt.configure({
+-+++++          placeholder: (element as HTMLElement).dataset.placeholder || 'Start writing...',
+-+++++        }),
+-+++++      ],
+-+++++      content: initialContent,
+-+++++      immediatelyRender: false,
+-+++++      onUpdate: ({ editor }) => {
+-+++++        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+++++        if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = editor.getHTML();
+-+++++      },
+-+++++    });
+-+++++
+-+++++    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+++++    if (hiddenInput) hiddenInput.value = initialContent;

+-+++++    return editor;

+-+++++        const level = (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.level;
+-+++++
+-+++++        if (command === 'toggleHeading' && level) {
+-+++++          editor.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: parseInt(level) }).run();
+-+++++        } else if (command === 'undo') {
+-+++++          editor.chain().focus().undo().run();
+-+++++        } else if (command === 'redo') {
+-+++++          editor.chain().focus().redo().run();
+-+++++        } else if (command) {
+-+++++          const cmd = (editor.chain().focus() as any)[command];
+-+++++          if (typeof cmd?.run === 'function') cmd.run();
+-+++++        }
+-+++++      });
+-+++++    });
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  async function loadSKUs() {
+-+++++    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
+-+++++    const businessFilter = document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement | null;
+-+++++    if (!container) return;
+-+++++
+-+++++    if (businessFilter) {
+-+++++      const opts = businessOptions.map((b: {value: string; label: string}) =>
+-+++++        `<option value="${b.value}">${escapeHtml(b.label)}</option>`
+-+++++      ).join('');
+-+++++      businessFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Businesses</option>' + opts;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/skus');
+-+++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++      if (!data.success) {
+-+++++        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Failed to load SKUs</p>';
+-+++++        return;
+-+++++      }
+-+++++      (window as SkuWindow).allSkus = data.data || [];
+-+++++      renderSkus();
+-+++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++      console.error('Error loading SKUs:', err);
+-+++++      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Error loading SKUs</p>';
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  function renderSkus() {
+-+++++    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
+-+++++    const countEl = document.getElementById('skus-count');
+-+++++    if (!container) return;
+-+++++
+-+++++    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+++++    const businessFilter = (document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++    const typeFilter = (document.getElementById('type-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+++++
+-+++++    const bizMap = new Map(businessOptions.map((b: {value: string; label: string}) => [b.value, b.label]));
+-+++++    const allSkus = (window as SkuWindow).allSkus || [];
+-+++++
+-+++++    const filtered = allSkus.filter((sku: any) => {
+-+++++      const matchesSearch = !search || (sku.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search));
+-+++++      const matchesBusiness = !businessFilter || sku.businessId === businessFilter;
+-+++++      const matchesType = !typeFilter || sku.productType === typeFilter;
+-+++++      return matchesSearch && matchesBusiness && matchesType;
+-+++++    });
+-+++++
+-+++++    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} of ${allSkus.length} SKUs`;
+-+++++
+-+++++    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+++++      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No SKUs found</p>';
+-+++++      return;
+-+++++    }
+-+++++
+-+++++    container.innerHTML = filtered.map((sku: any) => {
+-+++++      let priceDisplay = 'Ask for price';
+-+++++      try {
+-+++++        const fields = sku.priceFields ? JSON.parse(sku.priceFields) : [];
+-+++++        if (fields.length > 0 && fields[0].value) {
+-+++++          const unit = fields[0].unit ? ` / ${fields[0].unit.replace('/', '')}` : '';
+-+++++          priceDisplay = `$${fields[0].value}${unit}`;
+-+++++        }
+-+++++      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
+-+++++      return buildSkuItemHtml(sku, priceDisplay, bizMap.get(sku.businessId) || 'Unknown');
+-+++++    }).join('');
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  async function editSKU(id: string) {
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`);
+-+++++      const data = await res.json();
+-+++++      if (!data.id) { alert('SKU not found'); return; }
+-+++++
+-+++++      editingId = id;
+-+++++      document.getElementById('modal-title')!.textContent = 'Edit SKU';
+-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = id;
+-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-title') as HTMLInputElement).value = data.title || '';
+-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-business') as HTMLSelectElement).value = data.businessId || '';
+-+++++      (document.getElementById('sku-service-type') as HTMLSelectElement).value = data.productType || 'product';
+-+++++
+-+++++      let priceFields: any[] = [];
+-+++++      try { priceFields = data.priceFields ? JSON.parse(data.priceFields) : []; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
+-+++++      renderPriceFields(data.productType || 'product', priceFields);
+-+++++
+-+++++      let specifications: Record<string, any> = {};
+-+++++      try { specifications = data.specifications ? JSON.parse(data.specifications) : {}; } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
+-+++++
+-+++++      initEditor(data.description || '');
+-+++++      renderSpecificationFields(data.productType || 'product', specifications);
+-+++++      openModal();
+-+++++      setupToolbar();
+-+++++    } catch (err) {
+-+++++      console.error('Error loading SKU:', err);
+-+++++      alert('Failed to load SKU');
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  }

+-+++++    e.preventDefault();
+-+++++    const formData = new FormData(e.target as HTMLFormElement);
+-+++++
+-+++++    const fieldCount = parseInt(document.getElementById('price-fields-container')!.dataset.fieldCount || '1');
+-+++++    const priceFields: {label: any; value: any; unit: any}[] = [];
+-+++++    for (let i = 0; i < fieldCount; i++) {
+-+++++      const label = formData.get(`priceLabel_${i}`);
+-+++++      const value = formData.get(`priceValue_${i}`);
+-+++++      const unit = formData.get(`priceUnit_${i}`);
+-+++++      if (label || value) priceFields.push({ label, value: value || '', unit: unit || '' });
+-+++++    }
+-+++++
+-+++++    const productType = formData.get('productType');
+-+++++    const specFields = productConfig.getSpecificationFields(productType as string) || [];
+-+++++    const specifications: Record<string, any> = {};
+-+++++    specFields.forEach((field: any) => {
+-+++++      const key = `spec_${field.key}`;
+-+++++      if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
+-+++++        specifications[field.key] = formData.get(key) === 'true';
+-+++++      } else if (field.type === 'tags') {
+-+++++        const val = formData.get(key);
+-+++++        specifications[field.key] = val ? (val as string).split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(v => v) : [];
+-+++++      } else {
+-+++++        const val = formData.get(key);
+-+++++        if (val) specifications[field.key] = field.type === 'number' ? Number(val) : val;
+-+++++      }
+-+++++    });
+-+++++
+-+++++    const descriptionInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+++++    const description = descriptionInput?.value || '';
+-+++++
+-+++++    const skuData: Record<string, any> = {
+-+++++      title: formData.get('title'),
+-+++++      businessId: formData.get('businessId'),
+-+++++      productType,
+-+++++      priceFields: priceFields.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(priceFields) : null,
+-+++++      specifications: Object.keys(specifications).length > 0 ? specifications : null,
+-+++++      description,
+-+++++      isAdmin: true,
+-+++++    };
+-+++++
+-+++++    if (!skuData.businessId) { alert('Please select a business'); return; }
+-+++++    if (!skuData.title) { alert('Please enter a title'); return; }
+-+++++
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      const url = editingId ? `/api/products/${editingId}` : '/api/products';
+-+++++      const method = editingId ? 'PUT' : 'POST';
+-+++++      const res = await fetch(url, {
+-+++++        method,
+-+++++        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+-+++++        body: JSON.stringify(skuData),
+-+++++      });
+-+++++
+-+++++      if (res.ok) {
+-+++++        closeModal();
+-+++++        loadSKUs();
+-+++++      } else {
+-+++++        const error = await res.json();
+-+++++        alert('Failed to save SKU: ' + (error.message || 'Unknown error'));
+-+++++      }
+-+++++    } catch (err) { alert('Failed to save SKU'); }
+-+++++  });

+-+++++  renderPriceFields('product');

+-+++++function getStatusClass(status: string | null): string {
+-+++++  if (status === 'active') return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-200';
+-+++++  if (status === 'draft') return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900 dark:text-yellow-200';
+-+++++  if (status === 'deleted') return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900 dark:text-red-200';
+-+++++  return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200';

+-+++++function capitalizeFirst(str: string | null | undefined): string {
+-+++++  if (!str) return '-';
+-+++++  return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);

+-+++++  async function deletePlan(planId: string) {
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      const result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.delete({ id: planId });
+-+++++      if (result.success) {
+-+++++        hideDeleteConfirm();
+-+++++        closeModal();

+-+++++      }

+-+++++      console.error('Failed to delete plan:', e);
+-+++++      toast.error('Failed to delete plan');
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  }

+-+++++  async function savePlan(formData: FormData) {
+-+++++    const mode = formData.get('mode') as string;
+-+++++    const id = formData.get('id') as string;
+-+++++    const featuresText = formData.get('features') as string;
+-+++++    const features = featuresText.split('\n').filter(f => f.trim());
+-+++++
+-+++++    const variant = {
+-+++++      name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+++++      price: parseFloat(formData.get('amount') as string) || 0,
+-+++++      currency: 'USD',
+-+++++      durationValue: 1,
+-+++++      durationUnit: 'month',
+-+++++      limits: {
+-+++++        skuLimit: parseInt(formData.get('skuLimit') as string) || 0,
+-+++++        maxImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxImages') as string) || 0,
+-+++++        maxVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+++++        maxBusinessImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessImages') as string) || 0,
+-+++++        maxBusinessVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+++++      },
+-+++++      features: features,
+-+++++    };
+-+++++
+-+++++    try {
+-+++++      let result;
+-+++++      if (mode === 'edit' && id) {
+-+++++        const existingPkg = packages.find(p => p.id === id);
+-+++++        const variants = existingPkg?.variants || [variant];
+-+++++        variants[0] = variant;
+-+++++
+-+++++        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.update({
+-+++++          id,
+-+++++          name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+++++          description: formData.get('description') as string,
+-+++++          variants: variants,
+-+++++          isActive: formData.get('active') === 'on',
+-+++++          sortOrder: parseInt(formData.get('sortOrder') as string) || 0,
+-+++++        });
+-+++++      } else {
+-+++++        const serviceRelationTo = (formData.get('serviceRelationTo') as string) || 'business';
+-+++++        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.create({
+-+++++          name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+++++          serviceType: (formData.get('serviceType') as 'subscription' | 'listing_renewal' | 'ad_banner') || 'subscription',
+-+++++          serviceRelationTo: serviceRelationTo as 'business' | 'listing' | 'ad_banner',
+-+++++          description: formData.get('description') as string || '',
+-+++++          variants: [variant],
+-+++++          isActive: formData.get('active') === 'on',
+-+++++          sortOrder: parseInt(formData.get('sortOrder') as string) || 0,
+-+++++        });
+-+++++      }
+-+++++
+-+++++      if (result.success) {
+-+++++        closeModal();
+-+++++        toast.success(mode === 'edit' ? 'Plan updated' : 'Plan created');
+-+++++        window.location.reload();
+-+++++      } else {
+-+++++        toast.error(result.error?.message || 'Failed to save plan');
+-+++++      }
+-+++++    } catch (e) {
+-+++++      console.error('Failed to save plan:', e);
+-+++++      toast.error('Failed to save plan');
+-+++++    }
+-+++++  }

+-+++++// Flue AI Generation - Direct API calls (no Mastra dependency)
+-+++++// MiniMax M2.7 does not match Pi model catalog, so we call the API directly.
+-+++++import { getMinimaxApiKey } from '@/lib/env';
+-+++++import {
+-+++++  ListingDataSchema,
+-+++++  SkuDataSchema,
+-+++++  BlogDataSchema,
+-+++++  LandingDataSchema,
+-+++++  type ListingOutput,
+-+++++  type SkuOutput,
+-+++++  type BlogOutput,
+-+++++  type LandingOutput,
+-+++++} from '@/lib/ai/valibot-schemas';
+-+++++import { LISTING_INSTRUCTIONS, SKU_INSTRUCTIONS, BLOG_INSTRUCTIONS, LANDING_INSTRUCTIONS } from '@/lib/ai/validation';
+-+++++
+-+++++const API_BASE = 'https://api.minimax.chat/v1';
+-+++++
+-+++++interface GenerateOptions {
+-+++++  systemPrompt: string;
+-+++++  userMessage: string;
+-+++++  schema: unknown; // Valibot schema
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++export async function generateWithMinimax(options: GenerateOptions): Promise<unknown> {
+-+++++  const apiKey = getMinimaxApiKey();
+-+++++  if (!apiKey) {
+-+++++    throw new Error('MINIMAX_API_KEY is not configured');
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/text/chatcompletion_v2`, {
+-+++++    method: 'POST',
+-+++++    headers: {
+-+++++      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+-+++++      'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
+-+++++    },
+-+++++    body: JSON.stringify({
+-+++++      model: 'MiniMax-M2.7',
+-+++++      messages: [
+-+++++        { role: 'system', content: options.systemPrompt },
+-+++++        { role: 'user', content: options.userMessage },
+-+++++      ],
+-+++++      resp_format: { type: 'json_object' },
+-+++++    }),
+-+++++  });
+-+++++
+-+++++  if (!response.ok) {
+-+++++    const errText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
+-+++++    throw new Error(`MiniMax API error ${response.status}: ${errText}`);
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  const json = await response.json() as { choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[] };
+-+++++  const content = json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
+-+++++
+-+++++  if (!content) {
+-+++++    throw new Error('Empty response from MiniMax API');
+-+++++  }
+-+++++
+-+++++  return JSON.parse(content);
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++export async function generateListing(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-+++++  const message = buildListingMessage(data);
+-+++++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-+++++    systemPrompt: LISTING_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-+++++    userMessage: message,
+-+++++    schema: ListingDataSchema,
+-+++++  }) as ListingOutput;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++export async function generateSku(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-+++++  const message = buildSkuMessage(data);
+-+++++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-+++++    systemPrompt: SKU_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-+++++    userMessage: message,
+-+++++    schema: SkuDataSchema,
+-+++++  }) as SkuOutput;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++export async function generateBlog(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-+++++  const message = buildBlogMessage(data);
+-+++++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-+++++    systemPrompt: BLOG_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-+++++    userMessage: message,
+-+++++    schema: BlogDataSchema,
+-+++++  }) as BlogOutput;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++export async function generateLanding(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-+++++  const message = buildLandingMessage(data);
+-+++++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-+++++    systemPrompt: LANDING_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-+++++    userMessage: message,
+-+++++    schema: LandingDataSchema,
+-+++++  }) as LandingOutput;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++function buildListingMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
+-+++++  const title = String(data.title ?? '');
+-+++++  const entityType = String(data.entityType ?? 'business');
+-+++++  const contactName = String(data.contactName ?? '');
+-+++++  const phone = String(data.phone ?? '');
+-+++++  const email = String(data.email ?? '');
+-+++++  const address = String(data.address ?? '');
+-+++++  const about = String(data.about ?? '');
+-+++++  const tags = Array.isArray(data.tags) ? data.tags : String(data.tags ?? '').split(',');
+-+++++  return `Create a listing for "${title}" (${entityType}).
+-+++++Contact: ${contactName || 'N/A'}
+-+++++Phone: ${phone || 'N/A'}
+-+++++Email: ${email || 'N/A'}
+-+++++Address: ${address || 'N/A'}
+-+++++About: ${about || 'N/A'}
+-+++++Tags: ${Array.isArray(tags) ? tags.join(', ') : tags || 'N/A'}`;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++function buildSkuMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
+-+++++  const skuTitle = String(data.title ?? '');
+-+++++  const skuDesc = String(data.description ?? '');
+-+++++  const priceVal = String(data.priceValue ?? 'N/A');
+-+++++  const priceFields = Array.isArray(data.priceFields) ? data.priceFields : [];
+-+++++  const priceInfo = priceFields.length > 0
+-+++++    ? priceFields.map((p: { label: string; value: string; unit?: string }) =>
+-+++++        `${p.label}: ${p.value} ${p.unit || ''}`).join(', ')
+-+++++    : `Price: ${priceVal}`;
+-+++++  return `Create a ${data.productType || 'product'} called "${skuTitle}".
+-+++++Description: ${skuDesc}
+-+++++${priceInfo}`;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++function buildBlogMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
+-+++++  const topic = String(data.topic ?? '');
+-+++++  return `Write a ${data.type || 'general'} article about "${topic}".
+-+++++Length: ${data.length || 'medium'}
+-+++++Requirements: ${data.prompt || 'N/A'}`;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++function buildLandingMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
+-+++++  const lpTitle = String(data.title ?? '');
+-+++++  return `Create a ${data.type || 'promotion'} landing page for "${lpTitle}".
+-+++++Description: ${data.description || 'N/A'}
+-+++++Requirements: ${data.prompt || 'N/A'}`;
+-+++++}

+-+++++// Valibot schemas for Flue structured output
+-+++++// Matches src/lib/ai/validation.ts — Zod → Valibot conversion
+-+++++import * as v from 'valibot';
+-+++++
+-+++++const OpeningHoursSchema = v.record(v.string(), v.object({
+-+++++  open: v.string(),
+-+++++  close: v.string(),
+-+++++}));
+-+++++
+-+++++export const ListingDataSchema = v.object({
+-+++++  action: v.literal('create_listing'),
+-+++++  data: v.object({
+-+++++    entityType: v.picklist(['business', 'government', 'nonprofit', 'non-profit']),
+-+++++    title: v.string(),
+-+++++    slug: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    categoryId: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    contactName: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    countryCode: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    contactNumber: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    email: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    registrationUrl: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    address: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    aboutUs: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    tags: v.optional(v.array(v.string())),
+-+++++    yearOfEstablishment: v.optional(v.number()),
+-+++++    openingHours: v.optional(OpeningHoursSchema),
+-+++++    locationLat: v.optional(v.number()),
+-+++++    locationLng: v.optional(v.number()),
+-+++++    status: v.optional(v.picklist(['draft', 'live', 'suspended'])),
+-+++++    verifiedBadge: v.optional(v.boolean()),
+-+++++    socialLinks: v.optional(v.object({
+-+++++      facebook: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++      instagram: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++      tiktok: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    })),
+-+++++  }),
+-+++++});
+-+++++
+-+++++export const PriceFieldSchema = v.object({
+-+++++  label: v.string(),
+-+++++  value: v.string(),
+-+++++  unit: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++});
+-+++++
+-+++++export const SkuDataSchema = v.object({
+-+++++  action: v.literal('create_sku'),
+-+++++  data: v.object({
+-+++++    title: v.string(),
+-+++++    description: v.optional(v.string()),
+-+++++    productType: v.optional(v.picklist([
+-+++++      'product', 'service', 'rental', 'food',
+-+++++      'accommodation', 'automotive', 'healthcare', 'education', 'beauty', 'event',
+-+++++    ])),
+-+++++    priceFields: v.optional(v.array(PriceFieldSchema)),
+-+++++    specifications: v.optional(v.record(v.string(), v.unknown())),
+-+++++    featured: v.optional(v.boolean()),
+-+++++    active: v.optional(v.boolean()),

+-+++++  status: string | null;

+-+++++  featured: number | null;
+-+++++  createdAt: number | null;
+-+++++  updatedAt: number | null;
+-+++++}

+-+++++export interface ListingStats {
+-+++++  total: number;
+-+++++  published: number;
+-+++++  draft: number;
+-+++++  expired: number;
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++export async function getAdminListings(): Promise<ListingData[]> {
+-+++++  const db = await getDb();
+-+++++  if (!db) return [];
+-+++++
+-+++++  const rows = await db
+-+++++    .select()
+-+++++    .from(listings)
+-+++++    .orderBy(desc(listings.createdAt))
+-+++++    .all();
+-+++++
+-+++++  return rows.map(r => ({
+-+++++    id: r.id,
+-+++++    title: r.title,
+-+++++    slug: r.slug,
+-+++++    ownerId: r.ownerId,
+-+++++    categoryId: r.categoryId,
+-+++++    status: r.status,
+-+++++    description: r.description,
+-+++++    price: r.price,
+-+++++    condition: r.condition,
+-+++++    location: r.location,
+-+++++    contactName: r.contactName,
+-+++++    contactNumber: r.contactNumber,
+-+++++    email: r.email,
+-+++++    imageIds: r.imageIds,
+-+++++    planExpiresAt: r.planExpiresAt,
+-+++++    featured: r.featured,
+-+++++    createdAt: r.createdAt,
+-+++++    updatedAt: r.updatedAt,
+-+++++  }));
+-+++++}
+-+++++
+-+++++export async function getAdminListingStats(): Promise<ListingStats> {
+-+++++  const all = await getAdminListings();
+-+++++  const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-+++++  return {
+-+++++    total: all.length,
+-+++++    published: all.filter(l => l.status === 'active' || l.status === 'published').length,
+-+++++    draft: all.filter(l => l.status === 'draft').length,
+-+++++    expired: all.filter(l => l.planExpiresAt && l.planExpiresAt < now).length,
+-+++++  };

+-+++++  const rows = await db
+-+++++    .select({
+-+++++      id: products.id,
+-+++++      businessId: products.businessId,
+-+++++      categoryId: products.categoryId,
+-+++++      title: products.title,
+-+++++      slug: products.slug,
+-+++++      description: products.description,
+-+++++      productType: products.productType,
+-+++++      priceFields: products.priceFields,
+-+++++      specifications: products.specifications,
+-+++++      images: products.images,
+-+++++      featured: products.featured,
+-+++++      active: products.active,
+-+++++      sortOrder: products.sortOrder,
+-+++++      views: products.views,
+-+++++      likes: products.likes,
+-+++++      saves: products.saves,
+-+++++      shares: products.shares,
+-+++++      deletedAt: products.deletedAt,
+-+++++      createdAt: products.createdAt,
+-+++++      updatedAt: products.updatedAt,
+-+++++      businessTitle: businesses.title,
+-+++++    })
+-+++++    .from(products)
+-+++++    .leftJoin(businesses, eq(products.businessId, businesses.id))
+-+++++    .orderBy(desc(products.createdAt))
+-+++++    .all();
+-+++++
+-+++++  return rows;

+-+++++      createdAt: row.createdAt ?? null,
+-+++++      updatedAt: row.updatedAt ?? null,
+-+++++    };

+-++++      const db = await getDb();
+-++++      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-++++      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
+-++++      const newItem = {

+-++++        latestUpdate: input.latestUpdate || null,
+-++++        status: 'draft' as const,
+-++++        ownerId: user.id,
+-++++        createdAt: now,
+-++++        updatedAt: now,
+-++++      };
+-++++
+-++++      await db.insert(nonProfits).values(newItem);
+-++++      return { success: true, data: { id: newItem.id, slug: newItem.slug } };
+-++++    },

+-++++      const db = await getDb();
+-++++      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-++++
+-++++      const existing = await db.select()
+-++++        .from(nonProfits)
+-++++        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-++++        .limit(1)
+-++++        .get();
+-++++
+-++++      if (!existing) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND, 'Non-profit not found');
+-++++
+-++++      const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = { updatedAt: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) };
+-++++      if (input.title !== undefined) updateData.title = input.title;
+-++++      if (input.slug !== undefined) updateData.slug = input.slug;
+-++++      if (input.email !== undefined) updateData.email = input.email;
+-++++      if (input.contactNumber !== undefined) updateData.contactNumber = input.contactNumber;
+-++++      if (input.aboutUs !== undefined) updateData.aboutUs = input.aboutUs;
+-++++      if (input.latestUpdate !== undefined) updateData.latestUpdate = input.latestUpdate;

+-++++  interface Listing {
+-++++    id: string;
+-++++    title: string | null;
+-++++    slug: string | null;
+-++++    status: string | null;
+-++++    price: string | null;
+-++++    createdAt: number | null;

+-++++
+-++++  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
+-++++    return fetch(url, {
+-++++      ...options,
+-++++      credentials: 'include',
+-++++      headers: {
+-++++        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-++++        ...options.headers,
+-++++      },
+-++++    });
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  const statusFilter = document.getElementById('filter-status') as HTMLSelectElement | null;
+-++++  const searchInput = document.getElementById('search') as HTMLInputElement | null;
+-++++  const tbody = document.getElementById('listings-body') as HTMLTableSectionElement | null;
+-++++  const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results') as HTMLDivElement | null;
+-++++
+-++++  let listings: Listing[] = [];
+-++++
+-++++  function formatDate(ts: number | null): string {
+-++++    return ts ? new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : 'N/A';
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  async function loadListings() {
+-++++    try {
+-++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing');
+-++++      const data = await res.json();
+-++++      if (data.success) {
+-++++        listings = data.data || [];
+-++++        updateStats();
+-++++        renderListings();
+-++++      } else {
+-++++        console.error('API error:', data.error);
+-++++      }
+-++++    } catch (err) {
+-++++      console.error('Failed to load listings:', err);
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  function updateStats() {
+-++++    const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-++++    const total = listings.length;
+-++++    const published = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'published' || l.status === 'active').length;
+-++++    const draft = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'draft').length;
+-++++    const expired = listings.filter(l => l.planExpiresAt && l.planExpiresAt < now).length;
+-++++
+-++++    const el = (id: string) => document.getElementById(id);
+-++++    (el('stat-total') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(total);
+-++++    (el('stat-published') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(published);
+-++++    (el('stat-draft') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(draft);
+-++++    (el('stat-expired') as HTMLElement).textContent = String(expired);
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  function renderListings() {
+-++++    if (!tbody) return;
+-++++    const search = searchInput?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-++++    const status = statusFilter?.value || '';
+-++++
+-++++    const filtered = listings.filter(l => {
+-++++      if (search && !(l.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ?? false)) return false;
+-++++      if (status) {
+-++++        if (status === 'published') {
+-++++          if (l.status !== 'published' && l.status !== 'active') return false;
+-++++        } else if (l.status !== status) {
+-++++          return false;
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++      return true;
+-++++    });
+-++++
+-++++    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-++++      tbody.innerHTML = '';
+-++++      noResults?.classList.remove('hidden');
+-++++      return;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    noResults?.classList.add('hidden');
+-++++
+-++++    const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-++++    tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(listing => {
+-++++      const isExpired = listing.planExpiresAt && listing.planExpiresAt < now;
+-++++      const effectiveStatus = isExpired ? 'expired' : (listing.status === 'active' ? 'published' : listing.status);
+-++++      const statusColors: Record<string, string> = {
+-++++        published: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400',
+-++++        expired: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
+-++++        draft: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300',
+-++++      };
+-++++      const colorClass = statusColors[effectiveStatus || 'draft'] || statusColors.draft;
+-++++
+-++++      return `
+-++++        <tr class="hover:bg-muted/30">
+-++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">
+-++++            <div class="font-medium">${listing.title || 'Untitled'}</div>
+-++++            <div class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Created ${formatDate(listing.createdAt)}</div>
+-++++          </td>
+-++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">
+-++++            <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${colorClass}">${effectiveStatus || 'draft'}</span>
+-++++          </td>
+-++++          <td class="px-4 py-3">${listing.price || '-'}</td>
+-++++          <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
+-++++            <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
+-++++              <a href="/admin/listings/${listing.id}/edit" data-action="edit-listing" data-id="${listing.id}" class="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">Edit</a>
+-++++              <button data-action="toggle-status" data-id="${listing.id}" data-status="${effectiveStatus}" class="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">
+-++++                ${effectiveStatus === 'published' ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
+-++++              </button>
+-++++              <button data-action="delete-listing" data-id="${listing.id}" class="text-sm text-red-500 hover:underline">Delete</button>
+-++++              ${listing.slug ? `<a href="/listing/${listing.slug}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">View</a>` : ''}
+-++++            </div>
+-++++          </td>
+-++++        </tr>
+-++++      `;
+-++++    }).join('');
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  async function handleToggleStatus(id: string, currentStatus: string) {
+-++++    const newStatus = currentStatus === 'published' ? 'draft' : 'published';
+-++++    try {
+-++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-++++        method: 'PUT',
+-++++        body: JSON.stringify({ id, status: newStatus }),
+-++++      });
+-++++      const data = await res.json();
+-++++      if (data.success) loadListings();
+-++++      else alert('Failed to update listing');
+-++++    } catch (err) {
+-++++      console.error('Error:', err);
+-++++      alert('Failed to update listing');
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  async function handleDeleteListing(id: string) {
+-++++    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this listing?')) return;
+-++++    try {
+-++++      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-++++        method: 'DELETE',
+-++++        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
+-++++      });
+-++++      const data = await res.json();
+-++++      if (data.success) loadListings();
+-++++      else alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-++++    } catch (err) {
+-++++      console.error('Error:', err);
+-++++      alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-++++    const btn = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-++++    const actionEl = btn.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
+-++++    if (!actionEl) return;
+-++++    const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
+-++++    const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-++++    const status = actionEl.dataset.status;
+-++++    switch (action) {
+-++++      case 'edit-listing':
+-++++        window.location.href = `/admin/listings/${id}/edit`;
+-++++        break;
+-++++      case 'toggle-status':
+-++++        handleToggleStatus(id!, status!);
+-++++        break;
+-++++      case 'delete-listing':
+-++++        handleDeleteListing(id!);
+-++++        break;
+-++++    }
+-++++  });
+-++++
+-++++  statusFilter?.addEventListener('change', renderListings);
+-++++  searchInput?.addEventListener('input', renderListings);

+-++++    return `<div class="flex gap-2 items-center price-field-row" data-index="${idx}">
+-++++      <input type="text" name="priceLabel_${idx}" value="${escapeHtml(field.label)}" placeholder="Label (e.g., Hourly Rate)" class="flex-1 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" />
+-++++      <input type="number" name="priceValue_${idx}" value="${escapeHtml(field.value)}" placeholder="${field.unit ? '0.00' : 'Ask for price'}" class="w-20 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" step="0.01" />
+-++++      <select name="priceUnit_${idx}" class="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs bg-background">
+-++++        ${units.map(u => `<option value="${u.value}" ${u.value === field.unit ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(u.label)}</option>`).join('')}
+-++++      </select>
+-++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-price-field" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 p-1" ${isFirst ? 'style="visibility:hidden"' : ''}>
+-++++        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
+-++++          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
+-++++        </svg>
+-++++      </button>
+-++++    </div>`;
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  function buildPriceFieldsHtml(productType: string, existingFields: {label: string; value: string; unit: string}[]): string {
+-++++    const units = getPriceUnitsForServiceType(productType);
+-++++    if (existingFields.length === 0) existingFields.push({ label: '', value: '', unit: '' });
+-++++    return existingFields.map((field, idx) => buildPriceFieldRow(idx, field, units)).join('');
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  function buildNewPriceFieldHtml(productType: string, count: number): string {
+-++++    const units = getPriceUnitsForServiceType(productType);
+-++++    return `<div class="flex gap-2 items-center price-field-row" data-index="${count}">
+-++++      <input type="text" name="priceLabel_${count}" placeholder="Label (e.g., Weekend Rate)" class="flex-1 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" />
+-++++      <input type="number" name="priceValue_${count}" placeholder="0.00" class="w-20 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" step="0.01" />
+-++++      <select name="priceUnit_${count}" class="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs bg-background">
+-++++        ${units.map(u => `<option value="${u.value}">${escapeHtml(u.label)}</option>`).join('')}
+-++++      </select>
+-++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-price-field" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 p-1">
+-++++        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
+-++++          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
+-++++        </svg>
+-++++      </button>
+-++++    </div>`;
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  function buildSpecFieldHtml(field: {key: string; type: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; options?: string[]}, value: string): string {
+-++++    const id = `spec-${field.key}`;
+-++++    const escapedValue = escapeHtml(Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(', ') : value);
+-++++    if (field.type === 'text') {
+-++++      return `<div>
+-++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-++++      </div>`;
+-++++    }
+-++++    if (field.type === 'number') {
+-++++      return `<div>
+-++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-++++        <input type="number" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-++++      </div>`;
+-++++    }
+-++++    if (field.type === 'select') {
+-++++      return `<div>
+-++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-++++        <select id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm bg-background">
+-++++          <option value="">Select...</option>
+-++++          ${(field.options || []).map((opt: string) => `<option value="${opt}" ${value === opt ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(opt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + opt.slice(1).replace('_', ' '))}</option>`).join('')}
+-++++        </select>
+-++++      </div>`;
+-++++    }
+-++++    if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
+-++++      return `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-++++        <input type="checkbox" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="true" ${value ? 'checked' : ''} class="w-4 h-4" />
+-++++        <label for="${id}" class="text-sm">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-++++      </div>`;
+-++++    }
+-++++    if (field.type === 'tags') {
+-++++      return `<div>
+-++++        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-++++        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-++++          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : 'Comma separated values'}"
+-++++          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-++++        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Separate with commas</p>
+-++++      </div>`;
+-++++    }
+-++++    return '';
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  function buildSkuItemHtml(sku: any, priceDisplay: string, businessName: string): string {
+-++++    const typeClass = sku.productType === 'product'
+-++++      ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200'
+-++++      : 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200';
+-++++    const typeLabel = sku.productType || 'product';
+-++++    return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 md:p-3 border rounded text-sm hover:bg-muted/30">
+-++++      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-++++        <p class="font-medium truncate">${escapeHtml(sku.title || 'Untitled')}</p>
+-++++        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${escapeHtml(priceDisplay)} - ${escapeHtml(businessName)}</p>
+-++++      </div>
+-++++      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-++++        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${typeClass}">${typeLabel}</span>
+-++++        <button data-action="edit-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-primary hover:text-primary/80 text-xs px-2 py-1">Edit</button>
+-++++        <button data-action="delete-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 text-xs px-2 py-1">Del</button>
+-++++      </div>
+-++++    </div>`;
+-++++  }

+-++++  function buildMediaThumbnailHtml(mediaId: string, mediaUrl: string, isVideo: boolean): string {
+-++++    const mediaHtml = isVideo
+-++++      ? `<video src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" muted /><div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"><svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></div>`
+-++++      : `<img src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" />`;
+-++++    return `<div class="relative aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
+-++++      ${mediaHtml}
+-++++      <button type="button" data-action="remove-media" data-media-id="${mediaId}" class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full text-xs">x</button>
+-++++    </div>`;
+-++++  }

+-++++  // =============================================================================
+-++++  // EVENT DELEGATION
+-++++  // =============================================================================
+-++++  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-++++    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-++++    const actionEl = target.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
+-++++    if (!actionEl) return;
+-++++    const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
+-++++    if (!action) return;
+-++++    switch (action) {
+-++++      case 'remove-price-field':
+-++++        actionEl.closest('.price-field-row')?.remove();
+-++++        break;
+-++++      case 'remove-media': {
+-++++        const mediaId = actionEl.dataset.mediaId;
+-++++        if (mediaId) {
+-++++          skuMediaIds = skuMediaIds.filter(id => id !== mediaId);
+-++++          actionEl.closest('.relative.aspect-square')?.remove();
+-++++          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
+-++++        }
+-++++        break;
+-++++      }
+-++++      case 'edit-sku': {
+-++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-++++        if (id) editSKU(id);
+-++++        break;
+-++++      }
+-++++      case 'delete-sku': {
+-++++        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-++++        if (id) deleteSKU(id);
+-++++        break;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++  });

+-++++  async function handleSkuImageUpload(files: FileList) {
+-++++    const preview = document.getElementById('sku-image-preview')!;
+-++++    const uploadArea = document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')!;
+-++++
+-++++    for (const file of files) {
+-++++      if (skuMediaIds.length >= 4) break;
+-++++
+-++++      const isImage = IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-++++      const isVideo = VIDEO_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-++++      if (!isImage && !isVideo) continue;
+-++++
+-++++      if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
+-++++        alert(`Image too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 2MB`);
+-++++        continue;
+-++++      }
+-++++      if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
+-++++        alert(`Video too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 8MB`);
+-++++        continue;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      let fileToUpload = file;
+-++++
+-++++      if (isVideo) {
+-++++        const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-++++        statusDiv.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs rounded-lg z-10';
+-++++        statusDiv.textContent = 'Processing...';
+-++++        uploadArea.style.position = 'relative';
+-++++        uploadArea.appendChild(statusDiv);
+-++++
+-++++        try {
+-++++          const { compressVideo } = await import('@/lib/video-compress');
+-++++          const result = await compressVideo(file, {
+-++++            maxSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
+-++++            onProgress: (p: {message: string}) => { statusDiv.textContent = p.message; }
+-++++          });
+-++++
+-++++          if (!result.withinLimit) {
+-++++            alert('Video still too large after compression');
+-++++            statusDiv.remove();
+-++++            continue;
+-++++          }
+-++++          fileToUpload = result.file;
+-++++          statusDiv.textContent = 'Uploading...';
+-++++        } catch (err) {
+-++++          console.error('Video compression error:', err);
+-++++          statusDiv.remove();
+-++++          alert('Video processing failed');
+-++++          continue;
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      try {
+-++++        const result = await actions.media.uploadMedia({ file: fileToUpload, category: 'sku' });
+-++++        if (result.success && result.data?.id) {
+-++++          skuMediaIds.push(result.data.id);
+-++++          preview.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', buildMediaThumbnailHtml(result.data.id, result.data.url, isVideo));
+-++++          preview.classList.remove('hidden');
+-++++          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
+-++++        }
+-++++      } catch (err) {
+-++++        console.error('Upload error:', err);
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-++++    document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.click();
+-++++  });
+-++++  document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
+-++++    const files = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).files;
+-++++    if (files) handleSkuImageUpload(files);
+-++++    (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-++++  });
