+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      // Handle keyboard navigation and item selection within dropdown
+-++++      this.content.addEventListener(
+-++++        "keydown",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          if (e.key === "Escape") {
+-++++            e.preventDefault();
+-++++            e.stopPropagation();
+-++++            this.lastCloseSource = "keyboard";
+-++++            // Close all menus in the group, focus root trigger
+-++++            this.rootDropdown.dispatchEvent(
+-++++              new CustomEvent("starwind-dropdown:close-all", { detail: { focusRoot: true } }),
+-++++            );
+-++++          } else if (this.isOpen) {
+-++++            this.handleMenuKeydown(e);
+-++++          }
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      // Handle item selection
+-++++      this.content.addEventListener(
+-++++        "mouseup",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          if (!this.isContextMenu || this.isSubmenu || !this.initialCursorPoint) return;
+-++++          const isOpeningPointer =
+-++++            Math.abs(e.clientX - this.initialCursorPoint.x) <= 1 &&
+-++++            Math.abs(e.clientY - this.initialCursorPoint.y) <= 1;
+-++++          this.initialCursorPoint = null;
+-++++          if (isOpeningPointer || e.button === 2) {
+-++++            e.preventDefault();
+-++++            e.stopPropagation();
+-++++          }
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      this.content.addEventListener(
+-++++        "click",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-++++          const item = target.closest('[role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemcheckbox"]');
+-++++          if (item && !(item as HTMLElement).hasAttribute("data-disabled")) {
+-++++            if (item.hasAttribute("aria-haspopup")) return;
+-++++            if (item.getAttribute("role") === "menuitemcheckbox") {
+-++++              this.toggleCheckboxItem(item as HTMLElement);
+-++++              if ((item as HTMLElement).getAttribute("data-close-on-click") !== "true") return;
+-++++            }
+-++++
+-++++            // Close the dropdown after item selection
+-++++            this.closeDropdown();
+-++++
+-++++            // Dispatch close-all through root to close all menus in the group
+-++++            this.rootDropdown.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("starwind-dropdown:close-all"));
+-++++          }
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      // Handle hover on dropdown items
+-++++      this.content.addEventListener(
+-++++        "mouseover",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-++++          const menuItem = target.closest('[role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemcheckbox"]');
+-++++          if (
+-++++            menuItem &&
+-++++            menuItem instanceof HTMLElement &&
+-++++            !menuItem.hasAttribute("data-disabled") &&
+-++++            this.isOpen === true
+-++++          ) {
+-++++            // Update items list before focusing to ensure the index is correct
+-++++            this.updateDropdownItems();
+-++++
+-++++            const itemIndex = this.items.indexOf(menuItem);
+-++++            if (itemIndex === -1) return;
+-++++
+-++++            // Focus the item when hovering
+-++++            this.focusItem(itemIndex);
+-++++          }
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.openOnHover) {
+-++++        this.trigger.addEventListener(
+-++++          "pointerenter",
+-++++          (e) => {
+-++++            if (e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
+-++++            if (this.isClosing) return;
+-++++            if (!this.isOpen) {
+-++++              this.lastOpenSource = "mouse";
+-++++              this.openDropdown();
+-++++            } else {
+-++++              // If the dropdown is already open, make sure to clear any close timer
+-++++              this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++            }
+-++++          },
+-++++          { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++        );
+-++++
+-++++        this.dropdown.addEventListener(
+-++++          "pointerleave",
+-++++          (e) => {
+-++++            if (e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
+-++++            if (this.openChildCount > 0) return;
+-++++            if (this.isOpen) {
+-++++              this.lastCloseSource = "mouse";
+-++++              this.closeDropdownDelayed();
+-++++            }
+-++++          },
+-++++          { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++        );
+-++++
+-++++        this.content.addEventListener(
+-++++          "pointerenter",
+-++++          (e) => {
+-++++            if (e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
+-++++            // If the user moves the mouse to the content, cancel the close timer
+-++++            this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++          },
+-++++          { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++        );
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setupContextMenuEvents() {
+-++++      if (!this.trigger) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener(
+-++++        "contextmenu",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          e.preventDefault();
+-++++          e.stopPropagation();
+-++++          if (Date.now() < this.suppressTouchContextMenuUntil) return;
+-++++          this.lastOpenSource = "mouse";
+-++++          this.openAtPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener(
+-++++        "touchstart",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          if (e.touches.length !== 1) {
+-++++            this.clearLongPressTimer();
+-++++            this.touchStartPoint = null;
+-++++            return;
+-++++          }
+-++++          const touch = e.touches[0];
+-++++          this.touchStartPoint = { x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY };
+-++++          this.clearLongPressTimer();
+-++++          this.longPressTimerRef = window.setTimeout(() => {
+-++++            if (!this.touchStartPoint) return;
+-++++            this.lastOpenSource = "mouse";
+-++++            this.openAtPoint(this.touchStartPoint.x, this.touchStartPoint.y, 10, 10);
+-++++            this.suppressTouchContextMenuUntil = Date.now() + 700;
+-++++            this.suppressTouchTriggerCloseUntil = Date.now() + 700;
+-++++          }, 500);
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener(
+-++++        "touchmove",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          if (e.touches.length !== 1) {
+-++++            this.clearLongPressTimer();
+-++++            return;
+-++++          }
+-++++          if (!this.touchStartPoint) return;
+-++++          const touch = e.touches[0];
+-++++          const deltaX = Math.abs(touch.clientX - this.touchStartPoint.x);
+-++++          const deltaY = Math.abs(touch.clientY - this.touchStartPoint.y);
+-++++          if (deltaX > 10 || deltaY > 10) {
+-++++            this.clearLongPressTimer();
+-++++          }
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      const handleTouchEnd = () => {
+-++++        this.clearLongPressTimer();
+-++++        this.touchStartPoint = null;
+-++++      };
+-++++
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener("touchend", handleTouchEnd, {
+-++++        signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++      });
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener("touchcancel", handleTouchEnd, {
+-++++        signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++      });
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private openAtPoint(x: number, y: number, width = 0, height = 0) {
+-++++      this.anchorRect = new DOMRect(x, y, width, height);
+-++++      this.initialCursorPoint = { x, y };
+-++++      if (this.isOpen) {
+-++++        this.positionContent({ avoidCollisions: true });
+-++++        return;
+-++++      }
+-++++      this.openDropdown();
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private openAtTrigger() {
+-++++      if (!this.trigger) return;
+-++++      const rect = this.trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
+-++++      this.openAtPoint(rect.left, rect.bottom);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private handleMenuKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
+-++++      // Make sure we've got an updated list of menu items
+-++++      this.updateDropdownItems();
+-++++
+-++++      // Skip if no items
+-++++      if (this.items.length === 0) return;
+-++++
+-++++      const currentIdx = this.currentFocusIndex;
+-++++      const currentItem = this.items[currentIdx];
+-++++
+-++++      switch (e.key) {
+-++++        case "ArrowDown":
+-++++          e.preventDefault();
+-++++          e.stopPropagation();
+-++++          this.focusItem(currentIdx === -1 ? 0 : currentIdx + 1);
+-++++          break;
+-++++        case "ArrowUp":
+-++++          e.preventDefault();
+-++++          e.stopPropagation();
+-++++          this.focusItem(currentIdx === -1 ? this.items.length - 1 : currentIdx - 1);
+-++++          break;
+-++++        case "ArrowRight":
+-++++          if (currentItem?.getAttribute("aria-haspopup") === "true") {
+-++++            e.preventDefault();
+-++++            e.stopPropagation();
+-++++            currentItem.click();
+-++++          }
+-++++          break;
+-++++        case "ArrowLeft":
+-++++          if (this.isSubmenu) {
+-++++            e.preventDefault();
+-++++            e.stopPropagation();
+-++++            this.closeDropdown({ skipParentHoverClose: true });
+-++++          }
+-++++          break;
+-++++        case "Home":
+-++++          e.preventDefault();
+-++++          e.stopPropagation();
+-++++          this.focusItem(0);
+-++++          break;
+-++++        case "End":
+-++++          e.preventDefault();
+-++++          e.stopPropagation();
+-++++          this.focusItem(this.items.length - 1);
+-++++          break;
+-++++        case "Enter":
+-++++        case " ":
+-++++          if (currentIdx !== -1) {
+-++++            e.preventDefault();
+-++++            e.stopPropagation();
+-++++            this.items[currentIdx].click();
+-++++          }
+-++++          break;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private isTargetInGroup(target: Node): boolean {
+-++++      const el = target instanceof HTMLElement ? target : target.parentElement;
+-++++      if (!el) return false;
+-++++      const contentEl = el.closest(
+-++++        '[data-slot="dropdown-content"], [data-slot="context-menu-content"]',
+-++++      );
+-++++      return !!contentEl && (contentEl as any).__rootDropdown === this.rootDropdown;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private shouldCloseContextMenuFromTarget(target: Node): boolean {
+-++++      if (Date.now() < this.suppressTouchTriggerCloseUntil && this.trigger?.contains(target)) {
+-++++        return false;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      return true;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private updateDropdownItems() {
+-++++      if (!this.content) return;
+-++++      // Get all interactive menuitem elements belonging to this menu level only
+-++++      this.items = (
+-++++        Array.from(
+-++++          this.content.querySelectorAll(
+-++++            '[role="menuitem"]:not([data-disabled="true"]), [role="menuitemcheckbox"]:not([data-disabled="true"])',
+-++++          ),
+-++++        ) as HTMLElement[]
+-++++      ).filter((item) => item.closest('[role="menu"]') === this.content);
+-++++      this.content
+-++++        .querySelectorAll('[role="menuitem"], [role="menuitemcheckbox"]')
+-++++        .forEach((item) => {
+-++++          if (item.closest('[role="menu"]') === this.content) {
+-++++            item.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
+-++++          }
+-++++        });
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private toggleCheckboxItem(item: HTMLElement) {
+-++++      const checked = item.getAttribute("aria-checked") === "true";
+-++++      const nextChecked = !checked;
+-++++      item.setAttribute("aria-checked", String(nextChecked));
+-++++      item.dispatchEvent(
+-++++        new CustomEvent("starwind-dropdown-checkbox:change", {
+-++++          detail: { checked: nextChecked },
+-++++          bubbles: true,
+-++++        }),
+-++++      );
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private focusItem(idx: number) {
+-++++      // Ensure the index wraps around properly
+-++++      const targetIdx = (idx + this.items.length) % this.items.length;
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.items[targetIdx]) {
+-++++        this.items.forEach((item) => item.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1"));
+-++++        this.items[targetIdx].setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
+-++++        this.items[targetIdx].focus();
+-++++        this.currentFocusIndex = targetIdx;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private toggleDropdown() {
+-++++      if (this.isOpen) {
+-++++        this.closeDropdown();
+-++++      } else {
+-++++        this.openDropdown();
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private openDropdown() {
+-++++      if (this.isClosing) return;
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger || (this.trigger as any).disabled) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.isOpen = true;
+-++++      this.trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("display");
+-++++
+-++++      this.portalContent();
+-++++
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
+-++++
+-++++      // Update the list of dropdown items
+-++++      this.updateDropdownItems();
+-++++
+-++++      // Reset focus index when opening
+-++++      this.currentFocusIndex = -1;
+-++++
+-++++      this.positionContent({ avoidCollisions: true });
+-++++
+-++++      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+-++++        this.positionContent({ avoidCollisions: true });
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      // For submenus opened by keyboard, focus the first item
+-++++      if (this.isSubmenu && this.lastOpenSource === "keyboard") {
+-++++        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+-++++          this.focusItem(0);
+-++++        });
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private closeDropdown(options?: { skipFocus?: boolean; skipParentHoverClose?: boolean }) {
+-++++      if (!this.isOpen) return;
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.isClosing = true;
+-++++      this.isOpen = false;
+-++++      this.initialCursorPoint = null;
+-++++      this.skipParentHoverCloseOnUnmount = options?.skipParentHoverClose === true;
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++
+-++++      // Set focus back on trigger only if opened or closed by keyboard
+-++++      // Skip focus if a close-all with focusRoot is closing this submenu (root will handle focus)
+-++++      if (
+-++++        !options?.skipFocus &&
+-++++        (!this.openOnHover ||
+-++++          this.lastOpenSource === "keyboard" ||
+-++++          this.lastCloseSource === "keyboard")
+-++++      ) {
+-++++        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+-++++          if (!this.trigger) return;
+-++++          this.trigger.focus();
+-++++        });
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      // Give the content time to animate before hiding
+-++++      if (this.closeTimeoutRef !== null) {
+-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.closeTimeoutRef);
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.closeTimeoutRef = window.setTimeout(() => {
+-++++        this.closeTimeoutRef = null;
+-++++        if (!this.content) return;
+-++++        this.unportalContent();
+-++++        this.content.style.display = "none";
+-++++        this.isClosing = false;
+-++++      }, this.animationDuration);
+-++++
+-++++      this.trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
+-++++
+-++++      // Reset focus index when closing
+-++++      this.currentFocusIndex = -1;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private closeDropdownDelayed() {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++
+-++++      // Clear any existing close timer
+-++++      this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++
+-++++      // Set a new timer to close the dropdown after the delay
+-++++      this.closeTimerRef = window.setTimeout(() => {
+-++++        if (this.isOpen) {
+-++++          this.closeDropdown();
+-++++        }
+-++++        this.closeTimerRef = null;
+-++++      }, this.closeDelay);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private clearCloseTimer() {
+-++++      if (this.closeTimerRef !== null) {
+-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.closeTimerRef);
+-++++        this.closeTimerRef = null;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private clearLongPressTimer() {
+-++++      if (this.longPressTimerRef !== null) {
+-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.longPressTimerRef);
+-++++        this.longPressTimerRef = null;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private isPointerWithinDropdownGroup(): boolean {
+-++++      if (this.trigger?.matches(":hover") || this.content?.matches(":hover")) {
+-++++        return true;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      const hoveredElements = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(":hover"));
+-++++      return hoveredElements.some(
+-++++        (element) =>
+-++++          this.dropdown.contains(element) ||
+-++++          this.content?.contains(element) ||
+-++++          this.isTargetInGroup(element),
+-++++      );
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    destroy() {
+-++++      if (this.abortController.signal.aborted) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.abortController.abort();
+-++++      this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++      this.clearLongPressTimer();
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.closeTimeoutRef !== null) {
+-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.closeTimeoutRef);
+-++++        this.closeTimeoutRef = null;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.unportalContent();
+-++++      this.isOpen = false;
+-++++      this.isClosing = false;
+-++++      this.anchorRect = null;
+-++++      this.initialCursorPoint = null;
+-++++      this.touchStartPoint = null;
+-++++      this.currentFocusIndex = -1;
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.trigger) {
+-++++        this.trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.content) {
+-++++        this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++        this.content.style.display = "none";
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private portalContent() {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++      const portalTarget = this.resolvePortalTarget();
+-++++      if (this.contentPlaceholder || this.content.parentElement === portalTarget) return;
+-++++
+-++++      // Save the original position with a placeholder
+-++++      this.contentPlaceholder = document.createComment("dropdown-content-placeholder");
+-++++      this.content.parentNode?.insertBefore(this.contentPlaceholder, this.content);
+-++++
+-++++      // Move content to body
+-++++      portalTarget.appendChild(this.content);
+-++++      this.portalTarget = portalTarget;
+-++++
+-++++      // Apply fixed positioning (overrides the CSS absolute class)
+-++++      this.content.style.position = portalTarget === document.body ? "fixed" : "absolute";
+-++++
+-++++      // Position relative to trigger
+-++++      this.positionContent({ avoidCollisions: true });
+-++++
+-++++      // Set up auto-update for scroll/resize
+-++++      const handleScroll = () => this.positionContent({ avoidCollisions: false });
+-++++      const handleResize = () => this.positionContent({ avoidCollisions: true });
+-++++      window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, true);
+-++++      window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
+-++++
+-++++      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() =>
+-++++        this.positionContent({ avoidCollisions: true }),
+-++++      );
+-++++      resizeObserver.observe(this.content);
+-++++      resizeObserver.observe(this.trigger);
+-++++
+-++++      // Find and link to parent handler for child-tracking
+-++++      const parentContent = this.trigger.closest(
+-++++        '[data-slot="dropdown-content"], [data-slot="context-menu-content"]',
+-++++      );
+-++++      if (parentContent) {
+-++++        this.parentHandler = (parentContent as any).__dropdownHandler || null;
+-++++        if (this.parentHandler) {
+-++++          this.parentHandler.openChildCount++;
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      // Handle hover interactions for portaled content
+-++++      const onPointerEnter = (e: PointerEvent) => {
+-++++        if (e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
+-++++        this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++        // Cancel close timers for all handlers in the group (parents included)
+-++++        this.rootDropdown.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("starwind-dropdown:cancel-close"));
+-++++      };
+-++++
+-++++      const onPointerLeave = (e: PointerEvent) => {
+-++++        if (e.pointerType !== "mouse") return;
+-++++        // Don't close if a child submenu is still open
+-++++        if (this.openChildCount > 0) return;
+-++++        this.lastCloseSource = "mouse";
+-++++        this.closeDropdownDelayed();
+-++++      };
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.openOnHover) {
+-++++        this.content.addEventListener("pointerenter", onPointerEnter);
+-++++        this.content.addEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.cleanupAutoUpdate = () => {
+-++++        window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, true);
+-++++        window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
+-++++        resizeObserver.disconnect();
+-++++        if (this.openOnHover) {
+-++++          this.content?.removeEventListener("pointerenter", onPointerEnter);
+-++++          this.content?.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onPointerLeave);
+-++++        }
+-++++      };
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private unportalContent() {
+-++++      if (!this.content) return;
+-++++
+-++++      // Decrement parent's open child count
+-++++      if (this.parentHandler) {
+-++++        const parentHandler = this.parentHandler;
+-++++        parentHandler.openChildCount = Math.max(0, parentHandler.openChildCount - 1);
+-++++        this.parentHandler = null;
+-++++
+-++++        if (
+-++++          !this.skipParentHoverCloseOnUnmount &&
+-++++          parentHandler.openOnHover &&
+-++++          parentHandler.openChildCount === 0 &&
+-++++          !parentHandler.isPointerWithinDropdownGroup()
+-++++        ) {
+-++++          parentHandler.lastCloseSource = "mouse";
+-++++          parentHandler.closeDropdownDelayed();
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++      this.skipParentHoverCloseOnUnmount = false;
+-++++
+-++++      // Clean up auto-update and hover listeners
+-++++      this.cleanupAutoUpdate?.();
+-++++      this.cleanupAutoUpdate = null;
+-++++
+-++++      // Move content back to its original position
+-++++      if (this.contentPlaceholder) {
+-++++        if (this.contentPlaceholder.parentNode) {
+-++++          this.contentPlaceholder.parentNode.insertBefore(this.content, this.contentPlaceholder);
+-++++        } else if (this.content.parentNode) {
+-++++          this.content.remove();
+-++++        }
+-++++        this.contentPlaceholder.remove();
+-++++        this.contentPlaceholder = null;
+-++++      } else if (
+-++++        this.content.parentNode &&
+-++++        this.portalTarget &&
+-++++        this.portalTarget !== document.body
+-++++      ) {
+-++++        this.content.remove();
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.portalTarget = null;
+-++++
+-++++      // Remove fixed positioning styles
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("position");
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("top");
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("left");
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("transform-origin");
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private syncDropdownWidth() {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger || this.isSubmenu || this.isContextMenu) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.content.style.width = "var(--starwind-dropdown-trigger-width)";
+-++++      this.content.style.setProperty(
+-++++        "--starwind-dropdown-trigger-width",
+-++++        `${this.trigger.offsetWidth}px`,
+-++++      );
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private positionContent(options?: { avoidCollisions?: boolean }) {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger || !this.isOpen) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.syncDropdownWidth();
+-++++
+-++++      const triggerRect =
+-++++        this.isContextMenu && !this.isSubmenu && this.anchorRect
+-++++          ? this.anchorRect
+-++++          : this.trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
+-++++      const contentWidth = this.content.offsetWidth;
+-++++      const contentHeight = this.content.offsetHeight;
+-++++      const viewportWidth = window.innerWidth;
+-++++      const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
+-++++      const viewportPadding = 8;
+-++++
+-++++      const resolvedPlacement = resolvePlacement({
+-++++        side: this.side,
+-++++        align: this.align,
+-++++        sideOffset: this.sideOffset,
+-++++        triggerRect,
+-++++        contentWidth,
+-++++        contentHeight,
+-++++        viewportWidth,
+-++++        viewportHeight,
+-++++        viewportPadding,
+-++++        avoidCollisions: options?.avoidCollisions ?? true,
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      const portalTargetRect =
+-++++        this.portalTarget && this.portalTarget !== document.body
+-++++          ? this.portalTarget.getBoundingClientRect()
+-++++          : null;
+-++++      const left = portalTargetRect
+-++++        ? resolvedPlacement.left - portalTargetRect.left
+-++++        : resolvedPlacement.left;
+-++++      const top = portalTargetRect
+-++++        ? resolvedPlacement.top - portalTargetRect.top
+-++++        : resolvedPlacement.top;
+-++++
+-++++      this.content.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
+-++++      this.content.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
+-++++      this.content.style.transformOrigin = getTransformOrigin(
+-++++        resolvedPlacement.side,
+-++++        resolvedPlacement.align,
+-++++      );
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-side", resolvedPlacement.side);
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-align", resolvedPlacement.align);
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  const dropdownInstances = new Map<HTMLElement, DropdownHandler>();
+-++++  let dropdownCounter = 0;
+-++++
+-++++  const cleanupStaleDropdowns = () => {
+-++++    for (const [dropdownEl, dropdownHandler] of dropdownInstances.entries()) {
+-++++      if (!document.contains(dropdownEl)) {
+-++++        dropdownHandler.destroy();
+-++++        dropdownInstances.delete(dropdownEl);

+-++++        dropdownInstances.set(dropdown, new DropdownHandler(dropdown, dropdownCounter++));
+-++++      }
+-++++    });
+-++++  };

+-++++  initDropdowns();

+-++++        const generatedId = `starwind-dropzone-${idx}`;
+-++++        this.input.id = generatedId;
+-++++        this.label.htmlFor = generatedId;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      // Setup event handlers
+-++++      this.setupEvents();
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setActive(active: boolean) {
+-++++      this.label.dataset.dragActive = String(active);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    // Set up mutation observer to watch for external attribute changes
+-++++    private observeAttributeChanges() {
+-++++      this.observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
+-++++        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
+-++++          if (mutation.type === "attributes" && mutation.attributeName === "data-is-uploading") {
+-++++            this.handleAttributeChange();
+-++++          }
+-++++        });
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      this.observer.observe(this.label, {
+-++++        attributes: true,
+-++++        attributeFilter: ["data-is-uploading"],
+-++++      });
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    // Handle attribute changes from external sources
+-++++    private handleAttributeChange() {
+-++++      const isUploading = this.label.dataset.isUploading === "true";
+-++++
+-++++      // Only update internal state if it's different
+-++++      if (isUploading !== this.isUploading) {
+-++++        this.isUploading = isUploading;
+-++++
+-++++        // Update UI
+-++++        if (this.uploadIndicator && this.loadingIndicator) {
+-++++          if (isUploading) {
+-++++            this.uploadIndicator.classList.add("hidden");
+-++++            this.loadingIndicator.classList.remove("hidden");
+-++++          } else {
+-++++            this.loadingIndicator.classList.add("hidden");
+-++++            this.uploadIndicator.classList.remove("hidden");
+-++++          }
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private updateFilesList() {
+-++++      if (!this.filesList) return;
+-++++
+-++++      const hasFiles = this.files.length > 0;
+-++++      this.label.dataset.hasFiles = String(hasFiles);
+-++++
+-++++      if (hasFiles) {
+-++++        this.filesList.classList.remove("invisible");
+-++++
+-++++        // Clear previous files
+-++++        this.filesList.innerHTML = "";
+-++++
+-++++        // Create file list
+-++++        this.files.forEach((file) => {
+-++++          const fileItem = document.createElement("div");
+-++++
+-++++          // Insert SVG directly
+-++++          fileItem.innerHTML = fileSvg;
+-++++
+-++++          const fileText = document.createElement("span");
+-++++          fileText.textContent = file.name;
+-++++
+-++++          // Append text after the SVG
+-++++          fileItem.appendChild(fileText);
+-++++
+-++++          // Use non-null assertion since we already checked at the beginning of the method
+-++++          this.filesList!.appendChild(fileItem);
+-++++        });
+-++++      } else {
+-++++        this.filesList.classList.add("invisible");
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private handleFiles(files: FileList | null) {
+-++++      if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.files = Array.from(files);
+-++++      this.updateFilesList();
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setupEvents() {
+-++++      this.label.addEventListener("dragover", (e) => {
+-++++        e.preventDefault();
+-++++        this.setActive(true);
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      this.label.addEventListener("dragleave", () => {
+-++++        this.setActive(false);
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      this.label.addEventListener("drop", (e) => {
+-++++        e.preventDefault();
+-++++        this.setActive(false);
+-++++
+-++++        const { files } = e.dataTransfer || {};
+-++++        if (files && files.length) {
+-++++          const dt = new DataTransfer();
+-++++          Array.from(files).forEach((file) => dt.items.add(file));
+-++++          this.input.files = dt.files;
+-++++          this.input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
+-++++
+-++++          this.handleFiles(files);
+-++++        }
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      // Handle file selection from dialog
+-++++      this.input.addEventListener("change", () => {
+-++++        this.handleFiles(this.input.files);
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      // Add keyboard accessibility for Enter and Space keys
+-++++      this.label.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
+-++++        // Handle Enter (13) and Space (32) keys
+-++++        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
+-++++          e.preventDefault();
+-++++          this.input.click(); // Trigger the native file dialog
+-++++        }
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.loadingIndicator) {
+-++++        // Watch for external changes to data-is-uploading attribute
+-++++        this.observeAttributeChanges();
+-++++        // Initialize based on current attribute values
+-++++        this.handleAttributeChange();
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  // Store instances in a WeakMap to avoid memory leaks
+-++++  const fileInputInstances = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, FileInputHandler>();
+-++++  let dropzoneCounter = 0;
+-++++
+-++++  const setupFileInputs = () => {
+-++++    document.querySelectorAll<HTMLLabelElement>(".starwind-dropzone").forEach((label) => {
+-++++      if (!fileInputInstances.has(label)) {
+-++++        try {
+-++++          fileInputInstances.set(label, new FileInputHandler(label, dropzoneCounter++));
+-++++        } catch {
+-++++          /* ignore labels without inputs */
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++    });
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  setupFileInputs();
+-++++  document.addEventListener("astro:after-swap", setupFileInputs);
+-++++  document.addEventListener("starwind:init", setupFileInputs);
+-++++</script>

+-++++---
+-++++import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types";
+-++++
+-++++import { hoverCard } from "./variants";
+-++++
+-++++type Props = HTMLAttributes<"div"> & {
+-++++  openDelay?: number;
+-++++  closeDelay?: number;
+-++++  disableHoverableContent?: boolean;
+-++++};
+-++++
+-++++const {
+-++++  openDelay = 700,
+-++++  closeDelay = 300,
+-++++  disableHoverableContent = false,
+-++++  class: className,
+-++++  ...rest
+-++++} = Astro.props;
+-++++---
+-++++
+-++++<div
+-++++  class={hoverCard({ class: className })}
+-++++  data-state="closed"
+-++++  data-open-delay={openDelay}
+-++++  data-close-delay={closeDelay}
+-++++  {...!disableHoverableContent && { "data-content-hoverable": "" }}
+-++++  {...rest}
+-++++  data-slot="hover-card"
+-++++>
+-++++  <slot />
+-++++</div>
+-++++
+-++++<script>
+-++++  import {
+-++++    type FloatingAlign,
+-++++    type FloatingSide,
+-++++    getTransformOrigin,
+-++++    resolvePlacement,
+-++++  } from "@/lib/utils/starwind/positioning";
+-++++
+-++++  class HoverCardHandler {
+-++++    private hoverCard: HTMLElement;
+-++++    private trigger: HTMLElement | null;
+-++++    private content: HTMLElement | null;
+-++++    private openTimerRef: number | null = null;
+-++++    private closeTimerRef: number | null = null;
+-++++    private hideAnimationTimerRef: number | null = null;
+-++++    private contentId: string;
+-++++    private animationDuration = 100;
+-++++    private side: FloatingSide = "bottom";
+-++++    private align: FloatingAlign = "center";
+-++++    private sideOffset = 4;
+-++++    private avoidCollisions = true;
+-++++    private isOpen = false;
+-++++    private contentPlaceholder: Comment | null = null;
+-++++    private cleanupAutoUpdate: (() => void) | null = null;
+-++++    private abortController: AbortController;
+-++++
+-++++    constructor(hoverCard: HTMLElement, idx: number) {
+-++++      this.contentId = `starwind-hover-card-${idx}`;
+-++++      this.hoverCard = hoverCard;
+-++++      this.abortController = new AbortController();
+-++++      this.content = hoverCard.querySelector(".starwind-hover-card-content");
+-++++      this.trigger = hoverCard.querySelector(".starwind-hover-card-trigger");
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.trigger?.hasAttribute("data-as-child")) {
+-++++        this.trigger = this.trigger.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      if (!this.trigger) {
+-++++        this.trigger = hoverCard.firstElementChild as HTMLElement;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.trigger === this.content) {
+-++++        this.trigger = this.trigger.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      if (!this.trigger || !this.content) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.trigger.classList.add("starwind-hover-card-trigger");
+-++++
+-++++      const animationDurationString = this.content.style.animationDuration;
+-++++      if (animationDurationString.endsWith("ms")) {
+-++++        this.animationDuration = parseFloat(animationDurationString);
+-++++      } else if (animationDurationString.endsWith("s")) {
+-++++        this.animationDuration = parseFloat(animationDurationString) * 1000;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      const contentSide = this.content.getAttribute("data-side");
+-++++      if (
+-++++        contentSide === "top" ||
+-++++        contentSide === "bottom" ||
+-++++        contentSide === "left" ||
+-++++        contentSide === "right"
+-++++      ) {
+-++++        this.side = contentSide;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      const contentAlign = this.content.getAttribute("data-align");
+-++++      if (contentAlign === "start" || contentAlign === "center" || contentAlign === "end") {
+-++++        this.align = contentAlign;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      const contentSideOffset = parseFloat(this.content.getAttribute("data-side-offset") || "4");
+-++++      if (Number.isFinite(contentSideOffset)) {
+-++++        this.sideOffset = contentSideOffset;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.avoidCollisions = this.content.hasAttribute("data-avoid-collisions");
+-++++      this.isOpen = this.hoverCard.getAttribute("data-state") === "open";
+-++++
+-++++      this.init();
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private init() {
+-++++      this.setupAccessibility();
+-++++      this.setupEvents();
+-++++      this.setInitialState();
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setupAccessibility() {
+-++++      if (!this.trigger || !this.content) return;
+-++++      if (!this.content.id) {
+-++++        this.content.id = this.contentId;
+-++++      }
+-++++      this.trigger.setAttribute("aria-describedby", this.content.id);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setInitialState() {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.isOpen) {
+-++++        this.hoverCard.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
+-++++        this.trigger.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
+-++++        this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
+-++++        this.content.classList.remove("hidden");
+-++++        this.portalContent();
+-++++        this.positionHoverCard();
+-++++        requestAnimationFrame(() => this.positionHoverCard());
+-++++      } else {
+-++++        this.hoverCard.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++        this.trigger.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++        this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++        this.content.classList.add("hidden");
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setupEvents() {
+-++++      if (!this.trigger || !this.content) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => this.show(), {
+-++++        signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++      });
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => this.hide(), {
+-++++        signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++      });
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener("focus", () => this.show(true), {
+-++++        signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++      });
+-++++      this.trigger.addEventListener("blur", () => this.hide(true), {
+-++++        signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.hoverCard.hasAttribute("data-content-hoverable")) {
+-++++        this.content.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => this.show(), {
+-++++          signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++        });
+-++++        this.content.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => this.hide(), {
+-++++          signal: this.abortController.signal,
+-++++        });
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      document.addEventListener(
+-++++        "keydown",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          if (e.key === "Escape" && this.isOpen) {
+-++++            this.hide(true);
+-++++          }
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      document.addEventListener(
+-++++        "pointerdown",
+-++++        (e) => {
+-++++          if (
+-++++            this.isOpen &&
+-++++            !this.hoverCard.contains(e.target as Node) &&
+-++++            !this.content?.contains(e.target as Node)
+-++++          ) {
+-++++            this.hide(true);
+-++++          }
+-++++        },
+-++++        { signal: this.abortController.signal },
+-++++      );
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private portalContent() {
+-++++      if (!this.content) return;
+-++++      if (this.contentPlaceholder || this.content.parentElement === document.body) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.contentPlaceholder = document.createComment("hover-card-content-placeholder");
+-++++      this.content.parentNode?.insertBefore(this.contentPlaceholder, this.content);
+-++++
+-++++      document.body.appendChild(this.content);
+-++++
+-++++      const updatePosition = () => this.positionHoverCard();
+-++++      window.addEventListener("scroll", updatePosition, true);
+-++++      window.addEventListener("resize", updatePosition);
+-++++
+-++++      const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => this.positionHoverCard());
+-++++      resizeObserver.observe(this.content);
+-++++      if (this.trigger) {
+-++++        resizeObserver.observe(this.trigger);
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.cleanupAutoUpdate = () => {
+-++++        window.removeEventListener("scroll", updatePosition, true);
+-++++        window.removeEventListener("resize", updatePosition);
+-++++        resizeObserver.disconnect();
+-++++      };
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private unportalContent() {
+-++++      if (!this.content) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.cleanupAutoUpdate?.();
+-++++      this.cleanupAutoUpdate = null;
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.contentPlaceholder) {
+-++++        this.contentPlaceholder.parentNode?.insertBefore(this.content, this.contentPlaceholder);
+-++++        this.contentPlaceholder.remove();
+-++++        this.contentPlaceholder = null;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("top");
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("left");
+-++++      this.content.style.removeProperty("transform-origin");
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private openNow() {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++      if (this.abortController.signal.aborted) return;
+-++++      if (this.isTriggerDisabled()) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.clearHideAnimationTimer();
+-++++      this.isOpen = true;
+-++++      this.hoverCard.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
+-++++      this.trigger.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "open");
+-++++      this.content.classList.remove("hidden");
+-++++      this.portalContent();
+-++++      this.positionHoverCard();
+-++++      requestAnimationFrame(() => this.positionHoverCard());
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private show(immediate: boolean = false) {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++      if (this.isTriggerDisabled()) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++      this.clearHideAnimationTimer();
+-++++      this.clearOpenTimer();
+-++++
+-++++      if (immediate) {
+-++++        this.openNow();
+-++++        this.clearOpenTimer();
+-++++        return;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      const delay = parseInt(this.hoverCard.getAttribute("data-open-delay") || "700");
+-++++      this.openTimerRef = window.setTimeout(() => {
+-++++        if (this.abortController.signal.aborted) return;
+-++++        this.openNow();
+-++++        this.openTimerRef = null;
+-++++      }, delay);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private positionHoverCard() {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger || !this.isOpen) return;
+-++++
+-++++      const triggerRect = this.trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
+-++++      const contentWidth = this.content.offsetWidth;
+-++++      const contentHeight = this.content.offsetHeight;
+-++++      if (contentWidth === 0 || contentHeight === 0) return;
+-++++
+-++++      const resolvedPlacement = resolvePlacement({
+-++++        side: this.side,
+-++++        align: this.align,
+-++++        sideOffset: this.sideOffset,
+-++++        triggerRect,
+-++++        contentWidth,
+-++++        contentHeight,
+-++++        viewportWidth: window.innerWidth,
+-++++        viewportHeight: window.innerHeight,
+-++++        viewportPadding: 8,
+-++++        avoidCollisions: this.avoidCollisions,
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      this.content.style.left = `${Math.round(resolvedPlacement.left)}px`;
+-++++      this.content.style.top = `${Math.round(resolvedPlacement.top)}px`;
+-++++      this.content.style.transformOrigin = getTransformOrigin(
+-++++        resolvedPlacement.side,
+-++++        resolvedPlacement.align,
+-++++      );
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-side", resolvedPlacement.side);
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-align", resolvedPlacement.align);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private closeNow() {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++      this.isOpen = false;
+-++++      this.hoverCard.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++      this.trigger.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++      this.content.setAttribute("data-state", "closed");
+-++++
+-++++      this.clearHideAnimationTimer();
+-++++      this.hideAnimationTimerRef = window.setTimeout(() => {
+-++++        if (this.abortController.signal.aborted) return;
+-++++        if (!this.content) return;
+-++++        this.content.classList.add("hidden");
+-++++        this.unportalContent();
+-++++      }, this.animationDuration);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private hide(immediate: boolean = false) {
+-++++      if (!this.content || !this.trigger) return;
+-++++      this.clearOpenTimer();
+-++++      this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++
+-++++      if (immediate) {
+-++++        this.closeNow();
+-++++        return;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      this.closeTimerRef = window.setTimeout(
+-++++        () => {
+-++++          if (this.abortController.signal.aborted) return;
+-++++          this.closeNow();
+-++++          this.closeTimerRef = null;
+-++++        },
+-++++        parseInt(this.hoverCard.getAttribute("data-close-delay") || "300"),
+-++++      );
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    destroy() {
+-++++      if (this.abortController.signal.aborted) return;
+-++++
+-++++      this.abortController.abort();
+-++++      this.clearOpenTimer();
+-++++      this.clearCloseTimer();
+-++++      this.clearHideAnimationTimer();
+-++++      this.unportalContent();
+-++++      this.isOpen = false;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private isTriggerDisabled() {
+-++++      if (!this.trigger) return true;
+-++++      return (
+-++++        this.trigger.hasAttribute("disabled") ||
+-++++        this.trigger.getAttribute("aria-disabled") === "true" ||
+-++++        this.trigger.getAttribute("data-disabled") === "true"
+-++++      );
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private clearOpenTimer() {
+-++++      if (this.openTimerRef) {
+-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.openTimerRef);
+-++++        this.openTimerRef = null;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private clearCloseTimer() {
+-++++      if (this.closeTimerRef) {
+-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.closeTimerRef);
+-++++        this.closeTimerRef = null;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private clearHideAnimationTimer() {
+-++++      if (this.hideAnimationTimerRef) {
+-++++        window.clearTimeout(this.hideAnimationTimerRef);
+-++++        this.hideAnimationTimerRef = null;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  const hoverCardInstances = new Map<HTMLElement, HoverCardHandler>();
+-++++  let hoverCardCounter = 0;
+-++++
+-++++  const cleanupStaleHoverCards = () => {
+-++++    for (const [hoverCardEl, hoverCardHandler] of hoverCardInstances.entries()) {
+-++++      if (!document.contains(hoverCardEl)) {
+-++++        hoverCardHandler.destroy();
+-++++        hoverCardInstances.delete(hoverCardEl);
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  const destroyAllHoverCards = () => {
+-++++    for (const hoverCardHandler of hoverCardInstances.values()) {
+-++++      hoverCardHandler.destroy();
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    hoverCardInstances.clear();
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  const setupHoverCards = () => {
+-++++    cleanupStaleHoverCards();
+-++++
+-++++    document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".starwind-hover-card").forEach((hoverCard) => {
+-++++      if (!hoverCardInstances.has(hoverCard)) {
+-++++        hoverCardInstances.set(hoverCard, new HoverCardHandler(hoverCard, hoverCardCounter++));
+-++++      }
+-++++    });
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  setupHoverCards();
+-++++  document.addEventListener("astro:before-swap", destroyAllHoverCards);
+-++++  document.addEventListener("astro:after-swap", setupHoverCards);
+-++++  document.addEventListener("starwind:init", setupHoverCards);
+-++++</script>

+-++++import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types";
+-++++
+-++++import { progress, progressIndicator } from "./variants";
+-++++
+-++++type Props = HTMLAttributes<"div"> & {
+-++++  /**
+-++++   * Current value of the progress bar (omit for indeterminate state)
+-++++   */
+-++++  value?: number;
+-++++  /**
+-++++   * Maximum value for the progress bar (default: 100)
+-++++   */
+-++++  max?: number;
+-++++  /**
+-++++   * Color variant for the progress indicator (default: default)
+-++++   */
+-++++  variant?: "default" | "primary" | "secondary" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error";
+-++++};
+-++++
+-++++const { class: className, value, max = 100, variant = "default", ...rest } = Astro.props;
+-++++
+-++++const isIndeterminate = value == null;
+-++++const valuePercent = isIndeterminate ? undefined : Math.round((value / max) * 100);
+-++++const valueText = isIndeterminate ? undefined : `${valuePercent}%`;
+-++++
+-++++const indicator = progressIndicator;
+-++++
+-++++const progressClasses = progress({
+-++++  variant: isIndeterminate ? "indeterminate" : undefined,
+-++++  class: className,
+-++++});
+-++++
+-++++const indicatorClasses = indicator({
+-++++  variant: isIndeterminate ? "indeterminate" : undefined,
+-++++  color: variant,
+-++++});
+-++++
+-++++const indicatorStyle = isIndeterminate
+-++++  ? ""
+-++++  : `transform: translateX(-${100 - (valuePercent ?? 0)}%);`;
+-++++---
+-++++
+-++++<div
+-++++  role="progressbar"
+-++++  aria-valuemin={0}
+-++++  aria-valuemax={max}
+-++++  aria-valuenow={isIndeterminate ? undefined : value}
+-++++  aria-valuetext={valueText}
+-++++  class:list={[progressClasses]}
+-++++  data-value={value}
+-++++  data-max={max}
+-++++  data-indeterminate={isIndeterminate}
+-++++  {...rest}
+-++++  data-slot="progress"
+-++++>
+-++++  <div class:list={[indicatorClasses]} style={indicatorStyle}></div>
+-++++</div>
+-++++
+-++++<script>
+-++++  class ProgressHandler {
+-++++    private progressElement: HTMLElement;
+-++++    private observer!: MutationObserver;
+-++++
+-++++    constructor(progressElement: HTMLElement) {
+-++++      this.progressElement = progressElement;
+-++++      this.setupMutationObserver();
+-++++      this.updateProgress(); // Initial update
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setupMutationObserver(): void {
+-++++      // Create a MutationObserver to watch for data-value attribute changes
+-++++      this.observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
+-++++        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
+-++++          if (mutation.attributeName === "data-value" || mutation.attributeName === "data-max") {
+-++++            this.updateProgress();
+-++++          }
+-++++        });
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      // Start observing
+-++++      this.observer.observe(this.progressElement, { attributes: true });
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private updateProgress(): void {
+-++++      const value = Number(this.progressElement.getAttribute("data-value"));
+-++++      const max = Number(this.progressElement.getAttribute("data-max") || 100);
+-++++      const isIndeterminate = this.progressElement.hasAttribute("data-indeterminate")
+-++++        ? this.progressElement.getAttribute("data-indeterminate") === "true"
+-++++        : value == null;
+-++++
+-++++      // Update ARIA attributes
+-++++      if (!isIndeterminate) {
+-++++        const valuePercent = Math.round((value / max) * 100);
+-++++        this.progressElement.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", String(value));
+-++++        this.progressElement.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", `${valuePercent}%`);
+-++++
+-++++        // Update indicator position
+-++++        const indicator = this.progressElement.querySelector("div");
+-++++        if (indicator) {
+-++++          indicator.style.transform = `translateX(-${100 - valuePercent}%)`;
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    // Clean up method to disconnect observer
+-++++    public destroy(): void {
+-++++      this.observer.disconnect();
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  // Store instances in a WeakMap to avoid memory leaks
+-++++  const progressInstances = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, ProgressHandler>();
+-++++
+-++++  const setupProgressBars = () => {
+-++++    document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".starwind-progress-bar").forEach((progressElement) => {
+-++++      if (!progressInstances.has(progressElement)) {
+-++++        progressInstances.set(progressElement, new ProgressHandler(progressElement));
+-++++      }
+-++++    });
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  setupProgressBars();
+-++++  document.addEventListener("astro:after-swap", setupProgressBars);
+-++++  document.addEventListener("starwind:init", setupProgressBars);
+-++++</script>

+-++++---
+-++++import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types";
+-++++
+-++++import ScrollBar from "./ScrollBar.astro";
+-++++import { scrollArea } from "./variants";
+-++++
+-++++type Props = HTMLAttributes<"div"> & {
+-++++  viewportClass?: string;
+-++++};
+-++++
+-++++const { class: className, viewportClass, ...rest } = Astro.props;
+-++++const { root, viewport, content, corner } = scrollArea();
+-++++---
+-++++
+-++++<div class={root({ class: className })} {...rest} data-slot="scroll-area">
+-++++  <div class={viewport({ class: viewportClass })} tabindex="-1" data-slot="scroll-area-viewport">
+-++++    <div class={content()} role="presentation" data-slot="scroll-area-content">
+-++++      <slot />
+-++++    </div>
+-++++  </div>
+-++++  <slot name="scrollbar">
+-++++    <ScrollBar />
+-++++  </slot>
+-++++  <div class={corner()} aria-hidden="true" data-slot="scroll-area-corner"></div>
+-++++</div>
+-++++
+-++++<style is:global>
+-++++  .starwind-scroll-area-viewport {
+-++++    scrollbar-width: none;
+-++++    -ms-overflow-style: none;
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  .starwind-scroll-area-viewport::-webkit-scrollbar {
+-++++    display: none;
+-++++  }
+-++++</style>
+-++++
+-++++<script>
+-++++  type ScrollOrientation = "vertical" | "horizontal";
+-++++  type ScrollAxis = "x" | "y";
+-++++  type SpacingProperty = "margin" | "padding";
+-++++
+-++++  const MIN_THUMB_SIZE = 20;
+-++++
+-++++  const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
+-++++
+-++++  const parseCssPixelValue = (value: string) => {
+-++++    const parsed = Number.parseFloat(value);
+-++++
+-++++    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  const getPhysicalSpacing = (
+-++++    element: Element,
+-++++    property: SpacingProperty,
+-++++    orientation: ScrollOrientation,
+-++++  ) => {
+-++++    const styles = getComputedStyle(element);
+-++++
+-++++    if (orientation === "horizontal") {
+-++++      return {
+-++++        start: parseCssPixelValue(styles.getPropertyValue(`${property}-left`)),
+-++++        end: parseCssPixelValue(styles.getPropertyValue(`${property}-right`)),
+-++++      };
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    return {
+-++++      start: parseCssPixelValue(styles.getPropertyValue(`${property}-top`)),
+-++++      end: parseCssPixelValue(styles.getPropertyValue(`${property}-bottom`)),
+-++++    };
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  const getSpacing = (
+-++++    element: Element | null,
+-++++    property: SpacingProperty,
+-++++    axis: ScrollAxis,
+-++++  ): number => {
+-++++    if (!element) return 0;
+-++++
+-++++    const styles = getComputedStyle(element);
+-++++
+-++++    if (axis === "x" && property === "margin") {
+-++++      return parseCssPixelValue(styles.getPropertyValue("margin-inline-start")) * 2;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    const propertyAxis = axis === "x" ? "inline" : "block";
+-++++
+-++++    return (
+-++++      parseCssPixelValue(styles.getPropertyValue(`${property}-${propertyAxis}-start`)) +
+-++++      parseCssPixelValue(styles.getPropertyValue(`${property}-${propertyAxis}-end`))
+-++++    );
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  class ScrollAreaHandler {
+-++++    private root: HTMLElement;
+-++++    private viewport: HTMLElement;
+-++++    private content: HTMLElement | null;
+-++++    private scrollbars: HTMLElement[];
+-++++    private corner: HTMLElement | null;
+-++++    private resizeObserver: ResizeObserver;
+-++++    private mutationObserver: MutationObserver;
+-++++
+-++++    constructor(root: HTMLElement) {
+-++++      this.root = root;
+-++++      this.viewport = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area-viewport")!;
+-++++      this.content = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area-content");
+-++++      this.scrollbars = Array.from(
+-++++        root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area-scrollbar"),
+-++++      ).filter((scrollbar) => scrollbar.closest(".starwind-scroll-area") === root);
+-++++      this.corner =
+-++++        Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area-corner")).find(
+-++++          (corner) => corner.closest(".starwind-scroll-area") === root,
+-++++        ) ?? null;
+-++++      this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => this.update());
+-++++      this.mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(() => this.update());
+-++++
+-++++      this.setupScrollbars();
+-++++      this.setupObservers();
+-++++      this.viewport.addEventListener("scroll", () => this.update());
+-++++      requestAnimationFrame(() => this.update());
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setupScrollbars(): void {
+-++++      this.scrollbars.forEach((scrollbar) => {
+-++++        const thumb = scrollbar.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area-thumb");
+-++++        if (!thumb) return;
+-++++
+-++++        thumb.style.flex = "0 0 auto";
+-++++        thumb.dataset.orientation = this.getOrientation(scrollbar);
+-++++        thumb.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) =>
+-++++          this.handleThumbPointerDown(event, scrollbar, thumb),
+-++++        );
+-++++        scrollbar.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) =>
+-++++          this.handleScrollbarPointerDown(event, scrollbar, thumb),
+-++++        );
+-++++        scrollbar.addEventListener(
+-++++          "wheel",
+-++++          (event) => this.handleScrollbarWheel(event, scrollbar),
+-++++          {
+-++++            passive: false,
+-++++          },
+-++++        );
+-++++      });
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setupObservers(): void {
+-++++      this.resizeObserver.observe(this.root);
+-++++      this.resizeObserver.observe(this.viewport);
+-++++      if (this.content) {
+-++++        this.resizeObserver.observe(this.content);
+-++++      }
+-++++      this.mutationObserver.observe(this.viewport, {
+-++++        childList: true,
+-++++        subtree: true,
+-++++        characterData: true,
+-++++      });
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private getOrientation(scrollbar: HTMLElement): ScrollOrientation {
+-++++      return scrollbar.dataset.orientation === "horizontal" ? "horizontal" : "vertical";
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private hasOverflow(orientation: ScrollOrientation): boolean {
+-++++      if (orientation === "horizontal") {
+-++++        return this.viewport.scrollWidth > this.viewport.clientWidth + 1;
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      return this.viewport.scrollHeight > this.viewport.clientHeight + 1;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private isRtl(): boolean {
+-++++      return getComputedStyle(this.viewport).direction === "rtl";
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private getScrollbar(orientation: ScrollOrientation): HTMLElement | undefined {
+-++++      return this.scrollbars.find((scrollbar) => this.getOrientation(scrollbar) === orientation);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private getScrollSize(orientation: ScrollOrientation): number {
+-++++      return orientation === "horizontal" ? this.viewport.scrollWidth : this.viewport.scrollHeight;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private getViewportSize(orientation: ScrollOrientation): number {
+-++++      return orientation === "horizontal" ? this.viewport.clientWidth : this.viewport.clientHeight;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private getMaxScrollOffset(orientation: ScrollOrientation): number {
+-++++      return Math.max(this.getScrollSize(orientation) - this.getViewportSize(orientation), 0);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private getScrollPosition(orientation: ScrollOrientation): number {
+-++++      const maxScrollOffset = this.getMaxScrollOffset(orientation);
+-++++
+-++++      if (orientation === "horizontal") {
+-++++        return clamp(
+-++++          this.isRtl() ? -this.viewport.scrollLeft : this.viewport.scrollLeft,
+-++++          0,
+-++++          maxScrollOffset,
+-++++        );
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      return clamp(this.viewport.scrollTop, 0, maxScrollOffset);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private setScrollPosition(orientation: ScrollOrientation, position: number): void {
+-++++      const nextPosition = clamp(position, 0, this.getMaxScrollOffset(orientation));
+-++++
+-++++      if (orientation === "horizontal") {
+-++++        this.viewport.scrollLeft = this.isRtl() ? -nextPosition : nextPosition;
+-++++      } else {
+-++++        this.viewport.scrollTop = nextPosition;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private getThumbMetrics(
+-++++      scrollbar: HTMLElement,
+-++++      thumb: HTMLElement,
+-++++      orientation: ScrollOrientation,
+-++++    ) {
+-++++      const axis = orientation === "horizontal" ? "x" : "y";
+-++++      const isHorizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
+-++++      const viewportSize = this.getViewportSize(orientation);
+-++++      const scrollSize = this.getScrollSize(orientation);
+-++++      const scrollbarSize = isHorizontal ? scrollbar.clientWidth : scrollbar.clientHeight;
+-++++      const scrollbarPadding = getSpacing(scrollbar, "padding", axis);
+-++++      const thumbMargin = getSpacing(thumb, "margin", axis);
+-++++      const trackSize = Math.max(scrollbarSize - scrollbarPadding - thumbMargin, 0);
+-++++      const thumbSize =
+-++++        trackSize > 0
+-++++          ? Math.min(Math.max((viewportSize / scrollSize) * trackSize, MIN_THUMB_SIZE), trackSize)
+-++++          : 0;
+-++++      const maxThumbOffset = Math.max(trackSize - thumbSize, 0);
+-++++      const maxScrollOffset = Math.max(scrollSize - viewportSize, 0);
+-++++
+-++++      return {
+-++++        maxScrollOffset,
+-++++        maxThumbOffset,
+-++++        thumbSize,
+-++++      };
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private updateLayout(hasVerticalOverflow: boolean, hasHorizontalOverflow: boolean): void {
+-++++      const verticalScrollbar = this.getScrollbar("vertical");
+-++++      const horizontalScrollbar = this.getScrollbar("horizontal");
+-++++      const shouldShowCorner = Boolean(
+-++++        hasVerticalOverflow && hasHorizontalOverflow && verticalScrollbar && horizontalScrollbar,
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      if (this.corner) {
+-++++        this.corner.style.display = shouldShowCorner ? "block" : "none";
+-++++
+-++++        if (shouldShowCorner && verticalScrollbar && horizontalScrollbar) {
+-++++          this.corner.style.width = `${verticalScrollbar.offsetWidth}px`;
+-++++          this.corner.style.height = `${horizontalScrollbar.offsetHeight}px`;
+-++++        } else {
+-++++          this.corner.style.width = "";
+-++++          this.corner.style.height = "";
+-++++        }
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      if (verticalScrollbar) {
+-++++        verticalScrollbar.style.bottom =
+-++++          shouldShowCorner && horizontalScrollbar ? `${horizontalScrollbar.offsetHeight}px` : "";
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      if (horizontalScrollbar) {
+-++++        horizontalScrollbar.style.insetInlineEnd =
+-++++          shouldShowCorner && verticalScrollbar ? `${verticalScrollbar.offsetWidth}px` : "";
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private update(): void {
+-++++      let hasVerticalOverflow = false;
+-++++      let hasHorizontalOverflow = false;
+-++++      let hasVerticalScrollbar = false;
+-++++      let hasHorizontalScrollbar = false;
+-++++
+-++++      this.scrollbars.forEach((scrollbar) => {
+-++++        const orientation = this.getOrientation(scrollbar);
+-++++        const thumb = scrollbar.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area-thumb");
+-++++        const isOverflowing = this.hasOverflow(orientation);
+-++++
+-++++        if (orientation === "vertical") {
+-++++          hasVerticalOverflow = isOverflowing;
+-++++          hasVerticalScrollbar = true;
+-++++        } else {
+-++++          hasHorizontalOverflow = isOverflowing;
+-++++          hasHorizontalScrollbar = true;
+-++++        }
+-++++
+-++++        scrollbar.style.display = isOverflowing ? "flex" : "none";
+-++++
+-++++        if (!thumb) return;
+-++++
+-++++        thumb.dataset.orientation = orientation;
+-++++      });
+-++++
+-++++      this.viewport.tabIndex = hasVerticalOverflow || hasHorizontalOverflow ? 0 : -1;
+-++++      this.updateLayout(
+-++++        hasVerticalOverflow && hasVerticalScrollbar,
+-++++        hasHorizontalOverflow && hasHorizontalScrollbar,
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      this.scrollbars.forEach((scrollbar) => {
+-++++        const orientation = this.getOrientation(scrollbar);
+-++++        const thumb = scrollbar.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area-thumb");
+-++++
+-++++        if (!thumb || !this.hasOverflow(orientation)) return;
+-++++
+-++++        this.updateThumb(scrollbar, thumb, orientation);
+-++++      });
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private updateThumb(
+-++++      scrollbar: HTMLElement,
+-++++      thumb: HTMLElement,
+-++++      orientation: ScrollOrientation,
+-++++    ): void {
+-++++      const isHorizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
+-++++      const { maxScrollOffset, maxThumbOffset, thumbSize } = this.getThumbMetrics(
+-++++        scrollbar,
+-++++        thumb,
+-++++        orientation,
+-++++      );
+-++++      const scrollPosition = this.getScrollPosition(orientation);
+-++++      const thumbOffset =
+-++++        maxScrollOffset === 0 ? 0 : (scrollPosition / maxScrollOffset) * maxThumbOffset;
+-++++
+-++++      if (isHorizontal) {
+-++++        thumb.style.width = `${thumbSize}px`;
+-++++        thumb.style.height = "100%";
+-++++        thumb.style.transform = `translateX(${this.isRtl() ? -thumbOffset : thumbOffset}px)`;
+-++++      } else {
+-++++        thumb.style.height = `${thumbSize}px`;
+-++++        thumb.style.width = "100%";
+-++++        thumb.style.transform = `translateY(${thumbOffset}px)`;
+-++++      }
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private handleScrollbarPointerDown(
+-++++      event: PointerEvent,
+-++++      scrollbar: HTMLElement,
+-++++      thumb: HTMLElement,
+-++++    ): void {
+-++++      if (event.button !== 0 || !event.isPrimary || thumb.contains(event.target as Node)) return;
+-++++
+-++++      event.preventDefault();
+-++++      const orientation = this.getOrientation(scrollbar);
+-++++      const isHorizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
+-++++      const rect = scrollbar.getBoundingClientRect();
+-++++      const scrollbarPadding = getPhysicalSpacing(scrollbar, "padding", orientation);
+-++++      const thumbMargin = getPhysicalSpacing(thumb, "margin", orientation);
+-++++      const pointerPosition = isHorizontal
+-++++        ? this.isRtl()
+-++++          ? rect.right - event.clientX - scrollbarPadding.end - thumbMargin.end
+-++++          : event.clientX - rect.left - scrollbarPadding.start - thumbMargin.start
+-++++        : event.clientY - rect.top - scrollbarPadding.start - thumbMargin.start;
+-++++      const { maxScrollOffset, maxThumbOffset, thumbSize } = this.getThumbMetrics(
+-++++        scrollbar,
+-++++        thumb,
+-++++        orientation,
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      if (maxThumbOffset === 0) return;
+-++++
+-++++      const nextThumbOffset = Math.min(
+-++++        Math.max(pointerPosition - thumbSize / 2, 0),
+-++++        maxThumbOffset,
+-++++      );
+-++++      const nextScrollPosition = (nextThumbOffset / maxThumbOffset) * maxScrollOffset;
+-++++
+-++++      this.setScrollPosition(orientation, nextScrollPosition);
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private handleScrollbarWheel(event: WheelEvent, scrollbar: HTMLElement): void {
+-++++      const orientation = this.getOrientation(scrollbar);
+-++++      const isHorizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
+-++++
+-++++      if (event.ctrlKey || !this.hasOverflow(orientation)) return;
+-++++
+-++++      const delta = isHorizontal ? event.deltaX : event.deltaY;
+-++++      if (delta === 0) return;
+-++++
+-++++      const scrollProperty = isHorizontal ? "scrollLeft" : "scrollTop";
+-++++      const maxScrollOffset = this.getMaxScrollOffset(orientation);
+-++++      const minScroll = isHorizontal && this.isRtl() ? -maxScrollOffset : 0;
+-++++      const maxScroll = isHorizontal && this.isRtl() ? 0 : maxScrollOffset;
+-++++      const scrollPosition = this.viewport[scrollProperty];
+-++++      const nextScrollPosition = clamp(scrollPosition + delta, minScroll, maxScroll);
+-++++
+-++++      if (nextScrollPosition === scrollPosition) return;
+-++++
+-++++      event.preventDefault();
+-++++      this.viewport[scrollProperty] = nextScrollPosition;
+-++++    }
+-++++
+-++++    private handleThumbPointerDown(
+-++++      event: PointerEvent,
+-++++      scrollbar: HTMLElement,
+-++++      thumb: HTMLElement,
+-++++    ): void {
+-++++      if (event.button !== 0 || !event.isPrimary) return;
+-++++
+-++++      event.preventDefault();
+-++++
+-++++      const orientation = this.getOrientation(scrollbar);
+-++++      const isHorizontal = orientation === "horizontal";
+-++++      const startPointerPosition = isHorizontal ? event.clientX : event.clientY;
+-++++      const startScrollPosition = this.getScrollPosition(orientation);
+-++++      const { maxScrollOffset, maxThumbOffset } = this.getThumbMetrics(
+-++++        scrollbar,
+-++++        thumb,
+-++++        orientation,
+-++++      );
+-++++
+-++++      if (maxThumbOffset === 0) return;
+-++++
+-++++      if (!thumb.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
+-++++        thumb.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
+-++++      }
+-++++
+-++++      const handlePointerMove = (moveEvent: PointerEvent) => {
+-++++        const pointerPosition = isHorizontal ? moveEvent.clientX : moveEvent.clientY;
+-++++        const delta =
+-++++          isHorizontal && this.isRtl()
+-++++            ? startPointerPosition - pointerPosition
+-++++            : pointerPosition - startPointerPosition;
+-++++        const nextScrollPosition = startScrollPosition + (delta / maxThumbOffset) * maxScrollOffset;
+-++++
+-++++        this.setScrollPosition(orientation, nextScrollPosition);
+-++++      };
+-++++
+-++++      const handlePointerUp = (upEvent: PointerEvent) => {
+-++++        if (thumb.hasPointerCapture(upEvent.pointerId)) {
+-++++          thumb.releasePointerCapture(upEvent.pointerId);
+-++++        }
+-++++        thumb.removeEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
+-++++        thumb.removeEventListener("pointerup", handlePointerUp);
+-++++        thumb.removeEventListener("pointercancel", handlePointerUp);
+-++++      };
+-++++
+-++++      thumb.addEventListener("pointermove", handlePointerMove);
+-++++      thumb.addEventListener("pointerup", handlePointerUp);
+-++++      thumb.addEventListener("pointercancel", handlePointerUp);
+-++++    }
+-++++  }
+-++++
+-++++  const scrollAreaInstances = new WeakMap<HTMLElement, ScrollAreaHandler>();
+-++++
+-++++  const setupScrollAreas = () => {
+-++++    document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".starwind-scroll-area").forEach((root) => {
+-++++      if (!scrollAreaInstances.has(root) && root.querySelector(".starwind-scroll-area-viewport")) {
+-++++        scrollAreaInstances.set(root, new ScrollAreaHandler(root));
+-++++      }
+-++++    });
+-++++  };
+-++++
+-++++  setupScrollAreas();
+-++++  document.addEventListener("astro:after-swap", setupScrollAreas);
+-++++  document.addEventListener("starwind:init", setupScrollAreas);
+-++++</script>

+-++++---
+-++++import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types";
+-++++
+-++++type Props = HTMLAttributes<"div"> & {
+-++++  /**
+-++++   * The name for the hidden <select> element - used for standard form handling
+-++++   */
+-++++  name?: string;
+-++++  /**
+-++++   * The value of the item that should be selected by default
+-++++   */
+-++++  defaultValue?: string;
+-++++  /**
+-++++   * Whether the select field is required in a form context
+-++++   */
+-++++  required?: boolean;
+-++++
+-++++  children: any;
+-++++};
+-++++
+-++++const { class: className, name, defaultValue, required, ...rest } = Astro.props;
+-++++---
+-++++
+-++++<div
+-++++  class:list={["starwind-select", "relative", className]}
+-++++  data-name={name}
+-++++  data-value={defaultValue}
+-++++  data-required={required}
+-++++  {...rest}
+-++++  data-slot="select"
+-++++>
+-++++  <slot />
+-++++</div>
