+-++/**
+-++ * Starwind Toast API
+-++ *
+-++ * A simple, framework-agnostic toast notification system.
+-++ *
+-++ * @example
+-++ * ```ts
+-++ * import { toast } from "@/components/starwind/toast";
+-++ *
+-++ * // Simple usage
+-++ * toast("Hello world");
+-++ * toast({ title: "Success", description: "Item saved" });
+-++ *
+-++ * // Variant shortcuts
+-++ * toast.success("Saved successfully");
+-++ * toast.error("Something went wrong");
+-++ * toast.warning("Please check your input");
+-++ * toast.info("New update available");
+-++ * toast.loading("Processing...");
+-++ *
+-++ * // Promise handling
+-++ * toast.promise(saveData(), {
+-++ *   loading: "Saving...",
+-++ *   success: "Saved!",
+-++ *   error: "Failed to save",
+-++ * });
+-++ *
+-++ * // Management
+-++ * const id = toast("Processing...");
+-++ * toast.update(id, { title: "Almost done..." });
+-++ * toast.dismiss(id);
+-++ * toast.dismiss(); // dismiss all
+-++ * ```
+-++ */
+-++
+-++export type Variant = "default" | "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info" | "loading";
+-++
+-++export interface ToastOptions {
+-++  id?: string;
+-++  title?: string;
+-++  description?: string;
+-++  variant?: Variant;
+-++  /** Duration in ms. Set to 0 for infinite (no auto-dismiss). */
+-++  duration?: number;
+-++  /** Callback when toast close animation starts */
+-++  onClose?: () => void;
+-++  /** Callback when toast is removed from DOM */
+-++  onRemove?: () => void;
+-++  action?: {
+-++    label: string;
+-++    onClick: () => void;
+-++  };
+-++}
+-++
+-++export interface PromiseStateOption {
+-++  title?: string;
+-++  description?: string;
+-++  duration?: number;
+-++}
+-++
+-++export type PromiseStateValue<T> =
+-++  | string
+-++  | PromiseStateOption
+-++  | ((data: T) => string | PromiseStateOption);
+-++
+-++export interface PromiseOptions<T, E = Error> {
+-++  loading: string | PromiseStateOption;
+-++  success: PromiseStateValue<T>;
+-++  error: PromiseStateValue<E>;
+-++}
+-++
+-++interface ToastManager {
+-++  add(options: ToastOptions): string;
+-++  update(id: string, options: Partial<ToastOptions>): void;
+-++  close(id: string): void;
+-++  closeAll(): void;
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Get the toast manager instance from the window
+-++ */
+-++function getManager(): ToastManager | null {
+-++  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
+-++  return (window as any).__starwind__.toast as ToastManager | null;
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Normalize a string or options object to ToastOptions
+-++ */
+-++function normalizeOption<T>(
+-++  value: string | PromiseStateOption | ((data: T) => string | PromiseStateOption),
+-++  data?: T,
+-++): Omit<ToastOptions, "variant"> {
+-++  const resolved = typeof value === "function" ? value(data as T) : value;
+-++  if (typeof resolved === "string") {
+-++    return { title: resolved };
+-++  }
+-++  return resolved;
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Create a toast notification
+-++ */
+-++function createToast(
+-++  messageOrOptions: string | ToastOptions,
+-++  extraOptions?: Omit<ToastOptions, "title">,
+-++): string {
+-++  let options: ToastOptions;
+-++  if (typeof messageOrOptions === "string") {
+-++    options = { title: messageOrOptions, ...extraOptions };
+-++  } else {
+-++    options = messageOrOptions;
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  const manager = getManager();
+-++  if (manager) {
+-++    return manager.add(options);
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  console.warn("Toast: No Toaster found. Add <Toaster /> to your layout.");
+-++  return "";
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Create a toast with a specific variant
+-++ */
+-++function createVariantToast(
+-++  variant: Variant,
+-++  message: string,
+-++  options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">,
+-++): string {
+-++  return createToast({ ...options, title: message, variant });
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Toast API interface
+-++ */
+-++interface ToastAPI {
+-++  (message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "title">): string;
+-++  (options: ToastOptions): string;
+-++  success(message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">): string;
+-++  error(message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">): string;
+-++  warning(message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">): string;
+-++  info(message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">): string;
+-++  loading(message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">): string;
+-++  promise<T, E = Error>(promise: Promise<T>, options: PromiseOptions<T, E>): Promise<T>;
+-++  update(id: string, options: Partial<ToastOptions>): void;
+-++  dismiss(id?: string): void;
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Main toast function with variant methods attached
+-++ */
+-++const toast = createToast as ToastAPI;
+-++
+-++toast.success = (message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">) =>
+-++  createVariantToast("success", message, options);
+-++
+-++toast.error = (message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">) =>
+-++  createVariantToast("error", message, options);
+-++
+-++toast.warning = (message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">) =>
+-++  createVariantToast("warning", message, options);
+-++
+-++toast.info = (message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">) =>
+-++  createVariantToast("info", message, options);
+-++
+-++toast.loading = (message: string, options?: Omit<ToastOptions, "variant">) =>
+-++  createVariantToast("loading", message, { ...options, duration: 0 });
+-++
+-++toast.promise = async <T, E = Error>(
+-++  promise: Promise<T>,
+-++  options: PromiseOptions<T, E>,
+-++): Promise<T> => {
+-++  const loadingOpts = normalizeOption(options.loading);
+-++  const id = createToast({
+-++    ...loadingOpts,
+-++    variant: "loading",
+-++    duration: 0, // Don't auto-dismiss while loading
+-++  });
+-++
+-++  try {
+-++    const data = await promise;
+-++    const successOpts = normalizeOption(options.success, data);
+-++    toast.update(id, { ...successOpts, variant: "success" });
+-++    return data;
+-++  } catch (error) {
+-++    const errorOpts = normalizeOption(options.error, error as E);
+-++    toast.update(id, { ...errorOpts, variant: "error" });
+-++    throw error;
+-++  }
+-++};
+-++
+-++toast.update = (id: string, options: Partial<ToastOptions>): void => {
+-++  const manager = getManager();
+-++  if (manager) {
+-++    manager.update(id, options);
+-++  } else {
+-++    console.warn("Toast: No Toaster found. Add <Toaster /> to your layout.");
+-++  }
+-++};
+-++
+-++toast.dismiss = (id?: string): void => {
+-++  const manager = getManager();
+-++  if (!manager) {
+-++    // Can't dismiss if manager isn't ready
+-++    return;
+-++  }
+-++  if (id) {
+-++    manager.close(id);
+-++  } else {
+-++    manager.closeAll();
+-++  }
+-++};
+-++
+-++export { toast };

+-++// Flue AI Generation - Direct API calls (no Mastra dependency)
+-++// MiniMax M2.7 does not match Pi model catalog, so we call the API directly.
+-++import { getMinimaxApiKey } from '@/lib/env';
+-++import {
+-++  ListingDataSchema,
+-++  SkuDataSchema,
+-++  BlogDataSchema,
+-++  LandingDataSchema,
+-++  type ListingOutput,
+-++  type SkuOutput,
+-++  type BlogOutput,
+-++  type LandingOutput,
+-++} from '@/lib/ai/valibot-schemas';
+-++import { LISTING_INSTRUCTIONS, SKU_INSTRUCTIONS, BLOG_INSTRUCTIONS, LANDING_INSTRUCTIONS } from '@/lib/ai/validation';
+-++
+-++const API_BASE = 'https://api.minimax.chat/v1';
+-++
+-++interface GenerateOptions {
+-++  systemPrompt: string;
+-++  userMessage: string;
+-++  schema: unknown; // Valibot schema
+-++}
+-++
+-++export async function generateWithMinimax(options: GenerateOptions): Promise<unknown> {
+-++  const apiKey = getMinimaxApiKey();
+-++  if (!apiKey) {
+-++    throw new Error('MINIMAX_API_KEY is not configured');
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/text/chatcompletion_v2`, {
+-++    method: 'POST',
+-++    headers: {
+-++      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+-++      'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
+-++    },
+-++    body: JSON.stringify({
+-++      model: 'MiniMax-M2.7',
+-++      messages: [
+-++        { role: 'system', content: options.systemPrompt },
+-++        { role: 'user', content: options.userMessage },
+-++      ],
+-++      resp_format: { type: 'json_object' },
+-++    }),
+-++  });
+-++
+-++  if (!response.ok) {
+-++    const errText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
+-++    throw new Error(`MiniMax API error ${response.status}: ${errText}`);
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  const json = await response.json() as { choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[] };
+-++  const content = json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
+-++
+-++  if (!content) {
+-++    throw new Error('Empty response from MiniMax API');
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  return JSON.parse(content);
+-++}
+-++
+-++export async function generateListing(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-++  const message = buildListingMessage(data);
+-++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-++    systemPrompt: LISTING_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-++    userMessage: message,
+-++    schema: ListingDataSchema,
+-++  }) as ListingOutput;
+-++}
+-++
+-++export async function generateSku(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-++  const message = buildSkuMessage(data);
+-++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-++    systemPrompt: SKU_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-++    userMessage: message,
+-++    schema: SkuDataSchema,
+-++  }) as SkuOutput;
+-++}
+-++
+-++export async function generateBlog(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-++  const message = buildBlogMessage(data);
+-++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-++    systemPrompt: BLOG_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-++    userMessage: message,
+-++    schema: BlogDataSchema,
+-++  }) as BlogOutput;
+-++}
+-++
+-++export async function generateLanding(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
+-++  const message = buildLandingMessage(data);
+-++  return await generateWithMinimax({
+-++    systemPrompt: LANDING_INSTRUCTIONS,
+-++    userMessage: message,
+-++    schema: LandingDataSchema,
+-++  }) as LandingOutput;
+-++}

+-++function buildListingMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
+-++  const title = String(data.title ?? '');
+-++  const entityType = String(data.entityType ?? 'business');
+-++  const contactName = String(data.contactName ?? '');
+-++  const phone = String(data.phone ?? '');
+-++  const email = String(data.email ?? '');
+-++  const address = String(data.address ?? '');
+-++  const about = String(data.about ?? '');
+-++  const tags = Array.isArray(data.tags) ? data.tags : String(data.tags ?? '').split(',');
+-++  return `Create a listing for "${title}" (${entityType}).
+-++Contact: ${contactName || 'N/A'}
+-++Phone: ${phone || 'N/A'}
+-++Email: ${email || 'N/A'}
+-++Address: ${address || 'N/A'}
+-++About: ${about || 'N/A'}
+-++Tags: ${Array.isArray(tags) ? tags.join(', ') : tags || 'N/A'}`;
+-++}
+-++
+-++function buildSkuMessage(data: Record<string, unknown>): string {
+-++  const skuTitle = String(data.title ?? '');
+-++  const skuDesc = String(data.description ?? '');
+-++  const priceVal = String(data.priceValue ?? 'N/A');
+-++  const priceFields = Array.isArray(data.priceFields) ? data.priceFields : [];
+-++  const priceInfo = priceFields.length > 0
+-++    ? priceFields.map((p: { label: string; value: string; unit?: string }) =>
+-++        `${p.label}: ${p.value} ${p.unit || ''}`).join(', ')
+-++    : `Price: ${priceVal}`;
+-++  return `Create a ${data.productType || 'product'} called "${skuTitle}".
+-++Description: ${skuDesc}
+-++${priceInfo}`;
+-++}

+-++Requirements: ${data.prompt || 'N/A'}`;

+-++import { getDb, getRawDb } from '@/lib/db';
+-++import { businesses, users } from '@/db/schema';
+-++import { eq, and } from 'drizzle-orm';
+-++import { getSubscriptionDashboard } from '@/lib/subscription';
+-++import { getAuth } from '@/lib/auth';
+-++
+-++interface BusinessResult {
+-++  business: typeof businesses.$inferSelect | null;
+-++  owner: { name: string | null; email: string | null } | null;
+-++  isOwner: boolean;
+-++  subscriptionStatus: string;
+-++  planExpiresAt: number | null;
+-++  profileImage: { r2_key: string; alt: string | null } | null;
+-++  galleryImages: { r2_key: string; alt: string | null }[];
+-++}
+-++
+-++export async function getBusinessBySlug(slug: string): Promise<BusinessResult> {
+-++  if (!slug) return empty();
+-++
+-++  const db = await getDb();
+-++  if (!db) return empty();
+-++
+-++  try {
+-++    const business = await db
+-++      .select()
+-++      .from(businesses)
+-++      .where(and(eq(businesses.slug, slug), eq(businesses.status, 'active')))
+-++      .get();
+-++
+-++    if (!business) return empty();
+-++
+-++    // Owner check via better-auth session
+-++    let isOwner = false;
+-++    let owner: { name: string | null; email: string | null } | null = null;
+-++    try {
+-++      const auth = await getAuth();
+-++      const session = await auth.api.getSession().catch(() => null);
+-++      if (session?.user?.id === business.ownerId) {
+-++        isOwner = true;
+-++        const [ownerRow] = await db
+-++          .select({ name: users.name, email: users.email })
+-++          .from(users)
+-++          .where(eq(users.id, business.ownerId))
+-++          .limit(1);
+-++        owner = ownerRow ?? null;
+-++      }
+-++    } catch {}
+-++
+-++    // Subscription from orders table
+-++    const subscriptionInfo = await getSubscriptionDashboard(business.id);
+-++    const subscriptionStatus = subscriptionInfo?.status || 'none';
+-++    const planExpiresAt = subscriptionInfo?.expiresAt
+-++      ? Math.floor(new Date(subscriptionInfo.expiresAt).getTime() / 1000)
+-++      : null;
+-++
+-++    // Media
+-++    const mediaIds: string[] = [];
+-++    if (business.profileImageId) mediaIds.push(business.profileImageId);
+-++    if (business.photoGallery) {
+-++      try { mediaIds.push(...JSON.parse(business.photoGallery as string).filter((id: string) => !mediaIds.includes(id))); } catch {}
+-++    }
+-++
+-++    let profileImage: { r2_key: string; alt: string | null } | null = null;
+-++    let galleryImages: { r2_key: string; alt: string | null }[] = [];
+-++
+-++    if (mediaIds.length) {
+-++      const rawDb = await getRawDb();
+-++      if (rawDb) {
+-++        const placeholders = mediaIds.map(() => '?').join(',');
+-++        const imgsResult = await rawDb.prepare(
+-++          `SELECT id, r2_key, alt FROM media WHERE id IN (${placeholders})`
+-++        ).bind(...mediaIds).all() as unknown as { id: string; r2_key: string; alt: string | null }[];
+-++
+-++        if (business.profileImageId) {
+-++          profileImage = imgsResult.find(img => img.id === business.profileImageId!) ?? null;
+-++        }
+-++        galleryImages = imgsResult.filter(img => img.id !== business.profileImageId);
+-++      }
+-++    }
+-++
+-++    return { business, owner, isOwner, subscriptionStatus, planExpiresAt, profileImage, galleryImages };
+-++  } catch (e) {

+-++
+-++  const tableMap: Record<EntityType, string> = {
+-++    'non-profit': 'non_profits',
+-++    'public-sector': 'public_sectors',
+-++  };
+-++  const categoryTableMap: Record<EntityType, string> = {
+-++    'non-profit': 'non_profit_categories',
+-++    'public-sector': 'public_sector_categories',
+-++  };
+-++
+-++  const table = tableMap[entityType];
+-++  const categoryTable = categoryTableMap[entityType];

+-++             address, year_of_establishment, opening_hours, tags, social_links,
+-++             likes, saves, views, category_id, status, profile_image_id, photo_gallery
+-++      FROM ${table} WHERE slug = ? LIMIT 1
+-++    `).bind(slug).first() as NonProfitRecord | null;
+-++
+-++    if (!entity) return { entity: null, category: null, socialLinks: {}, tags: [], galleryImages: [], profileImage: null };
+-++
+-++    let category: { name: string } | null = null;
+-++    if (entity.category_id) {
+-++      category = await db.prepare(`SELECT name FROM ${categoryTable} WHERE id = ? LIMIT 1`)
+-++        .bind(entity.category_id).first() as { name: string } | null;
+-++    }
+-++
+-++    let socialLinks: Record<string, string> = {};
+-++    if (entity.social_links) {
+-++      try { socialLinks = JSON.parse(entity.social_links); } catch {}
+-++    }
+-++
+-++    let tags: string[] = [];
+-++    if (entity.tags) {

+-++    }
+-++

+-++        } catch {}

+-++        }

+-++      }

+-++  } catch (e) {

+-++export type FloatingSide = "top" | "bottom" | "left" | "right";
+-++export type FloatingAlign = "start" | "center" | "end";
+-++
+-++interface Placement {
+-++  side: FloatingSide;
+-++  align: FloatingAlign;
+-++}
+-++
+-++interface Position {
+-++  top: number;
+-++  left: number;
+-++}
+-++
+-++interface OverflowAmount {
+-++  left: number;
+-++  right: number;
+-++  top: number;
+-++  bottom: number;
+-++}
+-++
+-++export interface ResolvePlacementOptions {
+-++  side: FloatingSide;
+-++  align: FloatingAlign;
+-++  sideOffset: number;
+-++  triggerRect: DOMRect;
+-++  contentWidth: number;
+-++  contentHeight: number;
+-++  viewportWidth: number;
+-++  viewportHeight: number;
+-++  viewportPadding: number;
+-++  avoidCollisions?: boolean;
+-++}
+-++
+-++export interface ResolvePlacementResult {
+-++  side: FloatingSide;
+-++  align: FloatingAlign;
+-++  top: number;
+-++  left: number;
+-++}
+-++
+-++function getOppositeSide(side: FloatingSide): FloatingSide {
+-++  switch (side) {
+-++    case "top":
+-++      return "bottom";
+-++    case "bottom":
+-++      return "top";
+-++    case "left":
+-++      return "right";
+-++    case "right":
+-++      return "left";
+-++  }
+-++}
+-++
+-++function getOppositeAlign(align: FloatingAlign): FloatingAlign {
+-++  switch (align) {
+-++    case "start":
+-++      return "end";
+-++    case "end":
+-++      return "start";
+-++    case "center":
+-++      return "center";
+-++  }
+-++}
+-++
+-++function getPlacementCandidates(side: FloatingSide, align: FloatingAlign): Placement[] {
+-++  const placements: Placement[] = [];
+-++
+-++  const pushUnique = (candidate: Placement) => {
+-++    if (
+-++      !placements.some(
+-++        (placement) => placement.side === candidate.side && placement.align === candidate.align,
+-++      )
+-++    ) {
+-++      placements.push(candidate);
+-++    }
+-++  };
+-++
+-++  const oppositeSide = getOppositeSide(side);
+-++  const oppositeAlign = getOppositeAlign(align);
+-++
+-++  pushUnique({ side, align });
+-++  pushUnique({ side: oppositeSide, align });
+-++  pushUnique({ side, align: "center" });
+-++  pushUnique({ side: oppositeSide, align: "center" });
+-++  pushUnique({ side, align: oppositeAlign });
+-++  pushUnique({ side: oppositeSide, align: oppositeAlign });
+-++
+-++  if (side === "top" || side === "bottom") {
+-++    for (const fallbackAlign of ["start", "center", "end"] as const) {
+-++      pushUnique({ side: "right", align: fallbackAlign });
+-++      pushUnique({ side: "left", align: fallbackAlign });
+-++    }
+-++  } else {
+-++    for (const fallbackAlign of ["start", "center", "end"] as const) {
+-++      pushUnique({ side: "bottom", align: fallbackAlign });
+-++      pushUnique({ side: "top", align: fallbackAlign });
+-++    }
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  return placements;
+-++}
+-++
+-++function getPlacementPosition(
+-++  placement: Placement,
+-++  triggerRect: DOMRect,
+-++  contentWidth: number,
+-++  contentHeight: number,
+-++  sideOffset: number,
+-++): Position {
+-++  let top = 0;
+-++  let left = 0;
+-++
+-++  if (placement.side === "bottom" || placement.side === "top") {
+-++    top =
+-++      placement.side === "bottom"
+-++        ? triggerRect.bottom + sideOffset
+-++        : triggerRect.top - contentHeight - sideOffset;
+-++
+-++    if (placement.align === "start") {
+-++      left = triggerRect.left;
+-++    } else if (placement.align === "end") {
+-++      left = triggerRect.right - contentWidth;
+-++    } else {
+-++      left = triggerRect.left + (triggerRect.width - contentWidth) / 2;
+-++    }
+-++  } else {
+-++    left =
+-++      placement.side === "right"
+-++        ? triggerRect.right + sideOffset
+-++        : triggerRect.left - contentWidth - sideOffset;
+-++
+-++    if (placement.align === "start") {
+-++      top = triggerRect.top;
+-++    } else if (placement.align === "end") {
+-++      top = triggerRect.bottom - contentHeight;
+-++    } else {
+-++      top = triggerRect.top + (triggerRect.height - contentHeight) / 2;
+-++    }
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  return { top, left };
+-++}
+-++
+-++function clampPositionToViewport(
+-++  position: Position,
+-++  contentWidth: number,
+-++  contentHeight: number,
+-++  viewportWidth: number,
+-++  viewportHeight: number,
+-++  viewportPadding: number,
+-++): Position {
+-++  const maxLeft = Math.max(viewportPadding, viewportWidth - contentWidth - viewportPadding);
+-++  const maxTop = Math.max(viewportPadding, viewportHeight - contentHeight - viewportPadding);
+-++
+-++  return {
+-++    left: Math.min(Math.max(viewportPadding, position.left), maxLeft),
+-++    top: Math.min(Math.max(viewportPadding, position.top), maxTop),
+-++  };
+-++}
+-++
+-++function getOverflowAmount(
+-++  position: Position,
+-++  contentWidth: number,
+-++  contentHeight: number,
+-++  viewportWidth: number,
+-++  viewportHeight: number,
+-++  viewportPadding: number,
+-++): OverflowAmount {
+-++  const right = position.left + contentWidth;
+-++  const bottom = position.top + contentHeight;
+-++
+-++  return {
+-++    left: Math.max(0, viewportPadding - position.left),
+-++    top: Math.max(0, viewportPadding - position.top),
+-++    right: Math.max(0, right - (viewportWidth - viewportPadding)),
+-++    bottom: Math.max(0, bottom - (viewportHeight - viewportPadding)),
+-++  };
+-++}
+-++
+-++function getMainAxisShift(
+-++  side: FloatingSide,
+-++  preferredPosition: Position,
+-++  clampedPosition: Position,
+-++): number {
+-++  if (side === "top" || side === "bottom") {
+-++    return Math.abs(clampedPosition.top - preferredPosition.top);
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  return Math.abs(clampedPosition.left - preferredPosition.left);
+-++}
+-++
+-++function getCrossAxisShift(
+-++  side: FloatingSide,
+-++  preferredPosition: Position,
+-++  clampedPosition: Position,
+-++): number {
+-++  if (side === "top" || side === "bottom") {
+-++    return Math.abs(clampedPosition.left - preferredPosition.left);
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  return Math.abs(clampedPosition.top - preferredPosition.top);
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Resolves the best side/alignment placement for floating content.
+-++ */
+-++export function resolvePlacement(options: ResolvePlacementOptions): ResolvePlacementResult {
+-++  const {
+-++    side,
+-++    align,
+-++    sideOffset,
+-++    triggerRect,
+-++    contentWidth,
+-++    contentHeight,
+-++    viewportWidth,
+-++    viewportHeight,
+-++    viewportPadding,
+-++    avoidCollisions = true,
+-++  } = options;
+-++
+-++  const preferredPlacement: Placement = { side, align };
+-++
+-++  if (!avoidCollisions) {
+-++    const preferredPosition = getPlacementPosition(
+-++      preferredPlacement,
+-++      triggerRect,
+-++      contentWidth,
+-++      contentHeight,
+-++      sideOffset,
+-++    );
+-++
+-++    return {
+-++      side,
+-++      align,
+-++      top: preferredPosition.top,
+-++      left: preferredPosition.left,
+-++    };
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  const candidates = getPlacementCandidates(side, align);
+-++
+-++  let bestPlacement = candidates[0] ?? preferredPlacement;
+-++  let bestPosition = clampPositionToViewport(
+-++    getPlacementPosition(bestPlacement, triggerRect, contentWidth, contentHeight, sideOffset),
+-++    contentWidth,
+-++    contentHeight,
+-++    viewportWidth,
+-++    viewportHeight,
+-++    viewportPadding,
+-++  );
+-++  let bestScore = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
+-++
+-++  for (const placement of candidates) {
+-++    const preferredPosition = getPlacementPosition(
+-++      placement,
+-++      triggerRect,
+-++      contentWidth,
+-++      contentHeight,
+-++      sideOffset,
+-++    );
+-++    const clampedPosition = clampPositionToViewport(
+-++      preferredPosition,
+-++      contentWidth,
+-++      contentHeight,
+-++      viewportWidth,
+-++      viewportHeight,
+-++      viewportPadding,
+-++    );
+-++
+-++    const overflow = getOverflowAmount(
+-++      preferredPosition,
+-++      contentWidth,
+-++      contentHeight,
+-++      viewportWidth,
+-++      viewportHeight,
+-++      viewportPadding,
+-++    );
+-++
+-++    const overflowTotal = overflow.left + overflow.right + overflow.top + overflow.bottom;
+-++    const mainAxisShift = getMainAxisShift(placement.side, preferredPosition, clampedPosition);
+-++    const crossAxisShift = getCrossAxisShift(placement.side, preferredPosition, clampedPosition);
+-++
+-++    const sidePenalty = placement.side === side ? 0 : 32;
+-++    const alignPenalty = placement.align === align ? 0 : 8;
+-++    const score =
+-++      overflowTotal * 24 + mainAxisShift * 8 + crossAxisShift * 3 + sidePenalty + alignPenalty;
+-++
+-++    if (score < bestScore) {
+-++      bestScore = score;
+-++      bestPlacement = placement;
+-++      bestPosition = clampedPosition;
+-++    }
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  return {
+-++    side: bestPlacement.side,
+-++    align: bestPlacement.align,
+-++    top: bestPosition.top,
+-++    left: bestPosition.left,
+-++  };
+-++}
+-++
+-++/**
+-++ * Returns a transform-origin value that matches the resolved placement.
+-++ */
+-++export function getTransformOrigin(side: FloatingSide, align: FloatingAlign): string {
+-++  if (side === "top" || side === "bottom") {
+-++    const vertical = side === "bottom" ? "top" : "bottom";
+-++    const horizontal = align === "start" ? "left" : align === "end" ? "right" : "center";
+-++
+-++    return `${horizontal} ${vertical}`;
+-++  }
+-++
+-++  const horizontal = side === "right" ? "left" : "right";
+-++  const vertical = align === "start" ? "top" : align === "end" ? "bottom" : "center";
+-++
+-++  return `${horizontal} ${vertical}`;
+-++}

+-+-// bindings are not available at module initialization time. Use getMastra()
+-+-// to access the Mastra instance — it creates the instance on first call.
+-+-// The CloudflareDeployer vars use placeholder values since they are resolved
+-+-// at request-handler time when the real env is available.
+-+-
+-+-import { Mastra } from "@mastra/core";
+-+-import { CloudflareDeployer } from "@mastra/deployer-cloudflare";
+-+-import { agents } from "./agents";
+-+-
+-+-export const providers = {
+-+-  default: "minimax-cn-coding-plan",
+-+-} as const;
+-+-
+-+-export type ProviderName = typeof providers.default;
+-+-
+-+-let _mastra: Mastra | null = null;
+-+-
+-+-export function getMastra(): Mastra {
+-+-  if (!_mastra) {
+-+-    _mastra = new Mastra({
+-+-      agents,
+-+-      deployer: new CloudflareDeployer({
+-+-        name: 'TimorUp-ai',
+-+-        // Placeholder — replace with real env vars at request time if needed
+-+-        vars: {},
+-+-      }),
+-+-    });
+-+-  }
+-+-  return _mastra;
+-+-}
+-+-
+-+-// Backwards-compatible named export
+-+-export const mastra = { get mastra() { return getMastra(); } };

+-+-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+-  async function authFetch(url, options = {}) {
+-+-    return fetch(url, {
+-+-      ...options,
+-+-      credentials: 'include',
+-+-      headers: {
+-+-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+-        ...options.headers,
+-+-      },
+-+-    });
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Check authentication on page load
+-+-  async function checkAuth() {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/auth/session');
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-      if (!data.user || !['admin', 'super_admin', 'editor'].includes(data.user.role)) {
+-+-        window.location.href = '/admin/login?redirect=/admin';
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (e) {
+-+-      window.location.href = '/admin/login?redirect=/admin';
+-+-    }
+-+-  }

+-+-  // Render revenue bar chart
+-+-  function renderRevenueChart(monthlyData: { month: string; revenue: number }[]) {
+-+-    const chart = document.getElementById('revenue-chart');
+-+-    if (!chart) return;
+-+-
+-+-    const maxRevenue = Math.max(...monthlyData.map(m => m.revenue), 1);
+-+-    const chartHeight = 120;
+-+-
+-+-    chart.innerHTML = monthlyData.map(m => {
+-+-      const heightPercent = (m.revenue / maxRevenue) * 100;
+-+-      const heightPx = Math.max((heightPercent / 100) * chartHeight, 4);
+-+-      return `
+-+-        <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
+-+-          <div class="w-full bg-gradient-to-t from-amber-400 to-amber-300 rounded-t transition-all hover:opacity-80 cursor-help relative group" style="height: ${heightPx}px">
+-+-            <div class="absolute -top-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-gray-800 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 whitespace-nowrap z-10">
+-+-              $${m.revenue}
+-+-            </div>
+-+-          </div>
+-+-          <span class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${m.month}</span>
+-+-        </div>
+-+-      `;
+-+-    }).join('');
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Render SVG line chart
+-+-  function renderLineChart(svgId: string, data: number[], labels: string[], color: string) {
+-+-    const svg = document.getElementById(svgId) as unknown as SVGSVGElement;
+-+-    if (!svg) return;
+-+-
+-+-    const width = svg.clientWidth || 400;
+-+-    const height = svg.clientHeight || 128;
+-+-    const padding = { top: 10, right: 10, bottom: 30, left: 10 };
+-+-    const chartWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
+-+-    const chartHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;
+-+-
+-+-    const maxVal = Math.max(...data, 1);
+-+-    const minVal = 0;
+-+-    const range = maxVal - minVal || 1;
+-+-
+-+-    const points = data.map((val, i) => ({
+-+-      x: padding.left + (i / (data.length - 1)) * chartWidth,
+-+-      y: padding.top + chartHeight - ((val - minVal) / range) * chartHeight
+-+-    }));
+-+-
+-+-    const pathD = points.map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${p.x} ${p.y}`).join(' ');
+-+-    const areaD = pathD + ` L ${points[points.length - 1].x} ${height - padding.bottom} L ${padding.left} ${height - padding.bottom} Z`;
+-+-
+-+-    svg.innerHTML = `
+-+-      <defs>
+-+-        <linearGradient id="${svgId}-gradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
+-+-          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0.3"/>
+-+-          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0"/>
+-+-        </linearGradient>
+-+-      </defs>
+-+-      <path d="${areaD}" fill="url(#${svgId}-gradient)"/>
+-+-      <path d="${pathD}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
+-+-      ${points.map((p, i) => `
+-+-        <circle cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="4" fill="${color}">
+-+-          <title>${labels[i]}: ${data[i]}</title>
+-+-        </circle>
+-+-        <text x="${p.x}" y="${height - 8}" text-anchor="middle" class="fill-muted-foreground text-xs">${labels[i]}</text>
+-+-      `).join('')}
+-+-    `;
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Load dashboard stats
+-+-  async function loadStats() {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/stats');
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-
+-+-      if (data.success && data.data) {
+-+-        const toNum = (val: unknown): number => typeof val === 'number' ? val : 0;
+-+-
+-+-        document.getElementById('stat-users')!.textContent = String(toNum(data.data.totalUsers));
+-+-        document.getElementById('stat-businesses')!.textContent = String(toNum(data.data.totalBusinesses));
+-+-        document.getElementById('stat-nonprofits')!.textContent = String(toNum(data.data.totalNonProfits));
+-+-        document.getElementById('stat-products')!.textContent = String(toNum(data.data.totalProducts));
+-+-        
+-+-        if (data.data.mtd) {
+-+-          document.getElementById('mtd-revenue')!.textContent = '$' + String(toNum(data.data.mtd.revenue));
+-+-          document.getElementById('mtd-subs')!.textContent = String(toNum(data.data.mtd.newSubscriptions));
+-+-          document.getElementById('mtd-users')!.textContent = String(toNum(data.data.mtd.newUsers));
+-+-        }
+-+-
+-+-        document.getElementById('stat-expiring')!.textContent = String(toNum(data.data.expiringSoon));
+-+-
+-+-        if (data.data.monthly && Array.isArray(data.data.monthly) && data.data.monthly.length > 0) {
+-+-          renderRevenueChart(data.data.monthly);
+-+-          renderLineChart('subscriptions-svg', data.data.monthly.map((m: MonthlyData) => toNum(m.subscriptions)), data.data.monthly.map((m: MonthlyData) => m.month || ''), '#8b5cf6');
+-+-          renderLineChart('users-svg', data.data.monthly.map((m: MonthlyData) => 0), data.data.monthly.map((m: MonthlyData) => m.month || ''), '#3b82f6');
+-+-        }
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error loading stats:', err);
+-+-      document.getElementById('stat-users')!.textContent = '!';
+-+-      document.getElementById('stat-businesses')!.textContent = '!';
+-+-    }
+-+-  }

+-+-  // Load recent subscriptions
+-+-  async function loadOrders() {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/subscriptions');
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-
+-+-      const container = document.getElementById('orders-list');
+-+-      if (!container) return;
+-+-
+-+-      // API returns data as array directly, not data.subscriptions
+-+-      const subs = data.success && Array.isArray(data.data) ? data.data : [];
+-+-      if (subs.length === 0) {
+-+-        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-6 text-sm">No subscriptions yet</p>';
+-+-        return;
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      container.innerHTML = subs.slice(0, 5).map((sub: Subscription) => `
+-+-        <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 border rounded text-sm">
+-+-          <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-+-            <p class="font-medium truncate">#${sub.id.slice(0, 8)}</p>
+-+-            <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">${sub.servicePackageId || sub.planSlug || 'Subscription'} - $${sub.amount}</p>
+-+-          </div>
+-+-          <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${sub.status === 'paid' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-200' : 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900 dark:text-yellow-200'} ml-2">${sub.status}</span>
+-+-        </div>
+-+-      `).join('');
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error loading subscriptions:', err);
+-+-      const container = document.getElementById('orders-list');
+-+-      if (container) container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-6 text-sm">Failed to load</p>';
+-+-    }
+-+-  }

+-+-<script>
+-+-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+-  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
+-+-    return fetch(url, {
+-+-      ...options,
+-+-      credentials: 'include',
+-+-      headers: {
+-+-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+-        ...options.headers,
+-+-      },
+-+-    });
+-+-  }

+-+-  interface Listing {
+-+-    id: string;
+-+-    title: string;
+-+-    slug: string;
+-+-    status: string;
+-+-    price: string | null;
+-+-    createdAt: number;
+-+-    planExpiresAt: number | null;
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  const statusColors: Record<string, string> = {
+-+-    draft: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-300',
+-+-    published: 'bg-green-100 text-green-700 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400',
+-+-  };
+-+-
+-+-  function formatDate(timestamp: number): string {
+-+-    return new Date(timestamp * 1000).toLocaleDateString();
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function escapeHtml(str: string): string {
+-+-    return str.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  const statusFilter = document.getElementById('filter-status') as HTMLSelectElement;
+-+-  const searchInput = document.getElementById('search') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+-  const tbody = document.getElementById('listings-body') as HTMLTableSectionElement;
+-+-  const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results') as HTMLDivElement;
+-+-
+-+-  let listings: Listing[] = [];
+-+-
+-+-  async function loadListings() {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing');
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-
+-+-      if (data.success) {
+-+-        listings = data.data || [];
+-+-        updateStats();
+-+-        renderListings();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        console.error('API error:', data.error);
+-+-        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center py-8 text-red-500">Failed to load listings</td></tr>';
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Failed to load listings:', err);
+-+-      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center py-8 text-red-500">Failed to load listings</td></tr>';
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function updateStats() {
+-+-    const now = Date.now() / 1000;
+-+-    const total = listings.length;
+-+-    const published = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'published').length;
+-+-    const draft = listings.filter(l => l.status === 'draft').length;
+-+-    const expired = listings.filter(l => l.planExpiresAt && l.planExpiresAt < now).length;
+-+-
+-+-    document.getElementById('stat-total')!.textContent = String(total);
+-+-    document.getElementById('stat-published')!.textContent = String(published);
+-+-    document.getElementById('stat-draft')!.textContent = String(draft);
+-+-    document.getElementById('stat-expired')!.textContent = String(expired);
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function renderListings() {
+-+-    const search = searchInput?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+-    const status = statusFilter?.value || '';
+-+-
+-+-    const filtered = listings.filter(l => {
+-+-      if (search && !l.title.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
+-+-      if (status && l.status !== status) return false;
+-+-      return true;
+-+-    });
+-+-
+-+-    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+-      tbody.innerHTML = '';
+-+-      noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    noResults.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-
+-+-    tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(listing => `
+-+-      <tr class="hover:bg-muted/30">
+-+-        <td class="px-4 py-3">
+-+-          <div class="font-medium">${escapeHtml(listing.title)}</div>
+-+-          <div class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
+-+-            Created ${formatDate(listing.createdAt)}
+-+-          </div>
+-+-        </td>
+-+-        <td class="px-4 py-3">
+-+-          <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${statusColors[listing.status] || statusColors.draft}">
+-+-            ${listing.status || 'draft'}
+-+-          </span>
+-+-        </td>
+-+-        <td class="px-4 py-3">
+-+-          ${listing.price || '-'}
+-+-        </td>
+-+-        <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
+-+-          <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
+-+-            <a
+-+-              href="/admin/listings/${listing.id}/edit"
+-+-              data-action="edit-listing"
+-+-              data-id="${listing.id}"
+-+-              class="edit-listing text-sm text-primary hover:underline"
+-+-            >
+-+-              Edit
+-+-            </a>
+-+-            <button
+-+-              data-action="toggle-status"
+-+-              data-id="${listing.id}"
+-+-              data-status="${listing.status}"
+-+-              class="toggle-status text-sm text-primary hover:underline"
+-+-            >
+-+-              ${listing.status === 'published' ? 'Unpublish' : 'Publish'}
+-+-            </button>
+-+-            <button
+-+-              data-action="delete-listing"
+-+-              data-id="${listing.id}"
+-+-              class="delete-listing text-sm text-red-500 hover:underline"
+-+-            >
+-+-              Delete
+-+-            </button>
+-+-            <a href="/listing/${listing.slug}" target="_blank" class="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
+-+-              View →
+-+-            </a>
+-+-          </div>
+-+-        </td>
+-+-      </tr>
+-+-    `).join('');
+-+-
+-+-    // Event delegation handles all actions via data-action attributes
+-+-  }
+-+-  async function handleToggleStatus(id: string, currentStatus: string) {
+-+-    const newStatus = currentStatus === 'published' ? 'draft' : 'published';
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-+-        method: 'PUT',
+-+-        body: JSON.stringify({ id, status: newStatus }),
+-+-      });
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-      if (data.success) {
+-+-        loadListings();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        alert('Failed to update listing');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error:', err);
+-+-      alert('Failed to update listing');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-  async function handleDeleteListing(id: string) {
+-+-    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this listing?')) return;
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/listing', {
+-+-        method: 'DELETE',
+-+-        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
+-+-      });
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-      if (data.success) {
+-+-        loadListings();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error:', err);
+-+-      alert('Failed to delete listing');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-  // Event delegation - single listener for all listing actions
+-+-  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+-    const btn = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
+-+-    if (!btn) return;
+-+-    const action = btn.dataset.action;
+-+-    const id = btn.dataset.id;
+-+-    const status = btn.dataset.status;
+-+-    switch (action) {
+-+-      case 'edit-listing':
+-+-        window.location.href = `/admin/listings/${id}/edit`;
+-+-        break;
+-+-      case 'toggle-status':
+-+-        handleToggleStatus(id!, status!);
+-+-        break;
+-+-      case 'delete-listing':
+-+-        handleDeleteListing(id!);
+-+-        break;
+-+-    }
+-+-  });
+-+-

+-+-  statusFilter?.addEventListener('change', renderListings);
+-+-  searchInput?.addEventListener('input', renderListings);
+-+-

+-+-  loadListings();

+-+-    const status = select.value;

+-+-        method: 'PUT',
+-+-        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+-+-        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
+-+-      });

+-+-      
+-+-      if (!data.success) {

+-+-      modal?.classList.remove('flex');

+-+-      <input type="number" name="priceValue_${count}" placeholder="0.00" class="w-20 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs" step="0.01" />
+-+-      <select name="priceUnit_${count}" class="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs bg-background">
+-+-        ${units.map(u => `<option value="${u.value}">${escapeHtml(u.label)}</option>`).join('')}
+-+-      </select>
+-+-      <button type="button" data-action="remove-price-field" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 p-1">
+-+-        <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
+-+-          <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
+-+-        </svg>
+-+-      </button>
+-+-    </div>`;
+-+-  }
+-+-  function buildBusinessOptions(selectedId: string = ''): string {
+-+-    return businessOptions.map(b => `<option value="${b.value}" ${b.value === selectedId ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(b.label)}</option>`).join('');
+-+-  }
+-+-  function buildBusinessFilterOptions(): string {
+-+-    return businessOptions.map(b => `<option value="${b.value}">${escapeHtml(b.label)}</option>`).join('');
+-+-  }
+-+-  function buildSpecFieldHtml(field: {key: string; type: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; options?: string[]}, value: string): string {
+-+-    const id = `spec-${field.key}`;
+-+-    const escapedValue = escapeHtml(Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(', ') : value);
+-+-    if (field.type === 'text') {
+-+-      return `<div>
+-+-        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+-        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+-          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-+-          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+-      </div>`;
+-+-    }
+-+-    if (field.type === 'number') {
+-+-      return `<div>
+-+-        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+-        <input type="number" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+-          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : ''}"
+-+-          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+-      </div>`;
+-+-    }
+-+-    if (field.type === 'select') {
+-+-      return `<div>
+-+-        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+-        <select id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm bg-background">
+-+-          <option value="">Select...</option>
+-+-          ${(field.options || []).map(opt => `<option value="${opt}" ${value === opt ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(opt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + opt.slice(1).replace('_', ' '))}</option>`).join('')}
+-+-        </select>
+-+-      </div>`;
+-+-    }
+-+-    if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
+-+-      return `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-+-        <input type="checkbox" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="true" ${value ? 'checked' : ''} class="w-4 h-4" />
+-+-        <label for="${id}" class="text-sm">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+-      </div>`;
+-+-    }
+-+-    if (field.type === 'tags') {
+-+-      return `<div>
+-+-        <label for="${id}" class="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">${escapeHtml(field.label)}</label>
+-+-        <input type="text" id="${id}" name="spec_${field.key}" value="${escapedValue}"
+-+-          placeholder="${field.placeholder ? escapeHtml(field.placeholder) : 'Comma separated values'}"
+-+-          class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md text-sm" />
+-+-        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">Separate with commas</p>
+-+-      </div>`;
+-+-    }
+-+-    return '';
+-+-  }
+-+-  function buildSkuItemHtml(sku: any, priceDisplay: string, businessName: string): string {
+-+-    const typeClass = sku.productType === 'product'
+-+-      ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200'
+-+-      : 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200';
+-+-    const typeLabel = sku.productType || 'product';
+-+-    return `<div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 md:p-3 border rounded text-sm hover:bg-muted/30">
+-+-      <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-+-        <p class="font-medium truncate">${escapeHtml(sku.title)}</p>
+-+-        <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
+-+-          ${escapeHtml(priceDisplay)} - ${escapeHtml(businessName)}
+-+-        </p>
+-+-      </div>
+-+-      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
+-+-        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${typeClass}">${typeLabel}</span>
+-+-        <button data-action="edit-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-primary hover:text-primary/80 text-xs px-2 py-1">Edit</button>
+-+-        <button data-action="delete-sku" data-id="${sku.id}" class="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 text-xs px-2 py-1">Del</button>
+-+-      </div>
+-+-    </div>`;
+-+-  }
+-+-  function buildMediaThumbnailHtml(mediaId: string, mediaUrl: string, isVideo: boolean): string {
+-+-    const mediaHtml = isVideo
+-+-      ? `<video src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" muted /><div class="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"><svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></div>`
+-+-      : `<img src="${mediaUrl}" class="w-full h-full object-cover" />`;
+-+-    return `<div class="relative aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
+-+-      ${mediaHtml}
+-+-      <button type="button" data-action="remove-media" data-media-id="${mediaId}" class="absolute top-1 right-1 w-5 h-5 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full text-xs">×</button>
+-+-    </div>`;
+-+-  }
+-+-  // =============================================================================
+-+-  // EVENT DELEGATION - Single listener for all dynamic content
+-+-  // =============================================================================
+-+-  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+-    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-+-    const actionEl = target.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
+-+-    if (!actionEl) return;
+-+-    const action = actionEl.dataset.action;
+-+-    if (!action) return;
+-+-    switch (action) {
+-+-      case 'remove-price-field': {
+-+-        const row = actionEl.closest('.price-field-row');
+-+-        row?.remove();
+-+-        break;
+-+-      }
+-+-      case 'remove-media': {
+-+-        const mediaId = actionEl.dataset.mediaId;
+-+-        if (mediaId) {
+-+-          skuMediaIds = skuMediaIds.filter(id => id !== mediaId);
+-+-          actionEl.closest('.relative.aspect-square')?.remove();
+-+-          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
+-+-        }
+-+-        break;
+-+-      }
+-+-      case 'edit-sku': {
+-+-        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-+-        if (id) editSKU(id);
+-+-        break;
+-+-      }
+-+-      case 'delete-sku': {
+-+-        const id = actionEl.dataset.id;
+-+-        if (id) deleteSKU(id);
+-+-        break;
+-+-      }
+-+-    }
+-+-  });
+-+-  async function handleSkuImageUpload(files: FileList) {
+-+-    const preview = document.getElementById('sku-image-preview')!;
+-+-    const uploadArea = document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')!;
+-+-
+-+-    for (const file of files) {
+-+-      if (skuMediaIds.length >= 4) break;
+-+-
+-+-      const isImage = IMAGE_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-+-      const isVideo = VIDEO_TYPES.includes(file.type);
+-+-
+-+-      if (!isImage && !isVideo) continue;
+-+-
+-+-      if (isImage && file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE) {
+-+-        alert(`Image too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 2MB`);
+-+-        continue;
+-+-      }
+-+-      if (isVideo && file.size > MAX_VIDEO_SIZE) {
+-+-        alert(`Video too large: ${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB. Max: 8MB`);
+-+-        continue;
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      let fileToUpload = file;
+-+-
+-+-      // Compress video
+-+-      if (isVideo) {
+-+-        const statusDiv = document.createElement('div');
+-+-        statusDiv.className = 'absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs rounded-lg z-10';
+-+-        statusDiv.textContent = 'Processing...';
+-+-        uploadArea.style.position = 'relative';
+-+-        uploadArea.appendChild(statusDiv);
+-+-
+-+-        try {
+-+-          const { compressVideo } = await import('@/lib/video-compress');
+-+-          const result = await compressVideo(file, {
+-+-            maxSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
+-+-            onProgress: (p) => { statusDiv.textContent = p.message; }
+-+-          });
+-+-
+-+-          if (!result.withinLimit) {
+-+-            alert('Video still too large after compression');
+-+-            statusDiv.remove();
+-+-            continue;
+-+-          }
+-+-          fileToUpload = result.file;
+-+-          statusDiv.textContent = 'Uploading...';
+-+-        } catch (err) {
+-+-          console.error('Video compression error:', err);
+-+-          statusDiv.remove();
+-+-          alert('Video processing failed');
+-+-          continue;
+-+-        }
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      try {
+-+-        const result = await actions.media.uploadMedia({ file: fileToUpload, category: 'sku' });
+-+-        const data = { success: result.success, data: result.data };
+-+-        if (data.success && data.data?.id) {
+-+-          skuMediaIds.push(data.data.id);
+-+-          const html = buildMediaThumbnailHtml(data.data.id, data.data.url, isVideo);
+-+-          preview.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
+-+-          preview.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-          document.getElementById('sku-media-ids')!.value = skuMediaIds.join(',');
+-+-        }
+-+-      } catch (err) {
+-+-        console.error('Upload error:', err);
+-+-      }
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Setup upload handlers
+-+-  document.getElementById('sku-image-upload')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-+-    document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.click();
+-+-  });
+-+-  document.getElementById('sku-image-file')?.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
+-+-    const files = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).files;
+-+-    if (files) handleSkuImageUpload(files);
+-+-    (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+-  });
+-+-  async function initEditor(initialContent = '') {
+-+-    // Load editor modules first
+-+-    const loaded = await loadEditor();
+-+-    if (!loaded || !Editor) return null;
+-+-
+-+-    const element = document.querySelector('#tiptap-editor');
+-+-    if (!element) return null;
+-+-
+-+-    // Destroy existing editor
+-+-    if (editor) {
+-+-      editor.destroy();
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    editor = new Editor({
+-+-      element,
+-+-      extensions: [
+-+-        StarterKit,
+-+-        Underline,
+-+-        PlaceholderExt.configure({
+-+-          placeholder: element.dataset.placeholder || 'Start writing...',
+-+-        }),
+-+-      ],
+-+-      content: initialContent,
+-+-      immediatelyRender: false,
+-+-      onUpdate: ({ editor }) => {
+-+-        // Sync to hidden input
+-+-        const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+-        if (hiddenInput) {
+-+-          hiddenInput.value = editor.getHTML();
+-+-        }
+-+-      },
+-+-    });
+-+-
+-+-    // Initial sync
+-+-    const hiddenInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+-    if (hiddenInput) {
+-+-      hiddenInput.value = initialContent;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    return editor;
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Toolbar button handler
+-+-  function setupToolbar() {
+-+-    document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach(btn => {
+-+-      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-+-        if (!editor) return;
+-+-        const command = btn.dataset.command;
+-+-        const level = btn.dataset.level;
+-+-
+-+-        if (command === 'toggleHeading' && level) {
+-+-          editor.chain().focus().toggleHeading({ level: parseInt(level) }).run();
+-+-        } else if (command === 'undo') {
+-+-          editor.chain().focus().undo().run();
+-+-        } else if (command === 'redo') {
+-+-          editor.chain().focus().redo().run();
+-+-        } else if (command) {
+-+-          const cmd = editor.chain().focus()[command];
+-+-          if (typeof cmd.run === 'function') {
+-+-            cmd.run();
+-+-          }
+-+-        }
+-+-      });
+-+-    });
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Update toolbar button active states
+-+-  function updateToolbarState() {
+-+-    if (!editor) return;
+-+-    document.querySelectorAll('[data-command]').forEach(btn => {
+-+-      const command = btn.dataset.command;
+-+-      const level = btn.dataset.level;
+-+-      let isActive = false;
+-+-
+-+-      if (command === 'toggleHeading' && level) {
+-+-        isActive = editor.isActive('heading', { level: parseInt(level) });
+-+-      } else if (['toggleBold', 'toggleItalic', 'toggleUnderline', 'toggleBulletList', 'toggleOrderedList', 'toggleBlockquote'].includes(command)) {
+-+-        isActive = editor.isActive(command.replace('toggle', '').toLowerCase());
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      btn.classList.toggle('active', isActive);
+-+-    });
+-+-  }

+-+-  // Render price fields based on service type

+-+-  // Render specification fields based on service type
+-+-  function renderSpecificationFields(productType = 'product', existingSpecs: Record<string, any> = {}) {
+-+-    const container = document.getElementById('specifications-container');
+-+-    const fieldsContainer = document.getElementById('specifications-fields');
+-+-    if (!container || !fieldsContainer) return;
+-+-    const fields = productConfig.getSpecificationFields(productType) || [];
+-+-    if (fields.length === 0) {
+-+-      container.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-    container.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-    fieldsContainer.innerHTML = fields.map(field => buildSpecFieldHtml(field, existingSpecs[field.key] || '')).join('');
+-+-  }
+-+-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+-  async function authFetch(url, options = {}) {
+-+-    return fetch(url, {
+-+-      ...options,
+-+-      credentials: 'include',
+-+-      headers: {
+-+-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+-        ...options.headers,
+-+-      },
+-+-    });
+-+-  }

+-+-  // Global SKUs storage
+-+-  (window as SkuData).allSkus = [];
+-+-
+-+-  // Load SKUs
+-+-  async function loadSKUs() {
+-+-    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
+-+-    const countEl = document.getElementById('skus-count');
+-+-    const businessFilter = document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement;
+-+-    if (!container) return;
+-+-
+-+-    // Populate business filter options
+-+-    if (businessFilter) {
+-+-      businessFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Businesses</option>' + buildBusinessFilterOptions();
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/skus');
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-
+-+-      if (!data.success) {
+-+-        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Failed to load SKUs</p>';
+-+-        return;
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      (window as SkuData).allSkus = data.data || [];
+-+-      renderSkus();
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error loading SKUs:', err);
+-+-      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-4 text-sm">Error loading SKUs</p>';
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Render SKUs with filters
+-+-  function renderSkus() {
+-+-    const container = document.getElementById('skus-list');
+-+-    const countEl = document.getElementById('skus-count');
+-+-    if (!container || !(window as SkuData).allSkus) return;
+-+-
+-+-    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+-    const businessFilter = (document.getElementById('business-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+-    const typeFilter = (document.getElementById('type-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+-
+-+-    const bizMap = new Map(businessOptions.map(b => [b.value, b.label]));
+-+-
+-+-    const filtered = (window as SkuData).allSkus.filter((sku: SkuData) => {
+-+-      const matchesSearch = !search || sku.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search);
+-+-      const matchesBusiness = !businessFilter || sku.businessId === businessFilter;
+-+-      const matchesType = !typeFilter || sku.productType === typeFilter;
+-+-      return matchesSearch && matchesBusiness && matchesType;
+-+-    });
+-+-
+-+-    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} of ${(window as SkuData).allSkus.length} SKUs`;
+-+-
+-+-    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+-      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No SKUs found</p>';
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    container.innerHTML = filtered.map((sku: SkuData) => {
+-+-      let priceDisplay = 'Ask for price';
+-+-      try {
+-+-        const fields = sku.priceFields ? JSON.parse(sku.priceFields) : [];
+-+-        if (fields.length > 0 && fields[0].value) {
+-+-          const unit = fields[0].unit ? ` / ${fields[0].unit.replace('/', '')}` : '';
+-+-          priceDisplay = `$${fields[0].value}${unit}`;
+-+-        }
+-+-      } catch (e) {
+-+-        // ignore
+-+-      }
+-+-      return buildSkuItemHtml(sku, priceDisplay, bizMap.get(sku.businessId) || 'Unknown');
+-+-    }).join('');
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Edit SKU
+-+-  async function editSKU(id) {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`);
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-
+-+-      if (!data.id) {
+-+-        alert('SKU not found');
+-+-        return;
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      editingId = id;
+-+-      document.getElementById('modal-title').textContent = 'Edit SKU';
+-+-      document.getElementById('sku-id').value = id;
+-+-      document.getElementById('sku-title').value = data.title || '';
+-+-      document.getElementById('sku-business').value = data.businessId || '';
+-+-      document.getElementById('sku-service-type').value = data.productType || 'product';
+-+-
+-+-      // Parse price fields
+-+-      let priceFields = [];
+-+-      try {
+-+-        priceFields = data.priceFields ? JSON.parse(data.priceFields) : [];
+-+-      } catch (e) {
+-+-        // ignore
+-+-      }
+-+-      renderPriceFields(data.productType || 'product', priceFields);
+-+-
+-+-      // Parse and render specification fields
+-+-      let specifications = {};
+-+-      try {
+-+-        specifications = data.specifications ? JSON.parse(data.specifications) : {};
+-+-      } catch (e) {
+-+-        // ignore
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      // Initialize editor with existing content
+-+-      initEditor(data.description || '');
+-+-
+-+-      openModal();
+-+-      setupToolbar();
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error loading SKU:', err);
+-+-      alert('Failed to load SKU');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Delete SKU
+-+-  async function deleteSKU(id) {
+-+-    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this SKU?')) return;
+-+-
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+-+-      if (res.ok) {
+-+-        loadSKUs();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        alert('Failed to delete SKU');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      alert('Failed to delete SKU');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }

+-+-  // Form submission
+-+-  document.getElementById('sku-form')?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+-+-    e.preventDefault();
+-+-    const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+-+-
+-+-    // Collect price fields
+-+-    const fieldCount = parseInt(document.getElementById('price-fields-container').dataset.fieldCount || '1');
+-+-    const priceFields = [];
+-+-    for (let i = 0; i < fieldCount; i++) {
+-+-      const label = formData.get(`priceLabel_${i}`);
+-+-      const value = formData.get(`priceValue_${i}`);
+-+-      const unit = formData.get(`priceUnit_${i}`);
+-+-      if (label || value) {
+-+-        priceFields.push({ label, value: value || '', unit: unit || '' });
+-+-      }
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    // Collect specification fields
+-+-    const productType = formData.get('productType');
+-+-    const specFields = productConfig.getSpecificationFields(productType) || [];
+-+-    const specifications = {};
+-+-    specFields.forEach(field => {
+-+-      const key = `spec_${field.key}`;
+-+-      if (field.type === 'checkbox') {
+-+-        specifications[field.key] = formData.get(key) === 'true';
+-+-      } else if (field.type === 'tags') {
+-+-        const val = formData.get(key);
+-+-        specifications[field.key] = val ? val.split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(v => v) : [];
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        const val = formData.get(key);
+-+-        if (val) specifications[field.key] = field.type === 'number' ? Number(val) : val;
+-+-      }
+-+-    });
+-+-
+-+-    // Get description from hidden input (synced from TipTap)
+-+-    const descriptionInput = document.getElementById('sku-description');
+-+-    const description = descriptionInput?.value || '';
+-+-
+-+-    const skuData = {
+-+-      title: formData.get('title'),
+-+-      businessId: formData.get('businessId'),
+-+-      productType,
+-+-      priceFields: priceFields.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(priceFields) : null,
+-+-      specifications: Object.keys(specifications).length > 0 ? specifications : null,
+-+-      description,
+-+-      isAdmin: true,
+-+-    };
+-+-
+-+-    if (!skuData.businessId) {
+-+-      alert('Please select a business');
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    if (!skuData.title) {
+-+-      alert('Please enter a title');
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const url = editingId ? `/api/products/${editingId}` : '/api/products';
+-+-      const method = editingId ? 'PUT' : 'POST';
+-+-
+-+-      const res = await fetch(url, {
+-+-        method,
+-+-        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+-+-        body: JSON.stringify(skuData),
+-+-      });
+-+-
+-+-      if (res.ok) {
+-+-        closeModal();
+-+-        loadSKUs();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        const error = await res.json();
+-+-        alert('Failed to save SKU: ' + (error.message || 'Unknown error'));
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      alert('Failed to save SKU');
+-+-    }
+-+-  });
+-+-

+-+-  populateBusinesses();
+-+-  renderPriceFields('product');
+-+-  renderSpecificationFields('product');
+-+-  loadSKUs();
+-+-  // Initialize editor for create mode (will be reset on modal open)

+-+-<script>
+-+-  interface PublicSectorData {
+-+-    id: string;
+-+-    title: string;
+-+-    slug: string;
+-+-    email?: string;
+-+-    contactNumber?: string;
+-+-    aboutUs?: string;
+-+-    latestUpdates?: string;
+-+-    status: string;
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+-  async function authFetch(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
+-+-    return fetch(url, {
+-+-      ...options,
+-+-      credentials: 'include',
+-+-      headers: {
+-+-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+-        ...options.headers,
+-+-      },
+-+-    });
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  let businessList: PublicSectorData[] = [];
+-+-  let aboutContent = '';
+-+-  let updatesContent = '';
+-+-  let editingId: string | null = null;
+-+-
+-+-  // Load public-sectors
+-+-  async function loadPublicSectorores() {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/public-sectors');
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-
+-+-      const container = document.getElementById('list');
+-+-      const countEl = document.getElementById('count');
+-+-      if (!container) return;
+-+-
+-+-      if (!data.success || data.data.length === 0) {
+-+-        container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No public-sectors yet</p>';
+-+-        if (countEl) countEl.textContent = '0 public-sectors';
+-+-        return;
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      businessList = data.data;
+-+-      renderPublicSectorores();
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error loading public-sectors:', err);
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Render public-sectors with filters
+-+-  function renderPublicSectorores() {
+-+-    const container = document.getElementById('list');
+-+-    const countEl = document.getElementById('count');
+-+-    if (!container) return;
+-+-
+-+-    const search = (document.getElementById('search-input') as HTMLInputElement)?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+-+-    const status = (document.getElementById('status-filter') as HTMLSelectElement)?.value || '';
+-+-
+-+-    const filtered = businessList.filter(biz => {
+-+-      const matchesSearch = !search ||
+-+-        biz.title?.toLowerCase().includes(search) ||
+-+-        biz.slug?.toLowerCase().includes(search);
+-+-      const matchesStatus = !status || biz.status === status;
+-+-      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
+-+-    });
+-+-
+-+-    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${filtered.length} of ${businessList.length} public-sectors`;
+-+-
+-+-    if (filtered.length === 0) {
+-+-      container.innerHTML = '<p class="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">No public-sectors found</p>';
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    container.innerHTML = filtered.map((biz) => `
+-+-      <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-2 md:p-3 border rounded text-sm hover:bg-muted/30">
+-+-        <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
+-+-          <p class="font-medium truncate">${escapeHtml(biz.title)}</p>
+-+-          <p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">/${escapeHtml(biz.slug)}</p>
+-+-        </div>
+-+-        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-2">
+-+-          <button class="text-xs px-2 py-1 border rounded hover:bg-muted" data-action="edit" data-id="${biz.id}">Edit</button>
+-+-          <span class="px-2 py-0.5 text-xs rounded-full ${biz.status === 'live' || biz.status === 'paid' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900 dark:text-green-200' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-gray-200'}">${capitalizeFirst(biz.status)}</span>
+-+-          <select class="text-xs border rounded px-1 py-0.5 bg-background" data-action="status-update" data-id="${biz.id}">
+-+-            <option value="draft" ${biz.status === 'draft' ? 'selected' : ''}>Draft</option>
+-+-            <option value="live" ${biz.status === 'live' ? 'selected' : ''}>Live</option>
+-+-            <option value="paid" ${biz.status === 'paid' ? 'selected' : ''}>Paid</option>
+-+-            <option value="expired" ${biz.status === 'expired' ? 'selected' : ''}>Expired</option>
+-+-          </select>
+-+-        </div>
+-+-      </div>
+-+-    `).join('');
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function escapeHtml(str: string): string {
+-+-    return str.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function capitalizeFirst(str: string | null | undefined): string {
+-+-    if (!str) return '-';
+-+-    return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Render editors with textarea elements
+-+-  function renderEditors(initialAbout = '', initialUpdates = '') {
+-+-    aboutContent = initialAbout;
+-+-    updatesContent = initialUpdates;
+-+-
+-+-    const aboutContainer = document.getElementById('about-editor-container')!;
+-+-    const updatesContainer = document.getElementById('updates-editor-container')!;
+-+-
+-+-    aboutContainer.innerHTML = '';
+-+-    updatesContainer.innerHTML = '';
+-+-
+-+-    const aboutTextarea = document.createElement('textarea');
+-+-    aboutTextarea.name = 'aboutUs';
+-+-    aboutTextarea.rows = 4;
+-+-    aboutTextarea.className = 'flex min-h-[80px] w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2.5 text-base ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 resize-y';
+-+-    aboutTextarea.placeholder = 'Write about your public sector...';
+-+-    aboutTextarea.textContent = initialAbout;
+-+-    aboutContainer.appendChild(aboutTextarea);
+-+-
+-+-    const updatesTextarea = document.createElement('textarea');
+-+-    updatesTextarea.name = 'latestUpdates';
+-+-    updatesTextarea.rows = 4;
+-+-    updatesTextarea.className = 'flex min-h-[80px] w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2.5 text-base ring-offset-background placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 resize-y';
+-+-    updatesTextarea.placeholder = 'Latest news and updates...';
+-+-    updatesTextarea.textContent = initialUpdates;
+-+-    updatesContainer.appendChild(updatesTextarea);
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Modal reference
+-+-  const modal = document.getElementById('business-modal');
+-+-
+-+-  // Auto-generate slug from title
+-+-  document.getElementById('biz-title')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+-+-    const title = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value;
+-+-    const slugInput = document.getElementById('biz-slug') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+-    if (slugInput && !slugInput.dataset.userModified) {
+-+-      slugInput.value = title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
+-+-    }
+-+-  });
+-+-
+-+-  document.getElementById('biz-slug')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
+-+-    (e.target as HTMLInputElement).dataset.userModified = 'true';
+-+-  });
+-+-
+-+-  // Form submission
+-+-  document.getElementById('business-form')?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+-+-    e.preventDefault();
+-+-    const formData = new FormData(e.target as HTMLFormElement);
+-+-
+-+-    const aboutTextarea = document.querySelector('#about-editor-container textarea') as HTMLTextAreaElement;
+-+-    const updatesTextarea = document.querySelector('#updates-editor-container textarea') as HTMLTextAreaElement;
+-+-    
+-+-    const businessData = {
+-+-      title: String(formData.get('title') || ''),
+-+-      slug: String(formData.get('slug') || ''),
+-+-      email: String(formData.get('email') || ''),
+-+-      contactNumber: String(formData.get('phone') || ''),
+-+-      aboutUs: aboutTextarea?.value || aboutContent,
+-+-      status: 'draft',
+-+-    };
+-+-
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const isEdit = editingId !== null;
+-+-      const res = await authFetch('/api/admin/public-sectors' + (isEdit ? '/' + editingId : ''), {
+-+-        method: isEdit ? 'PUT' : 'POST',
+-+-        body: JSON.stringify(businessData),
+-+-      });
+-+-
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-
+-+-      if (data.success) {
+-+-        alert(isEdit ? 'Public Sector updated successfully!' : 'Public Sector created successfully!');
+-+-        modal?.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-        modal?.classList.remove('flex');
+-+-        (e.target as HTMLFormElement).reset();
+-+-        editingId = null;
+-+-        loadPublicSectorores();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        alert(data.error?.message || 'Failed to save public sector');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error saving public sector:', err);
+-+-      alert('Error saving public sector');
+-+-    }
+-+-  });
+-+-
+-+-  // Status update handler via document delegation
+-+-  document.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
+-+-    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-+-    if (!target.closest('[data-action="status-update"]')) return;
+-+-    
+-+-    const select = target.closest('select') as HTMLSelectElement;
+-+-    if (!select) return;
+-+-    
+-+-    const id = select.dataset.id;
+-+-    const status = select.value;
+-+-    if (!id) return;
+-+-
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/public-sectors/${id}/status`, {
+-+-        method: 'PUT',
+-+-        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+-+-        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
+-+-      });
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-      
+-+-      if (!data.success) {
+-+-        alert('Failed to update status');
+-+-        loadPublicSectorores();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        alert('Status updated');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (err) {
+-+-      console.error('Error updating status:', err);
+-+-      alert('Error updating status');
+-+-    }
+-+-  });
+-+-
+-+-  // Document-level click handler for all actions
+-+-  document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
+-+-    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-+-    
+-+-    // Handle edit buttons
+-+-    const editBtn = target.closest('[data-action="edit"]');
+-+-    if (editBtn) {
+-+-      const id = (editBtn as HTMLElement).dataset.id;
+-+-      if (!id) return;
+-+-
+-+-      const entity = businessList.find(b => b.id === id);
+-+-      if (!entity) return;
+-+-
+-+-      (document.getElementById('biz-title') as HTMLInputElement).value = entity.title || '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('biz-slug') as HTMLInputElement).value = entity.slug || '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('biz-email') as HTMLInputElement).value = entity.email || '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('biz-phone') as HTMLInputElement).value = entity.contactNumber || '';
+-+-
+-+-      const modalTitle = document.getElementById('modal-title');
+-+-      if (modalTitle) modalTitle.textContent = 'Edit Public Sector';
+-+-      editingId = id;
+-+-      aboutContent = entity.aboutUs || '';
+-+-      updatesContent = entity.latestUpdates || '';
+-+-      renderEditors(aboutContent, updatesContent);
+-+-
+-+-      modal?.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-      modal?.classList.add('flex');
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    // Handle modal controls
+-+-    if (target.closest('[data-action="modal-add"]')) {
+-+-      aboutContent = '';
+-+-      updatesContent = '';
+-+-      modal?.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-      modal?.classList.add('flex');
+-+-      renderEditors('', '');
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    if (target.closest('[data-action="modal-close"]') || target.closest('[data-action="modal-cancel"]')) {
+-+-      modal?.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-      modal?.classList.remove('flex');
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    // Close modal on backdrop click
+-+-    if (target === modal) {
+-+-      modal.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-      modal.classList.remove('flex');
+-+-    }
+-+-  });
+-+-
+-+-  // Event listeners for search and filter
+-+-  document.getElementById('search-input')?.addEventListener('input', renderPublicSectorores);
+-+-  document.getElementById('status-filter')?.addEventListener('change', renderPublicSectorores);

+-+-  // Initialize
+-+-  loadPublicSectorores();
