+-+-<script>
+-+-  import { actions } from 'astro:actions';
+-+-
+-+-  interface Plan {
+-+-    id: string;
+-+-    name: string;
+-+-    period: string;
+-+-    amount: number;
+-+-    skuLimit: number;
+-+-    maxImages: number;
+-+-    maxVideos: number;
+-+-    maxBusinessImages: number;
+-+-    maxBusinessVideos: number;
+-+-    features: string[];
+-+-    description: string;
+-+-    active: boolean;
+-+-    sortOrder: number;
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  interface PlanData {
+-+-    editPlan?: (planId: string) => void;
+-+-    createPlan?: () => void;
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Auth fetch helper
+-+-  async function authFetch(url, options = {}) {
+-+-    return fetch(url, {
+-+-      ...options,
+-+-      credentials: 'include',
+-+-      headers: {
+-+-        ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
+-+-        ...options.headers,
+-+-      },
+-+-    });
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  let plans: Plan[] = [];
+-+-  let currentUserRole: string = '';
+-+-
+-+-  // Check auth and role
+-+-  async function checkAuth() {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/session', { credentials: 'include' });
+-+-      const data = await res.json();
+-+-      if (data.user) {
+-+-        currentUserRole = data.user.role || '';
+-+-        // Show/hide Add Plan button based on role
+-+-        const addBtn = document.getElementById('add-plan-btn');
+-+-        if (addBtn) {
+-+-          addBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', currentUserRole !== 'super_admin');
+-+-        }
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (e) {
+-+-      console.error('Auth check failed:', e);
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  async function loadPlans() {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.getAll();
+-+-
+-+-      if (result.success && result.data) {
+-+-        plans = result.data;
+-+-        renderPlans();
+-+-        updateStats();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        showError(result.error?.message || 'Failed to load plans');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (e) {
+-+-      console.error('Failed to load plans:', e);
+-+-      showError('Failed to load plans');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function renderPlans() {
+-+-    const tbody = document.getElementById('plans-list');
+-+-    if (!tbody) return;
+-+-
+-+-    if (plans.length === 0) {
+-+-      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center p-8 text-muted-foreground">No packages found</td></tr>';
+-+-      return;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    const canEdit = currentUserRole === 'super_admin';
+-+-
+-+-    tbody.innerHTML = plans.map(pkg => {
+-+-      const firstVariant = pkg.variants?.[0] || {};
+-+-      const durationUnit = firstVariant.durationUnit || 'month';
+-+-      const price = firstVariant.price || 0;
+-+-      const skuLimit = firstVariant.limits?.skuLimit ?? '-';
+-+-      const maxImages = firstVariant.limits?.maxImages ?? '-';
+-+-      const maxVideos = firstVariant.limits?.maxVideos ?? '-';
+-+-      const variantCount = pkg.variants?.length || 0;
+-+-
+-+-      return `
+-+-      <tr class="border-t hover:bg-muted/50">
+-+-        <td class="p-3">
+-+-          <div class="font-medium">${escapeHtml(pkg.name)}</div>
+-+-          <div class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">${escapeHtml(pkg.slug)}</div>
+-+-        </td>
+-+-        <td class="p-3 hidden md:table-cell">
+-+-          <Badge variant="purple" size="sm">
+-+-            ${pkg.serviceType}
+-+-          </Badge>
+-+-        </td>
+-+-        <td class="p-3 font-semibold">$${price}</td>
+-+-        <td class="p-3 hidden lg:table-cell">${skuLimit}</td>
+-+-        <td class="p-3 hidden lg:table-cell">${maxImages}</td>
+-+-        <td class="p-3 hidden lg:table-cell">${variantCount} variant${variantCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</td>
+-+-        <td class="p-3 text-center">
+-+-          <Badge variant={pkg.isActive ? 'success' : 'secondary'} size="sm">
+-+-            {pkg.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}
+-+-          </Badge>
+-+-        </td>
+-+-        <td class="p-3 text-right">
+-+-          ${canEdit ? `<button data-action="edit-plan" data-plan-id="${pkg.id}" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-sm font-medium transition-colors rounded-md px-2 py-1">Edit</button>` : '<span class="text-xs text-muted-foreground">View only</span>'}
+-+-        </td>
+-+-    `}).join('');
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function updateStats() {
+-+-    const total = plans.length;
+-+-    const subscriptions = plans.filter(p => p.serviceType === 'subscription').length;
+-+-    const listings = plans.filter(p => p.serviceType === 'listing_renewal').length;
+-+-    const active = plans.filter(p => p.isActive).length;
+-+-
+-+-    const statTotal = document.getElementById('stat-total');
+-+-    const statMonthly = document.getElementById('stat-monthly');
+-+-    const statYearly = document.getElementById('stat-yearly');
+-+-    const statActive = document.getElementById('stat-active');
+-+-
+-+-    if (statTotal) statTotal.textContent = String(total);
+-+-    if (statMonthly) statMonthly.textContent = String(subscriptions);
+-+-    if (statYearly) statYearly.textContent = String(listings);
+-+-    if (statActive) statActive.textContent = String(active);
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  (window as PlanData).editPlan = function(planId: string) {
+-+-    const pkg = plans.find(p => p.id === planId);
+-+-    if (!pkg) return;
+-+-
+-+-    const firstVariant = pkg.variants?.[0] || {};
+-+-
+-+-    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+-    const title = document.getElementById('modal-title');
+-+-    const modeInput = document.getElementById('plan-mode') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+-    const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('delete-plan-btn');
+-+-
+-+-    if (modeInput) modeInput.value = 'edit';
+-+-    if (title) title.textContent = `Edit ${pkg.name}`;
+-+-    if (deleteBtn) {
+-+-      deleteBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-      deleteBtn.onclick = () => showDeleteConfirm(planId);
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    const form = document.getElementById('plan-form') as HTMLFormElement;
+-+-    if (form) {
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = pkg.id;
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-name') as HTMLInputElement).value = pkg.name;
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-amount') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.price || 0);
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-skuLimit') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.skuLimit || 0);
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxImages || 0);
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxVideos || 0);
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxBusinessImages || 0);
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(firstVariant.limits?.maxBusinessVideos || 0);
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-sortOrder') as HTMLInputElement).value = String(pkg.sortOrder || 0);
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-description') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = pkg.description || '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-features') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = (firstVariant.features || []).join('\n');
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-active') as HTMLInputElement).checked = Boolean(pkg.isActive);
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    if (modal) {
+-+-      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+-    }
+-+-  };
+-+-
+-+-  (window as PlanData).createPlan = function() {
+-+-    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+-    const title = document.getElementById('modal-title');
+-+-    const modeInput = document.getElementById('plan-mode') as HTMLInputElement;
+-+-    const periodField = document.getElementById('period-field');
+-+-    const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('delete-plan-btn');
+-+-    const form = document.getElementById('plan-form') as HTMLFormElement;
+-+-
+-+-    if (modeInput) modeInput.value = 'create';
+-+-    if (title) title.textContent = 'Create Plan';
+-+-    if (periodField) periodField.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-    if (deleteBtn) deleteBtn.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-
+-+-    if (form) {
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-id') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-name') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-period') as HTMLSelectElement).value = 'monthly';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-amount') as HTMLInputElement).value = '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-skuLimit') as HTMLInputElement).value = '10';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = '5';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = '1';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessImages') as HTMLInputElement).value = '16';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-maxBusinessVideos') as HTMLInputElement).value = '2';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-sortOrder') as HTMLInputElement).value = '0';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-description') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-features') as HTMLTextAreaElement).value = '';
+-+-      (document.getElementById('plan-active') as HTMLInputElement).checked = true;
+-+-    }
+-+-
+-+-    if (modal) {
+-+-      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+-    }
+-+-  };
+-+-
+-+-  let deleteTargetId: string | null = null;
+-+-
+-+-  function showDeleteConfirm(planId: string) {
+-+-    deleteTargetId = planId;
+-+-    const modal = document.getElementById('delete-modal');
+-+-    if (modal) {
+-+-      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
+-+-      modal.classList.add('flex');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function hideDeleteConfirm() {
+-+-    deleteTargetId = null;
+-+-    const modal = document.getElementById('delete-modal');
+-+-    if (modal) {
+-+-      modal.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-      modal.classList.remove('flex');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  async function deletePlan(planId: string) {
+-+-    try {
+-+-      const result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.delete({ id: planId });
+-+-      if (result.success) {
+-+-        hideDeleteConfirm();
+-+-        closeModal();
+-+-        loadPlans();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        showError(result.error?.message || 'Failed to delete plan');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (e) {
+-+-      console.error('Failed to delete plan:', e);
+-+-      showError('Failed to delete plan');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function closeModal() {
+-+-    const modal = document.getElementById('plan-modal');
+-+-    if (modal) {
+-+-      modal.classList.add('hidden');
+-+-      modal.classList.remove('flex');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  async function savePlan(formData: FormData) {
+-+-    const mode = formData.get('mode') as string;
+-+-    const id = formData.get('id') as string;
+-+-    const featuresText = formData.get('features') as string;
+-+-    const features = featuresText.split('\n').filter(f => f.trim());
+-+-
+-+-    // Build variant from form data
+-+-    const variant = {
+-+-      name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+-      price: parseFloat(formData.get('amount') as string) || 0,
+-+-      currency: 'USD',
+-+-      durationValue: 1,
+-+-      durationUnit: 'month',
+-+-      limits: {
+-+-        skuLimit: parseInt(formData.get('skuLimit') as string) || 0,
+-+-        maxImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxImages') as string) || 0,
+-+-        maxVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+-        maxBusinessImages: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessImages') as string) || 0,
+-+-        maxBusinessVideos: parseInt(formData.get('maxBusinessVideos') as string) || 0,
+-+-      },
+-+-      features: features,
+-+-    };
+-+-
+-+-    try {
+-+-      let result;
+-+-      if (mode === 'edit' && id) {
+-+-        // For edit, we need to get the existing package to preserve all variants
+-+-        const existingPkg = plans.find(p => p.id === id);
+-+-        const variants = existingPkg?.variants || [variant];
+-+-        // Update first variant with new values
+-+-        variants[0] = variant;
+-+-
+-+-        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.update({
+-+-          id,
+-+-          name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+-          description: formData.get('description') as string,
+-+-          variants: variants,
+-+-          isActive: formData.get('active') === 'on',
+-+-          sortOrder: parseInt(formData.get('sortOrder') as string) || 0,
+-+-        });
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        // Create new package
+-+-        const serviceType = (formData.get('serviceType') as string) || 'subscription';
+-+-        const serviceRelationTo = (formData.get('serviceRelationTo') as string) || null;
+-+-        result = await actions.admin.servicePackagesAdmin.create({
+-+-          name: formData.get('name') as string,
+-+-          serviceType: serviceType as 'subscription' | 'listing_renewal' | 'ad_banner',
+-+-          serviceRelationTo: serviceRelationTo as 'business' | 'listing' | 'business_product' | 'homepage' | null,
+-+-          description: formData.get('description') as string || '',
+-+-          variants: [variant],
+-+-          isActive: formData.get('active') === 'on',
+-+-          sortOrder: parseInt(formData.get('sortOrder') as string) || 0,
+-+-        });
+-+-      }
+-+-
+-+-      if (result.success) {
+-+-        closeModal();
+-+-        loadPlans();
+-+-      } else {
+-+-        showError(result.error?.message || 'Failed to save plan');
+-+-      }
+-+-    } catch (e) {
+-+-      console.error('Failed to save plan:', e);
+-+-      showError('Failed to save plan');
+-+-    }
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function showError(message: string) {
+-+-    alert(message);
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  function escapeHtml(text: string): string {
+-+-    const div = document.createElement('div');
+-+-    div.textContent = text;
+-+-    return div.innerHTML;
+-+-  }
+-+-
+-+-  // Event listeners
+-+-  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
+-+-    await checkAuth();
+-+-    loadPlans();
+-+-
+-+-    document.getElementById('close-modal')?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
+-+-    document.getElementById('cancel-btn')?.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
+-+-    document.getElementById('add-plan-btn')?.addEventListener('click', () => (window as PlanData).createPlan?.());
+-+-
+-+-    document.getElementById('plan-modal')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+-      if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeModal();
+-+-    });
+-+-
+-+-    document.getElementById('plan-form')?.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+-+-      e.preventDefault();
+-+-      const form = e.target as HTMLFormElement;
+-+-      const formData = new FormData(form);
+-+-      await savePlan(formData);
+-+-    });
+-+-
+-+-    // Delete modal handlers
+-+-    // Delete modal handlers
+-+-    document.getElementById('cancel-delete')?.addEventListener('click', hideDeleteConfirm);
+-+-    document.getElementById('confirm-delete')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+-+-      if (deleteTargetId) deletePlan(deleteTargetId);
+-+-    });
+-+-    document.getElementById('delete-modal')?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+-      if (e.target === e.currentTarget) hideDeleteConfirm();
+-+-    });
+-+-    // Event delegation for dynamically rendered buttons
+-+-    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+-+-      const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
+-+-      const button = target.closest('[data-action]') as HTMLElement | null;
+-+-      if (!button) return;
+-+-      const action = button.getAttribute('data-action');
+-+-      if (action === 'edit-plan') {
+-+-        const planId = button.getAttribute('data-plan-id');
+-+-        if (planId) (window as PlanData).editPlan?.(planId);
+-+-      }
+-+-    });
+-+-  });
+-+-</script>

+-+// Astro Server Actions for Admin Non-Profits Management
+-+import { defineAction } from 'astro:actions';
+-+import { z } from 'zod';
+-+import { getDb } from '@/lib/db';
+-+import { nonProfits } from '@/db/schema';
+-+import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
+-+import { getAdminUser } from '@/lib/admin-auth';
+-+import { createErrorResponse, ErrorCode } from '@/lib/errors';
+-+
+-+export const adminNonProfits = {
+-+  // Create a new non-profit (draft status)
+-+  create: defineAction({
+-+    input: z.object({
+-+      title: z.string().min(1),
+-+      slug: z.string().min(1),
+-+      email: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+      contactNumber: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+      aboutUs: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+      latestUpdate: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+    }),
+-+    handler: async (input) => {
+-+      const user = await getAdminUser();
+-+      if (!user) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.AUTH_REQUIRED, 'Authentication required');
+-+      const db = await getDb();
+-+      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-+      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
+-+      const newItem = {
+-+        id: `np-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
+-+        title: input.title,
+-+        slug: input.slug,
+-+        email: input.email || null,
+-+        contactNumber: input.contactNumber || null,
+-+        aboutUs: input.aboutUs || null,
+-+        latestUpdate: input.latestUpdate || null,
+-+        status: 'draft' as const,
+-+        ownerId: user.id,
+-+        createdAt: now,
+-+        updatedAt: now,
+-+      };
+-+
+-+      await db.insert(nonProfits).values(newItem);
+-+      return { success: true, data: { id: newItem.id, slug: newItem.slug } };
+-+    },
+-+  }),
+-+
+-+  // Update a non-profit
+-+  update: defineAction({
+-+    input: z.object({
+-+      id: z.string(),
+-+      title: z.string().min(1).optional(),
+-+      slug: z.string().min(1).optional(),
+-+      email: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+      contactNumber: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+      aboutUs: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+      latestUpdate: z.string().optional().nullable(),
+-+    }),
+-+    handler: async (input) => {
+-+      const user = await getAdminUser();
+-+      if (!user) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.AUTH_REQUIRED, 'Authentication required');
+-+      const db = await getDb();
+-+      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-+
+-+      const existing = await db.select()
+-+        .from(nonProfits)
+-+        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+        .limit(1)
+-+        .get();
+-+
+-+      if (!existing) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND, 'Non-profit not found');
+-+
+-+      const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = { updatedAt: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) };
+-+      if (input.title !== undefined) updateData.title = input.title;
+-+      if (input.slug !== undefined) updateData.slug = input.slug;
+-+      if (input.email !== undefined) updateData.email = input.email;
+-+      if (input.contactNumber !== undefined) updateData.contactNumber = input.contactNumber;
+-+      if (input.aboutUs !== undefined) updateData.aboutUs = input.aboutUs;
+-+      if (input.latestUpdate !== undefined) updateData.latestUpdate = input.latestUpdate;
+-+
+-+      await db.update(nonProfits)
+-+        .set(updateData)
+-+        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+        .run();
+-+
+-+      return { success: true, data: { id: input.id } };
+-+    },
+-+  }),
+-+
+-+  // Update non-profit status
+-+  updateStatus: defineAction({
+-+    input: z.object({
+-+      id: z.string(),
+-+      status: z.enum(['draft', 'active', 'deleted']),
+-+    }),
+-+    handler: async (input) => {

+-+      if (!db) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.SERVER_DB_ERROR, 'Database not available');
+-+
+-+      const existing = await db.select()
+-+        .from(nonProfits)
+-+        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+        .limit(1)
+-+        .get();
+-+
+-+      if (!existing) return createErrorResponse(ErrorCode.BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND, 'Non-profit not found');
+-+
+-+      await db.update(nonProfits)

+-+        .where(eq(nonProfits.id, input.id))
+-+        .run();
+-+
+-+      return { success: true, data: { id: input.id, status: input.status } };
+-+    },

 export const prerender = false;
 import AdminLayout from '@layouts/AdminLayout.astro';
+import { DashboardIsland } from '@/components/islands/admin';
+import { getDb } from '@/lib/db';
+import { businesses, users, products } from '@/db/schema';
+import { sql, eq, gte } from 'drizzle-orm';
+
+const db = await getDb();
+
+// Stats from DB
+const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
+const thirtyDaysAgo = now - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60);
+
+const [userCount] = await db.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` }).from(users).get() ?? [{ count: 0 }];
+const [businessCount] = await db.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` }).from(businesses).get() ?? [{ count: 0 }];
+const [nonProfitCount] = await db.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` }).from(businesses).where(eq(businesses.entityType, 'nonprofit')).get() ?? [{ count: 0 }];
+const [productCount] = await db.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` }).from(products).get() ?? [{ count: 0 }];
+const [mtdUserCount] = await db.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` }).from(users).where(gte(users.createdAt, thirtyDaysAgo)).get() ?? [{ count: 0 }];
+
+// Recent subscriptions for the list
+const { getAdminOrders } = await import('@/lib/db/queries');
+const orders = await getAdminOrders();
+
+const stats = {
+  totalUsers: userCount?.count ?? 0,
+  totalBusinesses: businessCount?.count ?? 0,
+  totalNonProfits: nonProfitCount?.count ?? 0,
+  totalProducts: productCount?.count ?? 0,
+  mtd: { revenue: 0, newSubscriptions: 0, newUsers: mtdUserCount?.count ?? 0 },
+  expiringSoon: 0,
+  monthly: [
+    { month: 'Jan', revenue: 0, subscriptions: 0 },
+    { month: 'Feb', revenue: 0, subscriptions: 0 },
+    { month: 'Mar', revenue: 0, subscriptions: 0 },
+    { month: 'Apr', revenue: 0, subscriptions: 0 },
+    { month: 'May', revenue: 0, subscriptions: 0 },
+    { month: 'Jun', revenue: 0, subscriptions: 0 },
+  ],
+};
